title: Human Resources Executive / HR Intern – Talent Acquisition & Training
description:
Human Resources Executive / HR Intern – Talent Acquisition \& Training

**Location:** Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu  
**Job Type:** Full\-Time

About the Role

We are looking for an enthusiastic **Human Resources Executive or HR Intern** to join our growing jewellery brand. Whether you are an experienced HR professional or a passionate fresher eager to build a career in Human Resources, this role offers an excellent opportunity to gain hands\-on experience in recruitment, employee onboarding, training, and HR operations.

Key ResponsibilitiesRecruitment \& Talent Acquisition

* Manage end\-to\-end recruitment for various departments.
* Write professional and attractive Job Descriptions (JDs).
* Post job openings on Indeed, LinkedIn, Naukri, and other hiring platforms.
* Source candidates through job portals, social media, employee referrals, and campus recruitment.
* Screen resumes and shortlist suitable candidates.
* Schedule and coordinate interviews with department heads.
* Conduct HR screening interviews and maintain interview records.
* Perform reference and background verification.

Candidate Assessment

* Prepare aptitude tests, communication assessments, and basic technical evaluations.
* Organize and conduct Group Discussions (GD) when required.
* Evaluate candidates based on skills, attitude, communication, and cultural fit.
* Recommend shortlisted candidates for final management interviews.

Onboarding \& Training

* Coordinate the complete onboarding process for new employees.
* Conduct induction and orientation sessions.
* Prepare training schedules and learning materials.
* Track employee probation and training progress.
* Support employee skill development initiatives.

SOP \& HR Operations

* Prepare and update Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
* Maintain HR documents, employee records, and recruitment reports.
* Assist in developing HR policies and employee handbooks.
* Ensure smooth HR operations and documentation.

Performance \& Employee Engagement

* Assist in employee performance evaluations.
* Support employee engagement activities and internal events.
* Coordinate with department heads for manpower planning.
* Maintain a positive and professional workplace culture.

EligibilityHR Executive

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in HR, MBA (HR), Business Administration, or related field.
* 2–5 years of HR or Talent Acquisition experience.
* Experience in retail, jewellery, fashion, or e\-commerce is preferred.

HR Intern

* Final\-year students or recent graduates in BBA, B.Com, BSW, MBA (HR), MSW, or related fields are welcome.
* Freshers with a strong interest in Human Resources can apply.
* Internship experience in recruitment or HR is an added advantage.

Skills Required

* Excellent communication in English and Tamil.
* Strong recruitment and interviewing skills.
* Good knowledge of Indeed, LinkedIn, Naukri, and other job portals.
* Ability to write clear and effective Job Descriptions.
* Strong organizational and documentation skills.
* Basic knowledge of MS Office and Google Workspace.
* Positive attitude, eagerness to learn, and good interpersonal skills.

Why Join Us?

* Work with a fast\-growing jewellery brand.
* Learn end\-to\-end HR operations and talent acquisition.
* Exposure to recruitment, training, SOP creation, and employee development.
* Career growth opportunities with mentorship from experienced professionals.
* Friendly, creative, and supportive work environment.

**Experience:** Fresher (Intern) to 5 Years (Executive)  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time / Internship  
**Location:** Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu

Pay: Up to ₹25,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Talent Acquisition - Assistant Manager
company: Brisk Olive Business Solutions Pvt Ltd
description:
We are seeking an experienced HR professional who can independently manage end\-to\-end HR operations with strong expertise in Tech Sales Recruitment. The ideal candidate will have proven experience hiring sales professionals across Networking, Wireless, ISP, Enterprise IT, and Channel Sales ecosystems.

**1\. Tech Sales Recruitment (Primary Responsibility)**

* Manage the complete recruitment lifecycle for IT Networking sales teams: Requirement understanding → Sourcing → Screening → Interview coordination → Offer rollout → Onboarding
* Hire profiles across key sales roles: RSM, BDM, TSM, Channel SM, TSE, Account Managers, Pre\-Sales Engineers
* Build a strong talent pipeline through LinkedIn, job portals, industry references, and networking communities
* Evaluate candidates on product knowledge, channel relationships, sales achievement, market exposure, and customer handling capability

**2\. HR Operations Management**

* Manage complete employee lifecycle: joining formalities, documentation, employee database, induction, and confirmation processes
* Handle attendance \& leave management, HR policy implementation, and employee engagement activities
* Coordinate with management on manpower planning, organization structure, and employee retention initiatives
* Maintain internal communication and ensure smooth day\-to\-day HR administration

**3\. Performance \& Employee Management**

* Support performance evaluation processes and appraisal cycles
* Maintain employee records and HR MIS reporting
* Identify employee engagement and professional development opportunities
* Assist in building and nurturing a positive, high\-performance work culture

**Experience Required**

* 4–8 years of overall experience in HR / Talent Acquisition
* Minimum 2–3 years of dedicated IT / Networking Sales Recruitment experience
* Prior experience hiring for OEMs, distributors, system integrators, or technology solution providers preferred

**Technical Understanding**: must understand the fundamentals of:

* Networking OEM and distributor ecosystem
* ISP / WISP market dynamics
* Enterprise networking solutions landscape
* Channel partner and reseller sales models
* Technical sales hierarchy and role structures

**Education**

* MBA / PG Diploma in Human Resources — preferred
* Graduate degree — mandatory

**Location: Noida, Sector 65**

**Budget: Upto 50k/month**

**6 Days Working**

Pay: ₹480,000\.00 \- ₹600,000\.00 per year

Experience:

* Talent acquisition: 4 years (Required)
* Non\-IT Sales Hiring: 3 years (Required)

The Branch Manager – Gold Loans is responsible for driving branch\-level business performance, ensuring compliance, delivering superior customer experience, and maintaining portfolio quality. The role leads the frontline team to achieve disbursement, new customer acquisition, yield, audit, collections, and risk KPIs while upholding operational governance. **2\) Dimensions:** *Mention quantitative or qualitative parameters that are relevant for the job and provide a better understanding of the scope and scale of the job.* **New Relationship**

Monitor delinquencies, yield, tonnage, auction ratios, spurious/bentex cases, and branch growth metric**3\) Job Context \& Major Challenges:** Write the specific aspects of the job that provide a challenge (internal and external) to the jobholder in the context of the Business/Unit/Function/Department/Section **(****Max 3975 Characters)**
==============================================================================================================================================================================================================================================

 **Organization Context**
Aditya Birla Capital Limited ("NBFC") is registered with RBI as a Systematically Important Non\-Deposit accepting Non\-Banking Finance Company (NBFC). ABCL is one of the top private diversified NBFCs in India. As of 31\-Sep’25, ABCL has a pan\-India presence with a lending book of approx. Rs. 139,500 Crores.  

ABCL offers end\-to\-end lending solutions to a diverse set of customers \- Retail, HNI, MSMEs, and Mid \& Large Corporates through secured as well as unsecured loan products. The diverse range of lending products includes Retail Small Ticket Secured and Unsecured Loans, Unsecured Personal Loans, Unsecured Business Loans, Health \& Education Loans, Digital B2B2C and B2B2B Small Ticket Loans, Small Business Secured Loans, Loans Against Property (LAP), Lease Rental Discounting (LRD), Construction Finance (to Real Estate Developers), SME Loans, Capital Markets Loans (Loan Against Shares), Supply Chain Finance, Mid and Large Corporate Loans, and Infrastructure Finance loans. ABCL also has a Wealth Management division.  

ABCL is rated “AAA” by India Ratings, ICRA and CARE (reaffirmed in 2020\). ABCL secured the ABG Business Excellence Award in 2017 (Silver), and 2015 (Bronze), and multiple other Awards on forums like CII. **Business Context**
Gold Loans is a key secured lending product with high volume, fast turnaround expectations and requires strict discipline in risk, valuation, purity testing, and customer trust management. **Job Context:**  

The Branch Manager executes gold loan business at the branch level, ensuring revenue, portfolio quality, and operational governance. The role balances growth, yield optimization, and compliance while managing a small but high?impact team and ensuring branch\-level risk controls **Key Challenges:*** Achieving aggressive customer acquisition, disbursement and tonnage growth in competitive local markets.
* Maintaining strict LTV adherence, gold purity compliance, and accurate valuation amid gold price fluctuations.
* Ensuring timely closure of spurious/bentex cases and minimizing auction\-to\-book ratio.
* Driving collection resolutions for 0–30 DPD while preventing slippages.
* Ensuring branch audit scores \>90% with zero tolerance deviations.
* Delivering consistent customer experience in high\-sensitivity product category (emotional asset).
* Motivating and developing frontline staff for continuous sales and service productivity
**4\) Key Result Areas:** Writethe key results expected from the job and the supporting actions for each of these key result areas (For most jobs typically there could be 4\- 7 key result areas)\- **Maximum 10 KRAs can be updated**
=======================================================================================================================================================================================================================================

 **Key Result Areas (Max 1325 Characters)** **Supporting Actions (Max 1325 Characters)** **Business Growth \& Acquisition*** Achieve targets for new CUID creation.
* Drive new customer disbursements as per percentile role benchmarks.
* Ensure net growth and tonnage growth in line with branch plan.
 **Yield \& Profitability Management*** Achieve onboarding yield benchmarks
* Drive optimal ticket size, renewal mix, and repeat customer engagement.
* Ensure cost\-efficient branch operations.
 **Portfolio Quality \& Risk Management*** Maintain auction\-to\-book ratio
* Ensure strict adherence to LTV, documentation quality, and purity testing protocols.
* Resolve spurious and bentex cases within defined timelines
 **Collections \& Delinquency Management*** Deliver resolution for 0–30 DPD bucket.
* Monitor overdue accounts and perform timely follow\-up.
* Support recovery actions as per internal guidelines.
 **Compliance, Audit \& Governance*** Achieve audit score as defined, ensure closure of audit findings.
* Maintain zero\-tolerance on operational deviations and regulatory breaches.
* Ensure accuracy in process, record keeping, and vault management.
 **Customer Service \& Branch Experience*** Ensure high service quality, fast turnaround time, and seamless grievance resolution.
* Maintain branch hygiene, safety, and security standards.
 **People Leadership \& Productivity*** Lead ABM, Gold Valuer, GLO, and CSE for daily performance.
* Conduct coaching, on\-the\-job training, and reviews.
* Ensure manpower productivity as per branch benchmarks
**5\) Job Purpose of Direct Reports:** Describe the job purpose of the direct report/s to the job (in 2\-3 lines for each report)
=================================================================================================================================

  

* Assistant Branch Manager: Support branch business operations, supervise frontline staff, and drive daily productivity.
* Manager – Gold Valuation: Ensure accurate valuation, purity checks, risk adherence, and secure handling of gold assets.
* Gold Loan Officer: Acquire customers, drive disbursement, manage renewals, and maintain documentation accuracy.
* Customer Service Executive: Deliver superior customer experience, manage service transactions, and support branch operations.

description:
**Job Title: Assistant Manager – HR**

**Location:**Thane, Wagle Estate

***Role Summary***

We are seeking a detail\-oriented and experienced **Assistant Manager – HR** to manage end\-to\-end payroll operations, statutory compliance, and HR administration while ensuring accuracy, confidentiality, and adherence to applicable labour laws. The role will be responsible for payroll processing, attendance management, statutory compliance, employee loan administration, HRMS management, full \& final settlements, and HR documentation to support smooth HR operations across the organization.

***Key Responsibilities***

**1\. Payroll Management**

* Manage end\-to\-end monthly payroll processing, ensuring timely and accurate salary disbursement.
* Validate payroll inputs including attendance, leave, overtime, incentives, bonuses, deductions, and reimbursements.
* Process annual increments, salary revisions, appraisal letters, and payroll\-related employee records.
* Prepare payroll reports and reconcile payroll data with the Finance team.

**2\. Attendance \& Leave Management**

* Monitor and validate employee attendance and leave records through the HRMS.
* Ensure accurate attendance data for payroll processing.
* Resolve attendance and leave discrepancies in coordination with department heads.

**3\. HRMS \& Payroll System Management**

* Administer and maintain the HRMS and payroll software, ensuring accurate employee master data.
* Upload and validate payroll inputs, attendance records, salary revisions, and statutory updates in the system.
* Coordinate with software vendors for issue resolution, system enhancements, and implementation of payroll\-related updates.
* Support HRMS automation initiatives and ensure data accuracy and system compliance.

**4\. Bonus, Gratuity \& Employee Benefits**

* Calculate and process statutory bonus and gratuity as per applicable laws.
* Maintain employee benefit records and ensure timely processing of eligible payments.
* Support administration of employee compensation and benefits.

**5\. Employee Loan Processing**

* Manage employee loan applications, approvals, documentation, and disbursement records as per company policy.
* Ensure accurate loan deductions through payroll and maintain loan repayment schedules.
* Prepare loan\-related reports and reconcile outstanding balances.

**6\. Statutory Compliance**

* Ensure timely compliance with PF, ESIC, Professional Tax (PT), Labour Welfare Fund (LWF), Bonus, Gratuity, and other statutory requirements.
* Prepare and submit statutory returns within prescribed timelines.
* Maintain statutory registers, records, and documentation.
* Stay updated on changes in labour laws and ensure organizational compliance.

**7\. Labour Law \& Factory Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with applicable Labour Laws, the Factory Act, and other employment regulations.
* Support internal and external statutory audits and labour inspections.
* Coordinate with government authorities and consultants on compliance matters as required.

**8\. Full \& Final Settlement (F\&F)**

* Process Full \& Final Settlements for resigned and terminated employees.
* Ensure accurate settlement of salary, leave encashment, gratuity, bonus, recoveries, loan adjustments, and statutory payments.
* Coordinate with HR, Finance, and departmental stakeholders for timely employee separation.

**9\. HR Documentation \& Operations**

* Prepare appointment letters, confirmation letters, appraisal letters, increment letters, transfer letters, and other employee correspondence.
* Maintain employee records and ensure complete HR documentation.
* Support onboarding, employee lifecycle management, and HR policy implementation.

**10\. Reporting \& Process Improvement**

* Generate payroll MIS, statutory reports, compliance dashboards, and management reports.
* Recommend improvements to payroll, HRMS, and compliance processes for greater efficiency and accuracy.
* Ensure confidentiality and integrity of employee payroll and personal data.

**Qualification \& Experience**

* MBA/PGDM in Human Resources or equivalent qualification.
* 6–10 years of experience in Payroll, HR Operations, and Statutory Compliance.
* Experience in a manufacturing environment will be preferred.
* Hands\-on experience with HRMS and payroll software.

**Key Competencies**

* End\-to\-End Payroll Management
* HRMS \& Payroll Software Administration
* Attendance \& Leave Management
* Employee Loan Processing
* PF, ESIC, PT, LWF, Bonus \& Gratuity Administration
* Full \& Final Settlement (F\&F)
* Labour Laws \& Factory Act Compliance
* Payroll Reconciliation \& MIS Reporting
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* High attention to detail and accuracy
* Advanced MS Excel and HRMS proficiency
* Excellent communication, coordination, and stakeholder management
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and meet strict deadlines

Pay: ₹45,000\.00 \- ₹50,000\.00 per month

* Flexible schedule

title: Senior Manager – Transitions
description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose\-driven, world\-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.
  

  

Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
  

  

Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance\-focused culture.


You’ll be part of the Transition and Transformation organisation, reporting into the Transition and Transformation Head working in close collaboration and partnership with multiple stakeholders across the board to enable delivery of the Haleon strategic roadmap.
  

  

You’ll enjoy the challenge of a fast\-paced, problem\-solving environment that requires you to think and act quickly to address strategic and day\-to\-day business priorities.


You’ll be empowered and accountable to deliver transitions end \- end spanning multiple Haleon functions, business units globally.


**About the Role**

The Global Transition and Transformation function has oversight and end to end delivery accountability for a wide portfolio of transformation programs and projects spanning Operating Model, Process and Enterprise level transformation. Your role therefore is pivotal to front\-ending and delivering the Operating Model transformation road map for Haleon.


* **Transition Scoping and planning:**
	+ Facilitate discovery workshops and document transition scope. Plan follow\-ups where required.
	+ Facilitate planning workshops; develop and baseline the end\-end transition roadmap / plan.
* **Business Case:** Closely monitor spend; manage baseline changes through change control.
* **Governance:**
* Partner with the Global PMO to ensure toll gate criteria are well defined relative to the transition nature and tollgates are orchestrated in line with the transition plan. Prepare content for tollgates.
* Prepare status reports on overall transition health for report\-out at weekly governance. Leverage standard tooling and best practices as prescribed by the Global PMO for status updates.
* **Detailed Design / Solutioning, Knowledge Transfer (KT) planning:**
	+ Consolidate outcomes of the detailed design for report\-out.
	+ Facilitate Knowledge Transfer planning workshops covering all aspects of the processes to be transitioned with clear alignment on scope, trainers, timelines, and ways of working.
* **Recruitment, Onboarding, Knowledge Transfer (KT):**
	+ Participate in recruitment steer cos; ensure HR gets required support from business to hire at pace.
	+ Align with IT requirements and raise provisioning requests in line with onboarding timelines.
	+ Onboard new joiners and orient / deploy for KT in accordance with the KT plan.
* **Stakeholder Management:** Plan stakeholder connects at an agreed cadence to keep them informed of the transition progress. Maintain a stakeholder log evidencing stakeholder engagement (Actions from the meetings, follow up plans etc.)

**Responsibilities:**

* Provide strategic leadership for large, complex, multi\-country transitions and operating model transformations.
* Own transition portfolio prioritization and resource planning in alignment with enterprise strategy.
* Act as escalation point for risks, issues, and cross\-functional dependencies.
* Mentor and develop Managers and Leads within the Transition \& Transformation team.
* Partner with senior business leaders to shape future transition opportunities and business cases.
* Drive standardization, best practices, and continuous improvement across transition methodology.

Experience (Senior Manager)


* 14\+ years of progressive experience in large\-scale transitions, transformations, or shared services environments.
* Demonstrated leadership of geographically distributed teams and senior executive stakeholders.
* Experience influencing strategy and decision\-making at Director / VP levels.

You will be supported by colleagues who live the culture of making Haleon a diverse and inclusive employer. We believe in agile working for all roles. If flexibility is important to you, our hybrid philosophy will certainly support you to stretch, learn and grow every day. This is your invitation to make everyday health more achievable, more inclusive and more sustainable.


**Qualifications \& Skills:**

* 14\+ years demonstrated experience of transitioning processes from local markets to Shared Services Captives, Outsourcing partners etc.
* Transition management experience across multiple functions (Finance, Supply Chain, Procurement, Tech etc.) in a Consumer goods company is a plus, but not mandatory
* Demonstrated proficiency in project, program, portfolio management processes and principles
* Demonstrated experience delivering projects through both Agile and waterfall approach is desirable.
* Demonstrated resilience in navigating through complex and ambiguous change.
* Excellent interpersonal (communication and presentation) and organizational skills
* Hands on experience on PM tools – Example MS Project, MS P4W, Jira, Confluence, Teams
* Certifications – PMP, Prince 2

This is a unique opportunity to influence change, interact with global stakeholders on projects and programs that drive a real impact to the Haleon businesses. Your ability to ‘make things happen’ coupled with a ‘positive can\-do attitude’ will set you up for success in this role.  



 **Job Posting End Date**

2026\-08\-15  

**Equal Opportunities**
-----------------------

Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It’s important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.
  

  

During the application process, we may ask you to share some personal information, which is entirely voluntary. This information ensures we meet certain regulatory and reporting obligations and supports the development, refinement, and execution of our inclusion and belonging programmes that are open to all Haleon employees.
  

  

The personal information you provide will be kept confidential, used only for legitimate business purposes, and will never be used in making any employment decisions, including hiring decisions.  



**Adjustment or Accommodations Request**

If you require a reasonable adjustment or accommodation or other assistance to apply for a job at Haleon at any stage of the application process, please let your recruiter know by providing them with a description of specific adjustments you are requesting. We’ll provide all reasonable adjustments to support you throughout the recruitment process and treat all information you provide us in confidence.  



**Note to candidates**
----------------------

The Haleon recruitment team will contact you using a Haleon email account (@haleon.com). If you are not sure whether the email you received is from Haleon, please get in touch.

title: Senior Lead Compensation
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission\-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI\-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well\-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.  



  

**The Role**

**Your Role**  

Kyndryl is looking to hire a strategic and dynamic Senior Lead Compensation to support our Asia Pacific markets and our data analytic needs. The Senior Lead will play a key role in supporting the evolution of our compensation programs to ensure we can attract, retain, and inspire top talent in the fast\-paced technology industry. This role will be hands\-on in implementing transformative compensation programs and designing efficient processes to support them. The role is split roughly evenly across two distinct areas: (1\) Compensation Analytics, dashboard, insights, and (2\) compensation partnering and advisory for our Asia Pacific markets, where strong stakeholder collaboration and client\-facing consulting skills are essential.
  

  

**What you will do**  

Key responsibilities include:


Role \& Responsibilities:


* Execute Employee compensation strategy based on global compensation and business strategy and facilitate the global compensation programs roll\-out at market/country level.
* Be a trusted partner and consult with HR Partners and senior business managers on pay decisions and related challenges and provide strategic and operational guidance and direction.
* Act as a strategic compensation partner to HR leaders and business executives across Asia Pacific, providing consultation on compensation decisions, workforce planning, talent attraction, retention, and pay governance.
* Serve as an advocate of the Total Rewards philosophy. Own local Compensation programs to align with the corporate and market/country strategy.
* Develop compensation analytics, models, dashboards, and insights related to pay competitiveness, pay equity, salary movements, hiring premiums, retention risks, and workforce trends to support business and compensation strategy
* Provide analytical insights to business and leadership related to compensation and assist them in decision making.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams such as HR Tech, CIO, Finance, Payroll, Legal, ER/LR,. to drive the execution efficiency and ensure seamless employee/manager experience.
* Continuously identify opportunities to improve, digitize \& automate compensation processes. Ensure compliance of compensation policies with local regulatory requirements.
  

  

**Your Future at Kyndryl**  

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands\-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

  

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer\-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.  

  



**Required Skills and Experience**

* 5 to 10 years of experience in HR preferably in Compensation with a thorough understanding of Employee Compensation.
* Proficiency in communicating complicated concepts to a broad audience. Familiar with Compensation Benchmarking Surveys and tools used. Proficient in Microsoft PowerPoint
* Experience partnering with or advising stakeholders across Asia Pacific markets, with an understanding of regional pay practices and regulatory differences; strong consulting, influencing and cross\-cultural communication skills.
* Ability to maintain discretion with extremely confidential information. Ability to build trust\-based relationships HR Partners and management.
* Strong organizational, analytical, and written communication skills
* Ability to build a story with data to support business decisions and recommendations.
* Fluent (written and spoken) in English.

  

**Preferred Skills and Experience:**

* Advanced analytical skills with expertise in Excel, compensation modelling, data visualization, and dashboard development; experience with Power BI or similar analytics tools preferred.

  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.  



  

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid\-friendly culture that supports your well\-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  

  

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  

  

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in\-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting\-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands\-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  

  

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.


**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

*Job Title:* ***Associate, HR Operations Intern***

*Location: 37 Cunningham Road, Bangalore*

**Why join Pearson’s intern program?**

Pearson is the world’s learning company. We help people of all ages acquire the knowledge and skills they need to be successful in their work and careers. We believe that everyone should be able to keep learning, every day and in every way, throughout their lives. Bringing together everything we know about the science of learning and the latest technology; we’re shaping the future of teaching and learning.


As one of our interns, you will gain a comprehensive introduction to our business. You’ll be assigned to a team to support real\-life projects that bring our products and services to life and are ready to launch to our learners. On\-the\-job training and professional development will be provided to enable you to contribute to the business. You’ll also have direct access to a senior member of the team, as each intern will be mentored to help you make the most of the internship at Pearson. During your internship, you will gain valuable hands\-on experience to build your resume to stand out with future employers, such as Pearson. We foster a work environment that’s inclusive as well as diverse, where our people can be themselves. Every idea and perspective are valued so that our products reflect the people we serve — our teachers and students, employers and employees, and consumers and learners.


**What Does the Internship Program Offer?**

This six\-month internship provides hands\-on experience in HR Operations, with exposure to employee onboarding, engagement, HR data management, benefits\-related initiatives, and cross\-functional coordination.


With guidance from experienced HR professionals, interns will develop practical skills in communication, stakeholder coordination, time management, and HR operations while gaining valuable insight into the employee lifecycle within a global organization.


You will be eligible for accrued paid sick time per the policy guidelines. Please refer to the Sick Leave Policy.


**Job Description**

Pearson is seeking a motivated and detail\-oriented **Associate, HR Operations Intern** to join the Country Care HR team in Bangalore. The Country Care HR team sits within HR Operations and supports operational excellence, compliance, and the delivery of locally relevant HR services and solutions.


Reporting to the Country Care SAARC Lead, the intern will support the HR Country Care team across a range of operational and employee\-focused activities. This role provides an opportunity to gain practical experience in HR Operations, employee onboarding, employee engagement, HR data management, benefits\-related initiatives, and cross\-functional coordination.


The successful candidate will demonstrate strong communication and organizational skills, effective time management, attention to detail, and a genuine interest in delivering a positive employee experience. The intern will work closely with HR stakeholders and gain exposure to the operational processes that support employees throughout their employee lifecycle.


**What does the 6\-months duration involve?**

During the six\-month internship, you will gain hands\-on experience in HR Operations while supporting initiatives that enhance employee experience and contribute to operational excellence and compliance.


Key areas of involvement may include:


* Supporting employee onboarding activities and helping to deliver a smooth and positive onboarding experience.
* Assisting with employee engagement initiatives and programs.
* Supporting the maintenance, organization, and accuracy of HR data and employee records.
* Assisting with benefits\-related initiatives and employee support activities.
* Supporting interview coordination and other recruitment\-related administrative activities, as needed.
* Collaborating with HR team members and cross\-functional stakeholders to support the effective delivery of HR services.
* Assisting with the coordination and administration of HR processes and operational activities.
* Supporting the preparation, tracking, and management of HR\-related information and documentation.
* Developing an understanding of HR Operations, employee experience design, and data\-driven HR insights.
* Building practical skills in communication, stakeholder coordination, time management, organization, and project support.
* Throughout the internship, you will receive guidance and support from experienced HR professionals while gaining valuable exposure to HR processes, employee lifecycle activities, and the operational practices that support Pearson’s purpose: **Add Life to a Lifetime of Learning.**

**Minimum Requirements/Qualifications:**

* Currently pursuing or recently completed a bachelor’s or master’s degree, with a strong interest in Human Resources and HR Operations.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Demonstrated ability to work proactively, take initiative, and identify actions required with minimal supervision.
* Strong attention to detail, with effective follow\-up and coordination skills.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks, prioritize effectively, and ensure the timely completion of deliverables.
* Willingness and ability to work from the office at least three days per week.

*Pearson is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer and a member of E\-Verify. All qualified applicants, including minorities, women, protected veterans, and individuals with disabilities are encouraged to apply.*

*Pearson believes that wherever learning flourishes, so do people. We are committed to being an anti\-racist company in everything we do. We value the power of an inclusive culture and a strong sense of belonging. We promote a culture where differences are embraced, opportunities are accessible, consideration and respect are the norm, and all individuals are supported in reaching their full potential.*

*Through our talent, we believe that diversity, equity, and inclusion make us a more innovative and vibrant place to work. People are at the center, and we are committed to a sustainable environment and workplace where talent can learn, grow, and thrive.*

*To learn more about Pearson’s commitment to a diverse and inclusive workforce, please :* http://www.pearson.com/careers/diversity\-and\-inclusion.html

**3\. Technical \& Niche Hiring**

iii. Embedded Engineers

iv. Robotics Engineers

v. Software Engineers

vi. Computer Vision Engineers

vii. AI/ML Engineers

viii. ROS Developers

ix. Firmware Engineers

x. Manufacturing \& Production Engineers

i. Robotics

ii. Autonomous Systems

iii. IoT Systems

iv. Fire Control Systems

v. Training Simulators

vi. Electro\-Optical Systems

a. Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, Management, or any related discipline.

a. 0–1 year of internship experience in recruitment, talent acquisition.

3\. Experience sourcing candidates through LinkedIn and other job portals.

**What You'll Gain**

title: Senior Medical Writer Medical Information
description:
Job description:

Cactus Life Sciences is a remote\-first organization, and we embrace an accelerate from anywhere culture. You may be required to travel to our Mumbai office based on business requirements or for company/team events.


If you are looking for challenging and rewarding work which combines your understanding of medical science and aptitude for writing into one unique job, the **Senior Medical Writer,Medical Information** role is for you. This is an opportunity to grow your career and make a greater impact on the lives around you.


Job responsibilities:
* Taking ownership and responsibility for development (write, review, proofread, and data\-check) of high\-quality, client\-ready scientific, medical, and educational materials like slides, abstracts, posters, manuscripts, MSL/training slide decks, infographics, congress and meetings materials, literature searches and reviews, standard response letters/medical information letters, and HCP engagement content according to client and audience needs with excellent attention to detail.
* Actively involve in reviewing materials developed by scientific writers to ensure strategic alignment and scientific accuracy as needed and providing clear constructive feedback, support, and supervision to writers. Mentor and train scientific writers by sharing best practices and client preferences, thereby contributing to skill development within the team.
* Having excellent knowledge of product/account to enable meaningful interactions with clients and authors, including consultancy where necessary.
* Building and maintaining strong, long\-term relationships with international pharmaceutical clients, healthcare professionals, and key stakeholders, including authors, reviewers, and KOLs across therapeutic areas. This involves anticipating client needs, advising on strategic and tactical plans, and recommending improvements to scientific content and new ways to disseminate data effectively.
* Attend workshops/seminars/trainings to hone your skills and contribute to organizational objectives. Attending client and other external meetings and supporting senior team members as needed.
* Apply your scientific and creative knowledge and work closely with client directors in developing ideas and executing effective medical communications initiatives in the digital space, including publication extenders, creation of infographics, interactive assets, website content, patient narratives, and medical information engagement plans. Also, supporting with the development of visual content and materials using effective data visualization techniques and approaches. Contributing to innovative “out of the box” solutions for medical writing projects.
* You will be responsible for ensuring all materials follow/comply with client requirements/SOPs, style guides, client templates, client preferences (as applicable), and CACTUS’ internal SOPs. Any updates to either of these items should be made consistently and documents should remain up to date.
* Perform as a document specialist, provide intellectual input across document types, and contribute to making cutting\-edge research accessible to specific audiences as appropriate, by maintaining current awareness of developments across therapeutic areas or disciplines.
* Supporting with pitches, both during the preparation phase and the actual pitch.  

\#LI\-Remote


Qualifications and prerequisites:
* 5\+ years of experience in Medical Information content for Medical Affairs/Promo Med Ed, preferably within an agency or biopharma environment
* PhD/MD (Pharmacology) OR PhD (Life Sciences) OR PharmD OR MPharm/ M.Sc. with a good understanding of clinical research and medical communication
* Has experience in reviewing, particularly, MI documents
* Very good communication (written and verbal) as you would need to manage clients and other junior writers
* Clear, concise, scientific style of writing, with a high level of attention to detail and excellent language skills
* Ability to multi\-task and work under tight timelines


Application process:

Before applying, please ensure you meet the role requirements listed above and have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is advertised. Our selection process typically involves an initial screening by a recruiter, a technical assessment, and two to three interview rounds. For this role, the process starts with a **Technical Interview** with the Hiring Managers, followed by a **Technical Assessment,** where candidates will have agreed upon timeline to complete the task. The final round will be the **HR Interview.** All interactions will be conducted virtually via **MS Teams.**

 **AI at Cactus Life Sciences**
The life sciences industry is undergoing a fundamental shift in how scientific knowledge is created, communicated, and delivered. We are building our work around it.
AI is embedded meaningfully across everything we do, through proprietary platforms purpose\-built for life sciences and generative tools that deliver measurable value to our clients. It is core to how we operate, and an expected way of working for everyone who joins us.
We believe in Human\-Anchored AI™: whatever your discipline \- science, communications, strategy, or operations, you will work in an environment where AI augments your expertise rather than replaces it.
You will build skills that are in genuine demand and still taking shape across the industry. If you are curious and focused on building capabilities for the world where human intelligence meets artificial intelligence, this is where you belong. **Equal Opportunity**


Our hiring practices reflect our commitment to providing equal opportunities and creating an environment where everyone can thrive, develop, and succeed. We celebrate the uniqueness of our team members and prohibit discrimination of any kind, based on race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or any other protected characteristic.

  

About Us:

At Cactus Life Sciences (cactuslifesciences.com), we believe the future of medical communications lies at the intersection of science, technology, and human connection. Headquartered in Princeton, New Jersey, with teams in Switzerland, the United Kingdom, India, and Japan, we help biopharmaceutical organizations redefine scientific exchange—leveraging AI, automation, and innovation while keeping patients at the heart of everything we do.

  

Our expertise spans medical strategy, scientific content development, and medical education across therapeutic areas and the product lifecycle. By blending scientific rigor, agile operational models, and future\-ready technologies, we partner with medical affairs teams to catalyze their transformation, adapt to a changing landscape, and drive meaningful outcomes for healthcare communities worldwide.

title: VP - Procurement
description:
**Job Title: VP – Procurement**

* The Senior Strategic Sourcing Manager will develop and execute category and supply base strategies and sourcing projects in assigned categories to deliver defined country annual targets by driving competitive advantage for the HSBC business through cost savings, lifecycle value generation, demand management and innovation.
* The projects will be delivered globally or locally in accordance with the category strategy plans and will leverage the full range of supply and demand\-side levers. In\-depth sourcing knowledge will be applied in the execution of these plans across all category areas whilst ensuring the risks associated with the purchase of goods and services are mitigated commercially, contractually and operationally.  

It is expected that post contract value opportunities will be identified and delivered through working with business supplier managers and the local supply base making sure that these opportunities align with category strategies at all times.
* The role will primarily focus on Corporate Real Estate Services category and is likely work across other variety of categories such as Professional Services \& Consulting, Workforce category, HR Services, Marketing, Legal, Events, Insurance, etc. so will need to demonstrate a broad range of category knowledge and be able to work dynamically and flexibly with a broad range of SMEs. The role will work with a variety of stakeholders and business partners requiring proactive engagement and fostering of existing and new relationships.

**In this role, you will:**

* Drive the right business outcomes with advanced subject matter expertise during the execution of projects. Support the local business in ensuring that the outputs of sourcing projects are embedded in the business to drive value through the contract lifecycle. Ensure maximum contractual protection for the business, taking into account the Procurement Handbook requirements and local regulatory issues. Ensure that businesses have operational accountability for contracts after execution and work with the Third\-Party Risk Management team to drive appropriate deployment of the supplier relationship and risk management framework. Provide robust reports on progress against targets, Preferred Supplier List and buying channel compliance.
* In the execution of sourcing projects, instil a responsive and strategic service and delivery culture, which makes business stakeholders value Procurement. Lead the application of a range of sourcing approaches, including the use of eSourcing, to deliver the most appropriate business outcomes. Influence the business and act as pathfinder for business (including Legal) and supply market relationships. Develop and execute local category strategies aligned with global category plans The category plans will be robust and forward\-looking based on business and product needs, supply market dynamics, and technological changes in marketplace. Foster and build relationships with key stakeholders and business partners as relevant to the role.
* Demonstrate importance of advanced subject matter expertise through example. Market and communicate appropriate category guidelines to the business. Act as a change agent for the Procurement Transformation and beyond into future change initiatives. Drive embedding of best practices and compliance to all Source to Pay processes through personal performance.
* Achieve or exceed agreed savings target for sourcing projects and categories. Lead negotiation and agreement of terms and conditions for all projects. Manage all initiatives to a robust plan in alignment with business/process milestones. Understand complex business problems, apply advanced analytical thinking / market knowledge and drive the most appropriate business outcome. Ensure project data (savings, pipeline, milestones, risks, and issues and all other appropriate data sources) is accurate and reflective of reality.Drive the usage of a variety of Procurement tools and manage an interface with offshore support teams. Demonstrate adherence to internal controls. This will be achieved by adherence to all relevant procedures, keeping appropriate records and, where appropriate, by the timely implementation of internal and external audit points, including issues raised by external regulators.
* Managing complex stakeholder relationship: Balancing the diverse and often conflicting priorities of internal stakeholders requires advanced negotiation, communication and influencing skills. Maintaining alignment across global teams while ensuring compliance with regulatory and procurement frameworks adds complexity. Navigating Regulatory and compliances pressures. Leading sourcing transformation initiatives (e.g., digital procurement, supplier innovation, sustainability) demands change leadership and strategic foresight.
* As the Vice President – Strategic Sourcing, the role operates in a highly dynamic, complex, and regulated environment. The sourcing landscape is influenced by evolving global market conditions, increasing regulatory scrutiny, rising stakeholder expectations, and accelerating digital transformation. The role holder is responsible for leading category strategy development and execution across a multi\-million dollar global spend portfolio. Operating at the intersection of commercial, regulatory, and operational priorities, the role demands a sophisticated balance of strategic vision, commercial rigor, and stakeholder influence.The role holder is expected to operate with significant autonomy and decision\-making authority, while ensuring strict adherence to HSBC’s governance, third\-party risk management, and procurement policies. There is limited day\-to\-day guidance, with the expectation that the role holder will proactively shape sourcing strategies, lead high\-value negotiations, resolve complex sourcing challenges, and drive innovation in supplier engagement.
* Ensuring compliance with all relevant FIMs, including Third Party Risk Management (TPRM), Outsourcing, Records Management, guidelines, Functional SOP’s and Conduct Risk guidelines. Proactively identifying operational, financial, reputational, and conduct risks associated with third\-party engagements, particularly in high\-risk service categories such as consultancy and workforce. Embedding controls throughout the sourcing lifecycle—from supplier due diligence and onboarding to contract execution, ongoing performance monitoring, and exit planning. Collaborating closely with Risk, Legal, Compliance, and Internal Audit teams to ensure sourcing strategies align with both internal policies and external regulatory expectations. Championing risk awareness across the supply chain and driving a culture of risk\-informed decision making within the sourcing function and among stakeholders.
* Ensuring full compliance with relevant FIMs, including but not limited to: Third Party Risk Management (TPRM). Outsourcing and Procurement Policies. Compliance to Anti\-Bribery and Corruption (AB\&C). Records Management. Embedding control checks and governance gates across the end\-to\-end sourcing process—from strategic planning through to contract execution and supplier management. Driving policy adherence through consistent documentation, transparent decision\-making, and timely approvals within sourcing platforms and internal control systems. Participating in internal reviews and audits, providing clear evidence of control effectiveness and taking ownership for timely remediation of identified issues. .

**To be successful you will:**


* Achieving Excellence, Customer Focus, Driving Sustainable Growth, Managing Risk Responsibly. Maximising the Performance of our People, Commerciality, Managing Business Information, Collaboration, Strengthening Stakeholder Relationships, Innovation and Idea Management, Change and Implementation Management. Supplier Relationship Development, Contract \& Service Management, Vendor Risk \& Compliance.
* The role commands significant commercial and strategic influence within HSBC’s global operations, with responsibility for managing a high\-value and complex category portfolio. Key dimensions of the role include: Spend Responsibility: Accountable for managing a global sourcing portfolio with the spend of USD $250\-300M spend annually across Real Estate Services, Professional Services, Consultancy, and Workforce categories. Independently manage any projects that value exceeds $1M USD.
* Contract Volume: Oversees the strategic sourcing and ongoing management of hundreds of supplier contracts, including global framework agreements, master service agreements, and high\-risk consultancy engagements.
* Transaction Complexity: Leads sourcing for both tactical and highly strategic engagements, often involving multi\-geography and cross\-functional stakeholder alignment, regulatory impact, and high reputational sensitivity.
* Governance Oversight: Responsible for ensuring compliance with internal governance frameworks across all sourcing activities, including competitive tendering, supplier due diligence, risk assessment, and contractual approval processes.
* Budget Influence: Provides strategic input into category\-level budget planning and optimization, influencing workforce and consulting expenditure decisions at both global and regional levels.
* Stakeholder Reach: Engages with Group\-level senior executives, including HR, Finance, Risk, Legal, Compliance, and Business Unit Heads, across multiple geographies and time zones. These dimensions reflect the high degree of strategic, financial, and operational impact the role has within HSBC’s global sourcing and third\-party risk ecosystem.

title: Manager, Compensation
description:
About Us:

Ventra is a leading business solutions provider for facility\-based physicians practicing anesthesia, emergency medicine, hospital medicine, pathology, and radiology. Focused on Revenue Cycle Management, Ventra partners with private practices, hospitals, health systems, and ambulatory surgery centers to deliver transparent and data\-driven solutions that solve the most complex revenue and reimbursement issues, enabling clinicians to focus on providing outstanding care to their patients and communities. **Come Join Our Team!*** As part of our robust Rewards \& Recognition program, this role is eligible for our Ventra performance\-based incentive plan, because we believe great work deserves great rewards

**Help Us Grow Our Dream Team — Join Us, Refer a Friend, and Earn a Referral Bonus!**
Job Summary:
* The Manager, Compensation is responsible for the day\-to\-day governance and administration of compensation programs for Ventra, ensuring pay decisions are consistent, competitive, and compliant with local regulations. This role manages offer and internal movement approvals, supports the annual salary review and bonus cycles, maintains job grading and salary structures, and partners closely with Business Partners, Talent Acquisition, Payroll and other HR stakeholders to ensure accurate and timely execution of compensation processes. This is a hands\-on role suited for a compensation professional with solid technical grounding who is ready to own a full\-cycle compensation portfolio for the India market.


Essential Functions and Tasks:
* Review and approve compensation for new hire offers and internal movements (promotions, transfers, lateral moves), ensuring alignment with salary structures, internal equity, and budget guidelines.
* Administer the annual salary review cycle, including data preparation, modeling, guideline development, manager enablement, and post\-cycle audits.
* Administer the annual bonus/incentive cycle, including calculation methodology, eligibility checks, payout modeling, and reconciliation with Finance and Payroll.
* Manage incentive plan administration for applicable colleagues, ensuring accuracy and timely payout in coordination with relevant stakeholders.
* Own job evaluation and grading for new and existing job descriptions, applying job evaluation methodology consistently across the organization.
* Maintain and periodically update salary structures/pay bands based on market benchmarking and internal equity analysis.
* Monitor and ensure compliance with applicable labor laws and statutory requirements relating to compensation (e.g., minimum wage rules, bonus act provisions, gratuity, PF, tax as relevant to comp design).
* Partner with the Payroll team to ensure accurate translation of compensation decisions into payroll processing, resolving discrepancies as needed.
* Support internal audits and statutory/regulatory reporting requirements related to compensation.
* Prepare compensation analyses, reports, and dashboards for HR and business leadership as needed.
* Respond to compensation\-related queries from HRBPs, managers, and employees, providing guidance grounded in policy and market data.
* Support ad hoc compensation projects (e.g., market benchmarking studies, pay equity analysis, new market entry pay structures) as assigned.


Education and Experience Requirements:
* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Psychology, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field required;
* 5–6 years of progressive experience in compensation management or total rewards, ideally within a multinational, shared services, or matrixed organization.
* Demonstrated experience managing salary review and bonus cycles end\-to\-end.
* Experience with job evaluation/grading methodologies (e.g., Mercer IPE, Korn Ferry/Hay, Willis Towers Watson, or similar).
* Working knowledge of statutory compliance requirements for India / US / Philippines as they relate to compensation.
* Experience in using HRIS and/or compensation planning tools preferred.
* Experience with compensation survey platforms (Mercer, WTW, Aon, Radford, etc.) preferred.
* Advanced Excel skills required.


Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:
* Strong quantitative and analytical skills, with the ability to model scenarios and translate data into clear recommendations.
* Solid understanding of compensation principles, including pay equity, market pricing, and total rewards philosophy.
* Working knowledge of labor laws for India / PH / US and statutory compliance as applicable to compensation administration.
* High attention to detail and accuracy, particularly given the sensitivity and confidentiality of compensation data.
* Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent cycles and deadlines.
* Effective communication skills, with the ability to explain compensation concepts clearly to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to build strong cross\-functional working relationships, particularly with Talent Acquisition, Talent Management, Payroll, HRBPs, and Finance.
* Discretion and sound judgment in handling confidential and sensitive information.
* Comfortable operating with a degree of autonomy while knowing when to escalate policy or compliance questions.


Compensation:
* Base Compensation will be based on various factors unique to each candidate including geographic location, skill set, experience, qualifications, and other job\-related reasons.
* This position is also eligible for a discretionary incentive bonus in accordance with company policies.

We encourage applications from a diverse pool of candidates, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ethnicity, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, or veteran status. 	+ Identify and highlight roadblocks, process gaps, and resourcing needs to the Leadership team as part of continuous improvement efforts. **Manage Work Transition and Insourcing**

	+ Develop standard processes and documents for onboarding new team members
	+ Execute Operations of the Platform for assigned Brands and domains in partnership with the technology teams in AIN and US. **Facilitate Cross\-Team and Organizational Engagement and Alignment**


	+ Partner closely with peers in Commercial Data Strategy core pillars and Data Management Leads in AIN to contribute to delivering against our priority initiatives and establish new ways of working, especially across time zones.
	+ Work with our Technology/IT partners and the US team members in Product Team setting and partner with other Product teams to ensure deliverables are aligned with the Platform governance model
	+ Act as a liaison between at our Amgen India Innovation Center with other Customer Data \& Analytics Teams to ensure alignment on goals, processes, and success measures.

title: Human Resources Operations Team Lead
description:
Pretium is a specialized investment manager with \~$53B in assets under management (AUM) focused on real estate, mortgage finance, and corporate debt. Pretium manages more than 96,000 single\-family rentals (SFRs) in the United States and has a global employee base of \~4,400\.


Pretium Enterprise Operations India Private Limited (PES India), based in Bangalore, is integral to the growth, innovation, and transformation of Pretium’s global operating companies. With 700\+ employees, PES India delivers with excellence, ownership, and a relentless focus on scalable growth.

 **Job Description:**

 *About the role:*


The HR Operations Team Lead at PES India is a key delivery role within the HR function, responsible for executing and overseeing the day\-to\-day HR operations processes that keep the employee lifecycle running accurately and on time — from Day 1 to exit. This role ensures that the operational heartbeat of HR is consistent, compliant, and employee\-centric.  

We are looking for a detail\-obsessed, process\-driven, and dependable HR Ops Team Lead who can own their workstreams end\-to\-end, support and guide junior team members, and serve as the first point of operational escalation within the team. This role works closely with the HR Ops Assistant Manager and Manager, the HRBP, Finance, and external vendors to deliver seamless HR operations for our 700\+ employees.

 *What you will do at PES India:*

*Employee Lifecycle Management*

* Execute and oversee end\-to\-end HR operations across the employee lifecycle — onboarding, confirmations, transfers, promotions, role changes, and exits — ensuring accuracy and timeliness at every stage
* Coordinate weekly induction logistics and ensure every new joiner has a smooth Day 1 — system access, documentation, and orientation completed before they arrive
* Manage the offboarding process — exit documentation, clearance coordination, full and final settlement inputs, and real\-time HRMS updates
* Prepare and issue all HR letters — offer, confirmation, transfer, promotion, and exit — with accuracy and turnaround speed
* Coordinate background verification (BGV) with vendors and ensure timely, accurate completion for all new joiners
 *HR Documentation \& Compliance*

* Maintain accurate, audit\-ready employee records across both physical and digital systems
* Ensure compliance with company HR policies and applicable statutory requirements; flag gaps proactively to the Assistant Manager
* Support internal and external HR audits with well\-organised documentation and trackers
* Assist in updating HR policy documents and process SOPs as directed by the HR leadership
 *Payroll \& Attendance Support*

* Compile and validate monthly payroll inputs — attendance, leaves, shift data, arrears, and variable pay — and share with the payroll processing team on time, every cycle
* Track leave balances, attendance records, and shift schedules; resolve discrepancies before they become payroll errors
* Coordinate with Finance and the payroll vendor to ensure smooth monthly cycles; flag exceptions and unresolved issues to the Assistant Manager
 *Benefits Administration*

* Manage the end\-to\-end medical insurance process — enrolments, additions, deletions, claim coordination, and annual renewal support
* Administer other employee benefits including shift allowances, weekend allowances, and any other applicable benefits programmes
* Serve as the first point of contact for employee benefit queries; resolve with speed and clarity; escalate complex cases appropriately
* Coordinate with benefits vendors — track SLAs, follow up on pending items, and flag performance issues to the Assistant Manager
 *HRIS \& Data Management*

* Ensure all employee data in Workday is accurate, up\-to\-date, and aligned with organisational standards always
* Prepare standard HR reports, MIS dashboards, and data extracts for the HR team and leadership — on time and in the right format
* Identify opportunities to improve data quality and reporting processes; flag automation or efficiency ideas to the Assistant Manager
* Maintain strict adherence to data privacy, confidentiality, and information security requirements
 *Employee Query Management*

* Respond to employee queries on HR policies, processes, benefits, and documentation — promptly, accurately, and with a helpful tone
* Maintain a query log to track recurring themes and surface them to the HRBP or Assistant Manager for policy\-level intervention
* Support HR initiatives, engagement activities, and culture programmes with operational and logistical coordination
 *Team Support \& Process Oversight*

* Guide and support junior HR Ops team members on day\-to\-day execution – reviewing their work, answering process queries, and ensuring quality and consistency
* Serve as the first point of escalation within the team for operational issues before they are raised to the Assistant Manager
* Contribute to process documentation, SOP maintenance, and continuous improvement initiatives within the HR Ops function
 *What we are looking for:*

*Must\-ha**ve*

* 6–10 years of experience in HR Operations or an HR generalist role with strong ops exposure
* Hands\-on experience managing employee lifecycle processes end\-to\-end — with a track record of ownership, not just support
* Proficiency in Workday — prior experience with HCM, Absence, and Reporting modules strongly preferred
* Strong MS Office skills — especially Excel (pivot tables, VLOOKUP, data validation) and PowerPoint
* Experience coordinating payroll inputs and benefits administration
* Working knowledge of Indian statutory compliance requirements — PF, ESI, Gratuity, POSH, Shops \& Establishment Act
* High attention to detail — someone who finds errors before anyone else does
* Good communication skills in English, both written and verbal
 *Good to have*

* Experience working in a GCC, shared services, or fast\-paced multinational environment
* Exposure to ServiceNow or a ticketing / query management system
* Familiarity with data visualisation tools (Tableau, Power BI, or similar)
* Prior experience supporting or guiding junior team members
 *Education*

* MBA/PGDM in HR (preferred)
* Bachelor’s degree with strong relevant experience will also be considered
 *Perks \& Benefits:*


We believe great people deserve to be taken care of – here’s what working at PES India looks like beyond the job:

* **Competitive Compensation –**Market\-aligned salary with performance\-linked bonus
* **Shift \& Weekend Allowances –** Additional allowances over and above fixed salary
* **Insurance Coverage****–** Group health cover for self and family \+ term and personal accident cover for self
* **Hybrid Flexibility –** 3 days on\-site, 2 days remote
* **Career Growth –** A growing organisation where strong ops talent gets noticed and moved up

description:

Magnit is the future of work. Serving hundreds of the world’s most recognizable brands for the past 30\+ years, Magnit offers the industry’s first holistic platform for the modern workforce. Magnit's integrated workforce management (IWM) platform supported by data, software, intelligence, and best\-in\-class services team is key to our clients’ success. We are looking for a proactive and strategic HR Business Partner to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate with wide experience in HR partnering roles, demonstrating excellence in stakeholder management, employee relations, end\-to\-end employment lifecycle operations, strategic workforce support, and HR data\-driven decision\-making. This role will be a critical enabler in driving people priorities, improving employee engagement, and supporting business objectives through analytical insights.

Strategic HR Partnership

eSentire is on a mission to hunt, investigate and stop cyber threats before they become business disrupting events. We were founded on the premise that if you can't find a solution, you build it. And today, that means pioneering the future of AI\-powered security. At eSentire, we're building a cutting\-edge AI Security Operations Platform that will amplify human expertise, not replace it, creating a workplace where innovation meets impact.

As the authority in Managed Detection and Response, we protect the critical data and applications of 2000\+ organizations in 80\+ countries, across 35 industries—and we're looking for forward\-thinking talent to help us define what AI\-first security, human\-backed trust means for the industry.
  
  

**The Opportunity:**  

The successful candidate will be part of a growing team of skilled technical professionals, providing tier\-1 support services. The candidate will be responsible for providing front\-line support for eSentire's MDR (Managed Detection and Response) offerings to our clients, ensuring the related products and services remain in a healthy operational state throughout the customer's partnership with eSentire. The candidate will work cross\-functionally to escalate any issues to the appropriate teams when necessary.
  
  

This role will report to the Manager, Support Center within our Support Operations organization.
  
  

**Who You Are:**  

You are a detail\-oriented technical professional with a positive attitude and excellent customer communication skills, both verbal and written. You have an analytical approach to problem\-solving in the most efficient manner and can provide technical support to clients of all levels. You are open to finding innovative solutions that meet both the customer's needs and those of our business.
  
  

**What You Are Great At:**  

You are a proactive self\-starter who is comfortable interacting with stakeholders at various levels of the organization, both internal and external, and can take ownership of ensuring all work is completed thoroughly and accurately. You excel at communicating complex technical language and concepts with end customers of all levels. The successful candidate will demonstrate experience with networking concepts, Linux operating systems, command line operations, and application support.
  
  

**Responsibilities:**  

* Handling customer enquiries and internal cases in our case management system, communicating directly with clients.
* Providing First Contact Resolution Phone Support. Handling inbound enquiries and resolving customer cases while on the phone as well as performing outbound escalations.
* Support a range of eSentire MDR offerings including but not limited to Endpoint, Network, Cloud, and API products/services.

* Identifying the underlying problem by analyzing the information/data related to the symptoms
* Documenting all troubleshooting steps and related results within our case and knowledge management systems
* Escalating issues that require Tier\-2 support to the appropriate teams as necessary
* Liaising with vendor support teams
* Field inquiries from a variety of internal teams.
* Utilize and maintain knowledge and process articles.


**Skills and Qualifications:**  

* 2\+ years of Information Technology experience in a Technical Customer Support role.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent hands\-on experience.
* A passion for delivering exceptional customer service and a proven track record of resolving technical issues.
* Good analytical and problem\-solving skills with a focus on root cause analysis.
* Exposure to and experience with the following:
* Computer software and hardware support experience, including desktop computers, servers, laptops, network devices, and peripherals.
* Experience with Service Management / IT Helpdesk ticketing and case management systems.
* Enterprise application support technologies.
* Solid understanding of networking fundamentals; LAN, WAN, TCP/IP, Routers, Switches, Firewalls, SD\-WAN, Traffic Mirroring.
* Linux command line operation experience (basic).
* Demonstrated attention to detail and a continuous improvement mindset.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment and manage multiple priorities.


**Nice to have:****Exposure to and experience with the following:**  

* Support of Endpoint security solutions such as Microsoft Defender, CrowdStrike, Carbon Black, and/or SentinelOne.
* Enterprise software distribution tools such as SCCM, Endpoint Manager, Intune, GPO and others.
* IT Monitoring/Observability tools.
* Basic awareness of APIs and web\-based technologies.


Our Culture and Values
  
We celebrate diversity, operating with mutual respect and consideration, in an environment that fosters inclusivity for all. We believe that a variety of perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences make us stronger – if you’re enthusiastic about this opportunity but don’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. It takes a diverse set of thoughts, cultures, backgrounds, and perspectives to be a true market leader.

If you have any accessibility requirements during the recruitment process, please reach out to our HR team at talentacquisition@esentire.com and any accommodation needs will be addressed upon request. title: Quality Assurance Engineer (Payroll & Benefits)
description:
**Your payroll expertise is the product.**



Most QA roles ask you to test what someone built. This one asks you to know payroll and benefits well enough to predict how it will break before the code exists.



PrismHR is the HR, payroll, and benefits platform behind PEOs and ASOs across the United States, backed by Vensure Employer Solutions. Payroll is unforgiving — one mishandled deduction or multi\-state tax scenario and a real person's paycheck is wrong.



You will design and run test scenarios based on how people actually use the product, build realistic test data, own test strategy and risk on your projects, and report status clearly enough for release decisions. You will also raise the domain fluency of the whole QA team — which makes you unusually influential here.


**You will need:**


* 3\+ years of hands\-on PEO, payroll, or benefits administration experience (a real requirement, not a preference)
* Solid QA practice: test case design, defect reporting, Agile testing
* Strong troubleshooting and root\-cause instincts
* Clear written and verbal communication
* Degree or equivalent experience

  


**Nice to have:** automation exposure, multi\-state US payroll tax, open enrollment, HRIS or HCM platforms.


**The schedule:** 6:00 PM – 3:00 AM IST, Monday to Friday. First four hours from our Noida office, the rest from home. Mornings and afternoons are yours.


**Why this role:** QA here sits upstream — you are in requirements and design while decisions are still open. Clear paths into Senior QA, automation, or QA leadership.



Competitive compensation, health coverage, learning support. Apply now.

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced recruitment professional who is more than just a recruiter—someone who thinks like an entrepreneur and is ready to become a **Partner / Working Partner** in building a successful recruitment business.

The ideal candidate will take ownership of recruitment operations while contributing to business development, client acquisition, strategic planning, and overall company growth.

ETS is a global education and talent solutions organization enabling lifelong learners worldwide to be future\-ready. For more than 75 years, we've been advancing the science of measurement to build benchmarks for fair and valid skill assessment across cultures and borders. Our worldwide impact extends through our renowned assessments including TOEFL®, TOEIC®, GRE® and Praxis® tests, serving millions of learners in more than 200 countries and territories.
