title: Branch Services
description:
At Franklin Templeton, we’re driving our industry forward by developing new and innovative ways to help our clients achieve their investment goals. Our dynamic and diversified firm spans asset management, wealth management, and fintech, offering many ways to help investors make progress toward their goals. Our talented teams working around the globe bring expertise that’s both broad and unique. From our welcoming, inclusive, and flexible culture to our global and diverse business, we offer opportunities not only to help you reach your potential but also to contribute to our clients’ achievements.

**Come join us in delivering better outcomes for our clients around the world!**

***About the GSS\-India:***

* Our GSS India team delivers a wide range of shared services and operational support functions to business units and stakeholders across the organization. We manage critical processes, ensure adherence to policies and processes, support process improvements and standardization initiatives, and provide timely resolution of customer queries. The team collaborates closely with internal and external stakeholders to enhance service quality, drive efficiency, and support business objectives through continuous improvement and digital transformation initiatives. Joining us offers broad exposure to global operations, cross\-functional collaboration, process excellence, and opportunities to develop expertise in shared services, stakeholder management, and business process optimization.

***What is the role of Branch Service?***
=========================================


Effective management of calls, walk\-ins, letters and email queries. Handle critical relationships by providing exceptional service support. Liaison with CAMS for enabling seamless service delivery to our clients.

* Effective management of operational activities of branch.

***What are the ongoing responsibilities of Customer Service?***
================================================================

* Meet the critical distributors on predefined frequency, foster relationships, and deliver exemplary service experience to our distributors.
* Effective Tracking of all the queries and ensure thorough NIGO checks,
* Effective use of data, MIS by adding value by creating talking points during all scheduled interactions with the distributors.
* Answers queries including but not limited to processing of transactions, processes, regulatory \& compliance guidelines from distributors, financial advisors, and other interested parties either from an incoming call or an outgoing returned call.
* Keeps abreast of current market conditions, fund and company policies, investment and tax law changes, compliance requirements, and all other procedural information in a constantly changing environment.
* Adheres to all legal requirements (compliance rules) while servicing distributors.
* Maintain effective channels of communication with all CAMS/KARVY POS for effective delivery of services to our distributors.
* Share monthly statistics with distributors on error trends at their level (Monthly Distributor Service Level Report)
* Preparation of monthly MIS to error trends and measure improvement
* Be flexible for switching job profile within the team.
* Should be a good team player.
* Build a good rapport with the stakeholders.
* Need to take care of operational activities of the branch.

***What ideal qualifications, skills \& experience would help someone to be successful?***
==========================================================================================

* Preferred MBA or any graduate degree. Preferably from a commerce / accounting / finance background. Proficient in English, numerate.
* Fresher or 1\-2 years of relevant experience in the financial services industry and mutual funds in specific.
* Good writing and verbal communication skills
* Good presentation skills
* Capacity to handle high volume of activity in fast\-paced environment.
* Strong interpersonal skills; interact effectively with all levels including senior management
* Ability to work collaboratively within teams to achieve results and also adept at working independently with moderate supervision.

**Work Shift Timings \- 9:00 AM \- 6:00 PM IST**

**Experience our welcoming culture and reach your professional and personal potential!**

**About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**

  

**Blue Dart Express Limited**, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.


Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.


We are proud to be consistently ranked among **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work**, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an **Employer of Choice** is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.


If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, **Blue Dart is where you belong**. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.


**Position Overview:**

  


The **Territory Service Representative (TSR) – Operations** is responsible for the timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within an assigned territory while delivering a superior customer experience and representing the Blue Dart brand with professionalism.


Operating as the face of Blue Dart on the ground, the role ensures safe handling of shipments, timely collections and deliveries, accurate shipment scanning, COD collections, proof of delivery (POD) compliance and adherence to operational procedures. The TSR works closely with the Shift In\-charge and branch operations team to ensure service commitments are consistently achieved while maintaining the highest standards of safety, customer service and operational discipline.

**Job Purpose:**

  


To execute timely pickup and delivery of shipments, ensure accurate shipment handling, customer interactions and COD collections while adhering to Blue Dart's operational standards, safety requirements and service commitments.

**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**

  

**Pickup \& Delivery Operations**

* Perform timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within the assigned route or territory.
* Ensure all shipments are delivered within committed service timelines.
* Verify shipment details before pickup and delivery.
* Handle shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.
* Maintain delivery productivity and route efficiency.

**Customer Service Excellence**

* Serve as the face of Blue Dart during every customer interaction.
* Maintain courteous, professional and customer\-centric behaviour at all times.
* Resolve basic customer queries during pickups and deliveries.
* Escalate customer concerns or operational exceptions promptly.
* Maintain high standards of grooming, behaviour and professionalism.

**COD \& Documentation Management**

* Collect Cash on Delivery (COD) payments wherever applicable.
* Ensure accurate cash handling and timely remittance as per company procedures.
* Obtain Proof of Delivery (POD), customer acknowledgements and required shipment documentation.
* Ensure documentation accuracy and compliance with operational procedures.
* Report discrepancies immediately.

**Operational Compliance**

* Scan shipments accurately using handheld devices or approved digital platforms.
* Ensure shipment status updates are completed in real time.
* Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) during pickup and delivery activities.
* Adhere to company policies relating to shipment handling, documentation and customer interaction.
* Support operational requirements during peak business periods.

**Safety \& Security**

* Follow all road safety guidelines while operating company or personal vehicles.
* Ensure safe handling and security of customer shipments throughout transit.
* Wear the prescribed company uniform and personal protective equipment wherever applicable.
* Report accidents, incidents or unsafe conditions immediately.
* Protect company assets and customer property.

**Vehicle \& Asset Responsibility**

* Maintain the assigned vehicle or personal two\-wheeler in roadworthy condition.
* Ensure all statutory vehicle documents remain valid.
* Maintain cleanliness and basic upkeep of the vehicle.
* Report maintenance requirements promptly.

**Workplace Discipline \& Brand Representation**

* Maintain high standards of personal grooming, hygiene and professional appearance.
* Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.
* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.
* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.
* Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.

**Team Collaboration**

* Work closely with Shift In\-charges and branch operations teams.
* Support colleagues during operational contingencies.
* Participate in operational briefings and safety meetings.
* Contribute towards achieving branch productivity and service goals.

**Qualifications \& Experience:**

  

**Education**:

* Minimum **10th Standard Pass**.
* Higher educational qualifications will be an added advantage.

**Experience**:

* Fresher or up to **2 years** of relevant experience in courier, logistics, distribution, retail delivery or field operations.
* Experience in pickup and delivery operations will be an added advantage.

**Eligibility Requirements:**

* Minimum age **18 years.**
* Valid **Two\-Wheeler** or Four\-Wheeler Driving Licence.
* Must own a two\-wheeler where deployment requires the employee to use a personal vehicle, in accordance with Company policy.
* Physically fit to perform field operations.
* Willingness to work across shifts, weekends and holidays based on business requirements.

**Skills \& Capabilities:**

  

**Technical Skills:**

* Pickup \& Delivery Operations
* Shipment Handling
* Cash Collection (COD)
* Proof of Delivery (POD)
* Mobile Device / Scanner Usage
* Route Familiarity
* Basic Computer \& Mobile Application Skills
* Basic English Reading \& Understanding

**Key Competencies:**

* Customer Focus
* Integrity
* Reliability
* Safety Consciousness
* Teamwork
* Discipline
* Time Management
* Accountability
* Positive Attitude
* Professional Appearance

**Key Performance Indicators:**

  

**KRAs**

 **KPIs**

  

Delivery \& Pickup Performance

  

On\-Time Delivery • Pickup Adherence • Delivery Productivity

  

Service Quality

  

First Attempt Delivery • Shipment Handling Accuracy • Customer Satisfaction

COD Collection Accuracy • POD Completion • Zero Documentation Errors

  

Safety \& Compliance

  

Safe Driving • SOP Adherence • Uniform \& Grooming Compliance

  

Operational Productivity

  

Shipments Delivered/Picked Up • Scanner Compliance • Route Efficiency

  

**Why join DHL Blue Dart?**

  


When you join us, you’re not just taking a job—you’re becoming part of a purpose\-led movement that’s reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don’t just deliver parcels—we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day.


Here’s what makes us stand out:

* **Great Place to Work® Certified**—a testament to our people\-first culture, inclusive environment, and commitment to your growth and well\-being.
* **Competitive pay** and performance\-linked rewards that truly recognize your impact.
* Structured learning, **global exposure**, and on\-the\-job coaching to help you grow faster than ever.
* **Best\-in\-class benefits**—from comprehensive medical cover (including optional parental care) to financial wellness and generous time off.
* A culture that celebrates **diversity, innovation, and bold thinking**—where your voice is heard and your contributions matter.
* **Global career paths**across the DHL Group, opening doors to opportunities in 220\+ countries and territories.
* The pride of working with **India’s most awarded logistics brand**, trusted by millions and driven by purpose.


This is your chance to do meaningful work, build a career without borders, and thrive in a company that’s not just a logistics leader—but a Great Place to Work. **Come grow with us.**

title: Mediclaim /Insurance co ordinator
description:
**Job Title:** Mediclaim Insurance Coordinator

**Department:** TPA / Insurance

**Reports To:** Manager – Billing \& Insurance / Hospital Administrator

Job Summary

The Mediclaim Insurance Coordinator is responsible for managing all health insurance and TPA (Third Party Administrator) processes, including cashless approvals, reimbursement claims, pre\-authorizations, patient counseling, documentation, and coordination with insurance companies to ensure timely claim settlement and smooth patient discharge.

Key Responsibilities

* Verify patient insurance eligibility and policy coverage.
* Coordinate with TPAs and insurance companies for cashless admission approvals.
* Process pre\-authorization, enhancement requests, and final authorization.
* Collect, verify, and submit all required claim documents.
* Coordinate with doctors, nursing, medical records, billing, and accounts departments for claim\-related documentation.
* Track pending approvals and follow up with insurers/TPAs for timely responses.
* Handle reimbursement claim documentation and guide patients on submission procedures.
* Resolve insurance queries, claim rejections, deductions, and deficiencies.
* Ensure accurate billing as per insurer and TPA guidelines.
* Maintain insurance records, approval trackers, and daily MIS reports.
* Coordinate discharge clearance after insurance approval.
* Educate patients and attendants regarding policy coverage, exclusions, and payment liabilities.
* Ensure compliance with hospital policies, IRDAI guidelines, and insurer requirements.
* Maintain confidentiality of patient information and insurance records.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in any discipline (B.Com, BBA, B.Sc., Hospital Administration preferred).
* Certification in Hospital Administration or Medical Insurance is an added advantage.

Experience

* Fresher to 3 years of experience in hospital TPA/insurance coordination.
* Knowledge of cashless and reimbursement claim processes is preferred.

Skills Required

* Knowledge of health insurance and TPA procedures.
* Medical terminology and hospital billing knowledge.
* Strong documentation and record\-keeping skills.
* Excellent communication and patient counseling skills.
* Proficiency in MS Office and Hospital Information Systems (HIS).
* Good negotiation, coordination, and problem\-solving abilities.
* Attention to detail and ability to work under pressure.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Timely processing of pre\-authorizations and final claims.
* Reduction in claim rejections and deductions.
* Turnaround time (TAT) for insurance approvals.
* Accuracy of documentation.
* Patient satisfaction with insurance services.
* Timely discharge of insured patients.

Pay: ₹16,000\.00 \- ₹23,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Senior System Software Engineer
description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self\-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.
   

  

 We are now looking for an experienced software engineer with strong system software and VR/AR/graphics fundamentals with robust C\+\+ skills. This would involve contribution to the development of NVIDIA’s Virtual Reality components like VRWorks SDK \& windows drivers. It is a comprehensive suite of SDK APIs and driver framework that enables different Virtual Reality use cases.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
 You will work alongside forward\-thinking engineers to implement and optimize software in VRWorks SDK and windows drivers for headset developers and application developers as well as improve the existing features and framework architecture for different GPUs, CPUs and system OS platforms.
   

  

 We'll give you exposure to new chip platforms across different stages like emulation and bring\-up.
   

  

 Together we will connect with multiple teams in our company, as well as our partners and customers.
   

  

**What We Need To See**
* Solid understanding of 3D graphics HW and SW.
* Proficiency in C\+\+ programming and debugging.
* Knowledge of one or more graphics libraries (Direct3D, Vulkan, OpenGL)
* You have a knack for full stack development \- from implementing frameworks and interfaces to understanding the impact and consequences on the hardware.
* Passion for optimizing system performance, root causing bottlenecks and optimizing performance on GPU, CPU and memory.
* Strong knowledge of OS fundamentals – Windows \& Linux.
* Strong software engineering background and design fundamentals particularly related to creating robust system software.
* Strong communication and analytical skills. Self\-motivated, fast to act and eager to learn as well as guide.
* Bachelor/Master/PhD in Computer Science or Electronics or Electrical Engineering.
* 8\+ years of experience developing systems software on Windows/Linux/iOS.


**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**
* You have implemented one or more virtual reality applications. If you have used NVIDIA’s VRWorks features, it is a significant plus
* Experience in stereoscopic rendering algorithms for Head Mounted Displays
* You have experience working in graphics engines such as Unity or Unreal
* Experience with graphics hardware accelerated systems on PC or embedded systems.
* Experience of collaborating with geographically diverse multi\-functional teams.


 We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
   

  

 Widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. As you plan your future, see what we can offer to you and your family www.nvidiabenefits.com/

title: Firmware Engineer
description:
**Location** 
 : Gurugram, India
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a highly motivated
 **Firmware Engineer with experience in embedded systems and wearable devices** 
 to
   

  

 develop next\-generation smartwatches, smart rings, smart bands, and connected wearable products. The ideal candidate
   

  

 will be responsible for designing, developing, optimizing, and maintaining firmware across multiple wearable platforms
   

  

 while working closely with hardware, mobile app, cloud, algorithm, and product teams.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Design, develop, and maintain embedded firmware for wearable devices based on RTOS platforms.
* Implement and optimize drivers, middleware, and application\-layer firmware for sensors, connectivity, power


 management, and user interfaces.
   

  

* Develop firmware for health monitoring features including heart rate, SpO₂, sleep tracking, activity tracking, and workout


 modes.
   

  

* Integrate and optimize communication protocols such as BLE, UART, SPI, I2C, GPIO, PWM, and ADC.
* Work with sensor vendors and chipset partners to integrate PPG, IMU, temperature, ECG, and other wearable sensors.
* Optimize power consumption, memory usage, and overall system performance to achieve battery life targets.
* Support firmware bring\-up, debugging, validation, and production readiness activities.
* Collaborate with hardware teams during board bring\-up, schematic reviews, and hardware debugging.
* Analyze field issues, identify root causes, and implement robust fixes.
* Participate in architecture discussions and contribute to firmware design reviews.
* Develop test tools, automation scripts, and diagnostic utilities to improve development efficiency.
* Support OTA (Over\-the\-Air) firmware upgrade mechanisms and firmware release management.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor\&/or Masters degree in Electronics, Embedded Systems, Computer Engineering, or related field.
* 4–8 years of experience in embedded firmware development.
* Strong proficiency in C programming and embedded software design.
* Experience working with RTOS\-based systems (FreeRTOS, RT\-Thread, Zephyr, ThreadX, or similar).
* Strong understanding of microcontroller architectures (ARM Cortex\-M preferred).
* Experience with communication interfaces: BLE, UART, SPI, I2C, GPIO, PWM
* Experience with debugging tools such as JTAG, SWD, Logic Analyzer, Oscilloscope, and Protocol Analyzers.
* Good understanding of low\-power embedded system design.
* Familiarity with Git and software development lifecycle practices.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience developing firmware for smartwatches, smart bands, smart rings, TWS, or IoT products.
* Experience with Nordic, Realtek, SiFli, Ambiq, Dialog, Telink, or similar wearable chipsets.
* Experience integrating health and fitness sensors.
* Knowledge of BLE profiles and wearable communication architectures.
* Understanding of bootloaders, OTA update mechanisms, and secure firmware development.
* Familiarity with LVGL or embedded UI frameworks.
* Experience working with manufacturing test firmware and factory tools.
* Basic understanding of signal processing and wearable algorithms.


**Desired Skills**
* Strong debugging and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Ability to work independently and drive feature ownership.
* Excellent collaboration and communication skills.
* Ability to balance performance, memory, and power constraints.
* Product\-oriented mindset with focus on user experience and reliability.


**Nice to Have**
* Experience with smartwatch watchface engines and graphics rendering.
* Experience integrating AI or voice\-assistant features on embedded devices.
* Knowledge of sensor fusion, motion processing, or health\-monitoring algorithms.
* Experience working with cloud\-connected wearable ecosystems.
* Experience: 4–8 Years

title: JUNIOR CAD ENGINEER
description:
DEPARTMENT Engineering / R\&D LOCATION Verna, Goa, India REPORTS TO Engineering Manager EMPLOYMENT TYPE Full\-time EXPERIENCE 0–4 years VACANCY 1 position WORK MODE In person ROLE FOCUS CAD, rapid modelling and prototyping QUALIFICATION BE / B.Tech / ME / M.Tech in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Industrial Design or a related discipline
   

  

**Job Summary**
 Enigmasoft Technologies is seeking a Junior CAD Engineer to support rapid design development, mechanical modelling and prototype fabrication within its Research \& Development engineering team.
   

  

 The selected candidate will create and revise 3D parts and assemblies, prepare manufacturing drawings and bills of materials, and convert engineering concepts into practical components for prototyping and testing. The role will support multidisciplinary projects in renewable energy, clean technology and advanced engineering, including solar photovoltaic systems, Organic Rankine Cycle systems and carbon\-capture technologies.
   

  

 This position is suited to a technically curious engineer who enjoys hands\-on problem\-solving, iterative design and working closely with engineers, technicians and fabrication vendors to improve designs through testing and real\-world feedback.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 CAD Modelling and Assembly Design
   

  

* Create, modify and optimise accurate 3D CAD models of mechanical parts, assemblies, fixtures and prototype systems.
* Translate sketches, engineering concepts, dimensions and functional requirements into structured CAD models.
* Develop parametric models that can be updated efficiently during rapid design iterations.
* Build and review assemblies for fit, alignment, interference, accessibility and basic serviceability.
* Support senior engineers in converting early\-stage concepts into practical and manufacturable components.


 Drawings, BOMs and Manufacturing Documentation
   

  

* Prepare clear 2D part drawings and assembly drawings with dimensions, tolerances, material specifications and manufacturing notes.
* Create and maintain basic bills of materials (BOMs), part lists and component identification records.
* Apply appropriate drawing standards, units, revision details and document\-control practices.
* Update drawings and supporting documentation whenever a design is revised following review, fabrication or testing.


 Rapid Prototyping and Fabrication Support
   

  

* Prepare CAD files for 3D printing, CNC machining, laser cutting, sheet\-metal fabrication, moulding and other prototype\-manufacturing processes.
* Review model orientation, wall thickness, clearances, tolerances and other design\-for\-manufacturing considerations before releasing files.
* Coordinate with internal fabrication personnel and external vendors to clarify drawings, dimensions, materials and manufacturing requirements.
* Inspect fabricated parts for basic dimensional accuracy, fitment and conformity with approved drawings.
* Assist in resolving fitment, assembly or manufacturability issues identified during fabrication and prototype build activities.


 Design Iteration, Testing and Review
   

  

* Incorporate feedback from testing, design reviews, prototype assembly and field observations into updated CAD models.
* Participate in design reviews and clearly present model changes, constraints, assumptions and open issues.
* Support prototype assembly and testing to understand how design decisions perform under practical conditions.
* Document design changes, iteration history, lessons learned and pending improvements.


 CAD Data Management and Coordination
   

  

* Maintain organised CAD libraries, folder structures, file\-naming conventions and revision histories.
* Ensure released files are clearly identified and prevent outdated models or drawings from being used for fabrication.
* Coordinate with mechanical, electronics, testing and procurement teams to obtain the information required for model development.
* Manage multiple modelling and drawing tasks while meeting agreed priorities and timelines.
* Perform other related engineering and prototype\-development duties as assigned.


**Qualifications And Experience**
* BE / B.Tech / ME / M.Tech in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Industrial Design or a closely related discipline.
* Zero to four years of experience in mechanical design, CAD modelling, product development, rapid prototyping or a related engineering role.
* Fresh graduates with strong CAD fundamentals, relevant academic projects, internships, competition experience or a practical portfolio are encouraged to apply.
* A portfolio or examples of CAD models, drawings, fabricated prototypes, hobby projects or personal engineering work will be an advantage.


 Key Skills and Competencies
   

  

* Strong proficiency in 3D CAD modelling, parametric design and assembly development.
* Hands\-on experience with Fusion 360 is preferred; SolidWorks or an equivalent professional CAD platform is also acceptable.
* Good understanding of mechanical fundamentals, engineering dimensions, fits, clearances and tolerances.
* Ability to create detailed part drawings and basic manufacturing\-ready documentation.
* Familiarity with rapid\-prototyping processes such as 3D printing, CNC machining, laser cutting, sheet\-metal fabrication or moulding.
* Awareness of basic design\-for\-manufacturing and design\-for\-assembly principles.
* Strong attention to detail, structured file management and revision\-control discipline.
* Ability to work independently, accept technical feedback and manage multiple design iterations under tight timelines.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office or equivalent engineering documentation tools.
* Clear communication and coordination with engineers, technicians and fabrication vendors.


 Technical Aptitude and Candidate Profile
   

  

 The ideal candidate should demonstrate a genuine interest in engineering, testing, fabrication and problem\-solving. The role is highly practical and requires a willingness to learn from prototype failures, manufacturing constraints and repeated testing cycles.
   

  

* Strong foundational understanding of mechanics, materials, manufacturing processes and engineering physics relevant to mechanical design.
* Ability to apply theoretical knowledge to real\-world design, fitment and prototype\-development challenges.
* Practical hobbies, technical interests, engineering competitions, personal builds or experimentation experience will be preferred.
* Curiosity to understand how components are manufactured, assembled, tested and improved.
* A proactive, detail\-oriented and self\-motivated approach to work.
* Adaptability and resilience in a fast\-moving R\&D environment where requirements may evolve during testing.
* Collaborative mindset and willingness to contribute beyond narrowly defined modelling tasks when required.


**ROLE CLARIFICATION** 
 This is a junior engineering role with a strong focus on hands\-on CAD development and prototype support. Candidates are not expected to independently own complex engineering systems from the first day, but they should demonstrate sound fundamentals, curiosity, discipline and the ability to develop rapidly under technical guidance.
   

  

**About Enigmasoft Technologies**
 Enigmasoft Technologies is a rapidly expanding, R\&D\-driven company specialising in advanced IT and engineering solutions. We develop hardware and software technologies across clean energy, advanced manufacturing and digital systems, with a strong focus on early\-stage innovation, rapid prototyping and technology commercialisation.
   

  

 Our engineering work includes renewable\-energy and climate\-technology products such as solar photovoltaic systems, Organic Rankine Cycle systems and carbon\-capture solutions. By combining mechanical engineering, electronics, software and applied research, we develop technologies that bridge laboratory concepts and real\-world deployment.
   

  

**Additional Candidate Requirements**
 Candidates applying for this role must demonstrate a genuine passion for engineering, testing, and problem\-solving.
   

  

 Preference will be given to individuals who possess practical hobby skills, hands\-on technical interests, or personal projects related to engineering, innovation, and experimentation.
   

  

 As this position is within Research \& Development (R\&D) Engineering, candidates should be comfortable working in a highly practical, testing\-driven environment that requires analytical thinking and continuous experimentation.
   

  

 Applicants must also have a strong foundational understanding of physics relevant to their area of expertise, whether in electronics, mechanical systems, fluid dynamics, or related engineering disciplines. A problem\-solving mindset and the ability to apply theoretical knowledge to real\-world testing and development are essential for this role.
   

  

**Why Join Team Enigma**
* Gain hands\-on exposure to real engineering challenges, rapid innovation cycles and multidisciplinary R\&D projects.
* Work directly on CAD models and prototypes that progress from concept through fabrication, testing and improvement.
* Develop technical depth across design, manufacturing, materials, testing and product\-development processes.
* Take ownership, learn from experienced engineers and contribute beyond conventional role boundaries.
* Build practical experience in clean\-energy and climate\-technology development.

**Quality Control (QC) Trainee** 

**Company Overview:**

**Pratiroop Mudran** is a leading name in the printing and packaging industry. We pride ourselves on delivering high\-quality, precision\-driven packaging solutions to our clients. To maintain our strict standards of excellence, we are looking for a detail\-oriented and motivated **QC Trainee** to join our growing quality assurance team.

**Position Summary**

As a QC Trainee, you will be trained to monitor, test, and inspect our printing and packaging processes. You will ensure that all raw materials, in\-process production, and finished goods meet our company's high\-quality standards and client specifications.

* **Role:** QC Trainee
* **Industry:** Printing \& Packaging
* **Experience:** Freshers are welcome / 0 to 1 Year of experience in a QC department
* **Education:** B.Sc. / M.Sc. (Chemistry/) OR Diploma in Printing Technology / Packaging
* **Salary:** ₹15,000 to ₹20,000 per month (Negotiable based on interview performance)

**Key Responsibilities**

* **In\-Process Inspection:** Conduct regular quality checks during the printing, cutting, and packaging stages to identify defects early.
* **Raw Material Verification:** Inspect incoming raw materials (paper, paperboard, inks, adhesives) against standard specifications.
* **Final Product Testing:** Ensure the final packed products meet standard dimensions, color matching, and structural integrity.
* **Defect Reporting:** Identify deviations, log defects, and report them immediately to the senior QC Executive or Production Manager.
* **Documentation:** Maintain neat and accurate daily quality inspection reports and logs.
* **Lab Testing:** Assist in basic laboratory testing (e.g., GSM checking, moisture testing, GSM/bursting strength, shade matching).

**Required Skills \& Competencies**

* **Basic Technical Knowledge:** Familiarity with printing processes and packaging materials is a huge plus.
* **Eye for Detail:** Strong visual inspection skills to spot color variations, misregistrations, or printing flaws.
* **Color Perception:** Excellent color vision (ability to pass standard color\-blindness tests is essential for shade matching).
* **Mathematical Skills:** Ability to take accurate measurements using tools like micrometers, vernier calipers, and GSM scales.
* **Communication:** Good verbal and written communication skills for internal reporting.
* **Tech Savvy:** Basic knowledge of MS Office (Excel and Word) for data entry.

**What We Offer**

* Hands\-on training from industry experts in printing and packaging quality standards.
* A supportive and growth\-oriented work environment.
* Clear career progression from Trainee to QC Executive.

title: Scrum Master
description:
Join us as Scrum Master at Barclays, where you will spearhead the evolution of our infrastructure and deployment pipelines, driving innovation and operational excellence. You will harness cutting\-edge technology to build and manage robust, scalable and secure infrastructure, ensuring seamless delivery of our digital solutions.
   

  

 To be successful as a Scrum Master, you should have experience with:
   

  

  

* Agile Delivery \& Ceremonies.
* Facilitate and time‑box all Scrum ceremonies: Sprint Planning, Daily Stand‑ups, Backlog Refinement, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives.
* Ensure ceremonies are value‑driven, outcome‑focused, and aligned to MCP ways of working.
* Support teams in defining Sprint Goals, managing commitments, and avoiding spill‑overs.
* Ensure user stories have clear acceptance criteria, are estimated with team consent, and follow Agile best practices.
* Coach teams on Agile and Scrum principles, fostering ownership, accountability, and self‑organisation.
* Create a psychologically safe environment that enables honest reflection and continuous improvement.
* Identify and remove impediments and blockers to maintain delivery momentum.
* Promote strong Agile hygiene including Jira updates, correct status/labels, and transparent reporting.
* Act as a bridge between delivery teams and Product Owners, Tech Leads, Architects, Release/Integration teams, and other Scrum Masters.
* Proactively manage cross‑team dependencies, risks, and delivery constraints.
* Represent the team in MCP forums (e.g. design reviews, sprint demos, governance touchpoints).
* Escalate risks and issues with clear context and data‑backed insights.
* Track and report delivery health using Agile metrics (e.g. sprint predictability, carry‑over, team capacity).
* Support compliance with Barclays governance, risk, and control expectations.
* Ensure transparency on delivery progress, risks, and outcomes.
* Contribute to Quarterly / PI objectives and Scrum Master OKRs for MCP teams.


**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**
* Proven experience as a Scrum Master in complex technology delivery environments.
* Strong understanding of Scrum, Agile, and Lean principles.
* Scrum certification (CSM, PSM, SAFe SSM).
* SAFe or large‑scale Agile exposure.
* Experience working with cross‑functional engineering teams (Dev, QA, Architecture).
* Hands‑on experience with Jira / Agile tooling.
* Strong facilitation, coaching, and conflict‑resolution skills.
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders across business and technology.


 You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.
   

  

 The role is based out of Pune.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 Facilitates and supports Agile teams by ensuring they follow Scrum principles. To remove obstacles, enhance team collaboration, and ensure smooth communication, enabling the team to focus on delivering high\-quality, iterative results. Facilitate Scrum events, promote continuous improvement, and act as a bridge between the team and external stakeholders.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Facilitate Events: Facilitate events, as needed, and ensure that all events take place and are positive, productive, and kept within the timebox
* Support Iteration Execution: Ensure quality of ceremony artefacts and continuous customer value through iteration execution, maintain backlog refinement, and iterate on stakeholder feedback
* Optimize Flow: Identify and facilitate the removal of conflict impacting team flow, utilizing metrics to empower the team to communicate effectively, making all work visible
* Mitigate Risks: Identify and escalate risks to remove impediments and shield the Squad from interruptions
* Build High\-Performing Teams: Foster and coach Agile Team attributes and continuous improvement, encourage stakeholder collaboration, deputise ‘in the moment leadership’, and drive high\-performing team attributes
* Stakeholder Management: Facilitate stakeholder collaboration (e.g., business stakeholders, product teams, vendors) and build trust with stakeholders
* Governance and Reporting: Ensure data quality and provide representation at required governance forums, if applicable


**Assistant Vice President Expectations**
 To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
   

  

 Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
   

  

 If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
   

  

 OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
   

  

 Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
   

  

 Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
   

  

 Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
   

  

 Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
   

  

 Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
   

  

 Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
   

  

 Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
   

  

 Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.
   

  

 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
**About Creative Studio 24**

Creative Studio 24 is a growing digital design and development agency working with clients across multiple industries. We specialize in creating clean, user\-friendly, and impactful digital experiences. We are looking for a passionate and creative **UI/UX Designer** to join our team and contribute to real client projects while collaborating with designers and developers.

**Role Overview**

As a UI/UX Designer, you will be responsible for designing intuitive, visually appealing, and user\-centric digital experiences for websites and web applications. You will work closely with the design and development teams to create functional, engaging, and consistent user interfaces that align with business goals and user needs.

* Design user\-friendly interfaces for websites and web applications.

* Stay updated with the latest UI/UX trends, tools, and design practices.

* Strong understanding of UI/UX design principles, typography, color theory, spacing, and responsive design.
* Ability to create wireframes, prototypes, and high\-fidelity UI designs.
* Good problem\-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills.
* Portfolio showcasing UI/UX design projects.
* Bachelor's degree or relevant certification in UI/UX Design, Graphic Design, or a related field is preferred.
* Experience of 0–2 years is welcome. Freshers with strong portfolios are encouraged to apply.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to work on diverse and real client projects.
* Collaborative and creative work environment.
* Continuous learning and professional development.
* Exposure to modern UI/UX workflows and industry\-standard tools.
* Career growth opportunities within the company.
* Performance\-based appraisals and incentives.
* Supportive mentorship and team collaboration.

**Who Should Apply**

* UI/UX Designers looking to build their careers in a creative agency.
* Freshers with a strong portfolio and practical UI/UX skills.
* Candidates passionate about designing exceptional digital experiences.
* Individuals who enjoy solving user problems through thoughtful design.

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule
* Internet reimbursement
* Leave encashment

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
**Job Title: UI/UX Designer (GenAI \& Prototyping)** 




**Experience:** 
 1–2 Years
 



**Reporting to:** 
 Head of Design
 



**Location:** 
 Bengaluru On\-site
 



  





**About Us** 




  





 Signzy is a digital trust system. We provide identification, background checks, forgery detection
 



 and contract management systems which enable contracting in a trustable, safe, legal, and
 



 convenient manner. Our biometric user authentication system and blockchain\-based digital trail
 



 ensure non\-repudiation. This increases compliance and enforceability in the court of law. We
 



 consist of a tech\-savvy team and are backed by investors who are enthusiastic about creating
 



 solutions with technology.
 



  





 We believe the future of design is augmented by AI. We are looking for an ambitious, resourceful UI/UX Designer who isn't just comfortable in Figma, but knows how to leverage Generative AI to push designs into functional front\-end prototypes and no\-code environments at lightning speed.
 



  





**The Role** 




  





 You will sit at the exciting intersection of design, business and AI\-assisted development. Reporting directly to the Head of Design, you will be a core player in our project teams, working closely with Project Managers, Business Analysts and Sales to face clients, understand their needs and deliver exceptional interfaces.
 



  





 Whether you are adapting a strict enterprise design system or conceptualizing a fresh UI for an internal product, you will apply a strong UX mindset to everything you touch. You won’t just hand over static screens—you will use GenAI tools to generate working HTML/CSS/JS and bridge the gap to no\-code platforms.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Design \& UX Problem Solving** 



* Design intuitive, high\-quality user interfaces for client projects and internal products.
* Adapt to and build upon existing client Design Systems, ensuring brand consistency while applying a strong UX mindset to improve user flows.
* Translate complex business requirements (gathered alongside project BAs) into elegant, user\-centric wireframes, user journeys and high\-fidelity mockups.



**GenAI \& Rapid Prototyping** 



* Utilize Generative AI tools (e.g., Gemini, ChatGPT, Claude, v0, etc.) to generate, iterate and troubleshoot foundational HTML, CSS and JavaScript.
* Transform static designs into working, interactive prototypes using GenAI and modern design\-to\-code pipelines.
* Ensure generated code or components can be easily copied/adapted into in\-house no\-code environments.



**Client\-Facing \& Collaboration** 



* Partner with Project Teams to act as the design voice in client meetings.
* Confidently present your work on client calls, actively defending your design decisions with UX principles and data, while remaining receptive to feedback.
* Report to and collaborate with the Head of Design to maintain a high bar for quality, consistency and innovation across all outputs.
* Pivot seamlessly between external client projects and internal product design sprints.



  





**What You Bring (Requirements)** 




  




* **1–2 years of hands\-on experience** 
 in UI/UX design, preferably in a startup, agency or fast\-paced tech environment.
* **A strong portfolio** 
 demonstrating a solid grasp of UX principles, UI aesthetics and experience working with design systems.
* **AI Resourcefulness:** 
 You don't need to be a software engineer, but you must have proven experience prompting GenAI tools to output and debug HTML, CSS and basic JS.
* **Client Empathy \& Backbone:** 
 The ability to communicate clearly, empathize with client needs and tactfully defend your design choices against pushback.
* **Tool Mastery:** 
 Deep expertise in Figma, coupled with a working knowledge of AI design/dev assistants and no\-code builders.
* **Agility:** 
 A "get\-it\-done" startup mentality. You are comfortable dealing with ambiguity and shifting priorities.



  





**Why Join Us?** 




  




* **Mentorship \& Growth:** 
 Direct reporting line to the Head of Design, offering fast\-tracked learning and career progression.
* **Cutting\-Edge Stack:** 
 You will be encouraged to experiment with the latest AI tools and workflows—if there’s a faster, smarter way to build, we want you to use it.
* **Impact:** 
 Your work will directly touch high\-profile client projects and shape the trajectory of our internal products.

**About The Role**
 The Technical Content Writer covers a specific lane: clinical and condition\-specific writing. While the Content \& Brand Lead owns voice and editorial strategy, you produce the depth — illness guides, recovery checklists, condition explainers, caregiver training material, internal SOP documents. Your work has to be medically accurate enough to pass a nurse’s review and emotionally clear enough that a non\-clinical family member reading at 11 PM can act on it. Most healthcare content fails one or the other. Doing both well is the entire job. Two\-thirds of your output is family\-facing (long guides, condition pages, post\-discharge checklists). One\-third is internal (training manuals, caregiver SOPs, supervisor scripts).
   

  

 What you'll do
   

  

 Your day\-to\-day responsibilities
   

  

* Write 2 long\-form clinical guides per month (1,500–2,500 words each).
* Refresh and expand existing service detail pages quarterly.
* Produce condition\-specific content (stroke recovery, Parkinson’s home care, post\-op cardiac, etc.).
* Build downloadable checklists and PDFs for families.
* Maintain caregiver training manuals and supervisor scripts.
* Coordinate clinical review with the consulting nurse on every clinical piece.
* Use primary sources (PubMed, WHO, ICMR) — cite responsibly.
* Maintain a glossary of caregiving terms for SEO and AEO surfaces.
* Internal docs — SOPs for Care Managers, escalation cards for placements.
* Collaborate with Content \& Brand on long\-form journal pieces.
* Maintain the version history of clinical content (every claim dated and reviewed).
* Localise key content into Kannada and Tamil with translation partners.


 What we're looking for
   

  

**Skills And Experience Required**
* 2\+ years technical or healthcare content writing experience.
* Portfolio of clinical/medical writing for a lay audience.
* Ability to read and translate primary research into plain English.
* Strong editing instinct — you’ll edit your own work daily.
* Comfort with Markdown, version control (Git), or similar workflows.
* Familiarity with SEO principles (you’ll write H2\-friendly, scan\-friendly copy).


 Nice to have
   

  

 Bonus points if you have these
   

  

* Nursing or allied\-health degree (BSc Nursing, B Pharm, BPT).
* Prior experience at Practo, Lybrate, mfine, Cleartrip Health, or similar.
* Comfort writing in Indian English while avoiding jargon.
* Experience writing for AI search / AEO (TL;DR blocks, FAQ schema).
* Kannada or Tamil writing ability.


 Shift
   

  

* Daytime — flexible, results\-based. Hybrid (2 office days, 3 remote). Weekends off.


**Compensation \& Benefits**
* ₹45,000–₹80,000 / month.
* Conference \+ book budget ₹35,000/year.
* Stock options (cliff after 1 year).
* Group medical insurance (family floater).
* Annual leave (22 days).
* Festival bonus.
* Modern hardware (laptop \+ display).


 Career path
   

  

* Year 1
* Technical Content Writer — steady, clinically\-reviewed long\-form output.
* Year 1–2
* Senior Technical Writer (₹80k–1\.2L/month).
* Year 2\+
* Editor / Head of Clinical Content.

title: Mobile Application Developer
description:
**About BJAK** 




 The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.
 



  





 Started in 2019, we built the first mobile\-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.
 



  





 Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.
 



  





 We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next\-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.
 



  





 If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
 



  





**The Role** 




 We are looking for Android engineers to build the native Android experience for BJAK's AI Neobank App.
 



  





 This role is for someone who cares about clean user flows, fast performance, product quality and shipping reliable mobile features used by real customers.
 



  





**What You'll Own** 



* Build and ship Android features using Kotlin.
* Create clean mobile flows for insurance, payments, claims, renewals and financial services.
* Work with product and design to simplify complex user journeys.
* Integrate backend APIs and ensure mobile flows are stable, secure and reliable.
* Improve app performance, crash rate, loading states, responsiveness and memory usage.
* Use analytics, user behaviour and production issues to improve the product.
* Build AI\-assisted mobile experiences only where they genuinely improve the user journey.



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* 3\+ years of Android development experience using Kotlin.
* Strong Android fundamentals and experience shipping production apps.
* Good knowledge of Jetpack, Coroutines, Flow and modern Android architecture.
* Strong sense of mobile UX, usability, edge cases and user flows.
* Experience integrating REST APIs and debugging production issues.
* Fast execution, high ownership and strong attention to product quality.
* App links, GitHub, screenshots or examples of shipped work are a strong advantage.



  





**Tech Stack** 



* Kotlin
* Jetpack Compose
* Android SDK
* Coroutines \& Flow
* SQL / NoSQL
* TensorFlow Lite (on\-device inference)



  





**The Kind of Builder We Want** 



* Thinks in user journeys, not just screens.
* Cares about making complex financial products feel simple.
* Moves fast without creating messy code.
* Notices UX, performance and reliability issues before users complain.
* Honest about what they personally built, what was team\-owned and what impact they can or cannot claim.



  





**This Role Is Not For** 



* Engineers who only want fully defined tickets.
* Developers who build screens without caring about user experience.
* People who ignore crashes, edge cases, loading states or performance.
* Engineers who move slowly in a startup environment.
* People who exaggerate impact without explaining their actual contribution.



  





**Location** 




 This role is remote, but candidates must be based in
 **India** 
 . We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in
 **India** 
 .
 



  





**Language** 




 English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
 



  





**Interview Process** 




 Our process is designed to move fast:
 


1. Online assessment or practical task
2. Role\-specific interview
3. CEO / final round



  





 For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Android Developer
description:
**About The Role**
 We are looking for strong Android Developers at the SDE II and SDE III levels to build and scale a high engagement consumer technology platform.
   

  

 You will take ownership of critical Android modules, translate product ideas into reliable user experiences, and solve challenges related to performance, scalability, real time interactions, offline behaviour, and device compatibility. This role requires strong Android fundamentals, product thinking, and the ability to deliver production grade applications independently.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Design, develop, test, and maintain high quality Android applications using Kotlin
* Build responsive and reusable user interfaces using Jetpack Compose
* Own features from technical design and development through release and post production monitoring
* Work with Product, Design, Backend, AI, Security, and Quality Engineering teams to deliver seamless user experiences
* Integrate REST APIs, WebSockets, push notifications, analytics, authentication, and third party services
* Improve application startup time, rendering performance, battery usage, memory consumption, and crash rates
* Develop reliable offline first experiences using local storage, caching, and data synchronisation
* Write modular, testable, and maintainable code using established architecture patterns
* Participate in code reviews, architecture discussions, sprint planning, and production troubleshooting
* Monitor application health using crash reporting, analytics, logging, and performance monitoring tools
* Maintain security standards for user data, API communication, local storage, and application releases
* Support CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, Play Store releases, staged rollouts, and production monitoring


 Core Technical Requirements
   

  

* Strong proficiency in Kotlin and Android SDK
* Hands on experience with Jetpack Compose and modern Android development practices
* Strong understanding of Kotlin Coroutines, Flow, StateFlow, and asynchronous programming
* Experience with MVVM, MVI, Clean Architecture, or similar scalable architectural approaches
* Experience with Android Jetpack components such as ViewModel, Navigation, Room, WorkManager, and DataStore
* Strong understanding of dependency injection using Hilt, Dagger, or Koin
* Experience integrating REST APIs, WebSockets, Firebase, push notifications, and deep links
* Knowledge of local databases, caching strategies, pagination, background processing, and data synchronisation
* Strong understanding of Android lifecycle, threading, memory management, networking, and application performance
* Experience writing unit tests and UI tests using JUnit, MockK, Espresso, or Compose Testing
* Familiarity with Git, Gradle, CI/CD pipelines, Play Console, release management, and production debugging
* Good understanding of Material Design and the ability to translate Figma designs into polished Android experiences


 Level ExpectationsSDE II
   

  

* Typically 4 to 6 years of Android development experience
* Independently owns complex features and modules
* Writes clean, testable, and production ready code
* Makes sound implementation and component level design decisions
* Identifies and resolves performance, stability, and usability issues
* Contributes meaningfully to code reviews and engineering standards


 SDE III
   

  

* Typically 6 to 9 years of Android development experience
* Owns architecture and delivery of major application areas
* Makes system level decisions affecting scalability, reliability, and maintainability
* Drives improvements in performance, testing, observability, security, and release quality
* Mentors Android engineers and raises the overall technical standard of the team
* Collaborates with engineering leadership on roadmap planning, technical tradeoffs, and risk management
* Leads investigation and resolution of complex production issues


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience building high scale B2C, social media, community, messaging, content, or consumer applications
* Experience implementing real time feeds, chat, media upload, notifications, recommendation surfaces, or social interactions
* Experience with modular Android architecture and multi module codebases
* Familiarity with media processing, CameraX, ExoPlayer or Media3, image loading, and upload optimisation
* Understanding of Android security, certificate pinning, encryption, obfuscation, and secure data storage
* Published or actively maintained applications on the Google Play Store
* Experience working in fast paced product or startup environments


 What We Look For
   

  

* Strong ownership and a product first approach
* Ability to balance development speed with long term engineering quality
* Attention to interaction details, usability, and application performance
* Clear communication and effective cross functional collaboration
* Ability to work through ambiguity and convert broad product requirements into scalable technical solutions

title: Administration Manager
description:
Broomies Bakery is looking for a mature, highly organized, and responsible Senior Admin \& Operations Manager to oversee the day\-to\-day operations of our central production (Base Kitchen) and ensure seamless coordination with our four retail outlets across Faridabad.

The ideal candidate should have strong leadership skills, experience in food production or hospitality operations, and the ability to manage teams, vendors, inventory, dispatch, and administration efficiently.

Key Responsibilities

1\. Base Kitchen Operations

* Oversee complete daily operations of the central kitchen.
* Ensure timely production planning based on outlet requirements.
* Monitor productivity, hygiene, quality standards, and food safety.
* Coordinate with the Production Head to ensure smooth workflow.

2\. Dispatch \& Logistics

* Ensure accurate and timely dispatch of products to all four stores.
* Monitor dispatch schedules and delivery timelines.
* Coordinate with drivers and dispatch staff for smooth daily operations.
* Resolve delivery\-related issues promptly.

3\. Team Management

* Supervise dispatch, store support, housekeeping, security, and administrative staff.
* Allocate duties and monitor staff performance.
* Maintain discipline and ensure adherence to company policies.
* Conduct daily operational meetings and provide guidance to team members.

4\. Purchase \& Vendor Management

* Handle procurement of raw materials, packaging, consumables, and operational supplies.
* Negotiate with suppliers for quality, pricing, and timely deliveries.
* Maintain strong relationships with vendors.
* Track purchase orders and ensure cost control.

5\. Inventory \& Stock Control

* Monitor inventory levels of raw materials and packaging.
* Ensure accurate stock records and periodic stock audits.
* Minimize wastage and prevent stock shortages.
* Coordinate with the accounts team for inventory reconciliation.

6\. Store Coordination

* Maintain close coordination with all four Broomies outlets.
* Ensure outlets receive products on time and in the required quantities.
* Address operational issues reported by store managers.
* Ensure smooth communication between stores and the base kitchen.

7\. Administration

* Manage day\-to\-day administrative activities of the base kitchen.
* Oversee maintenance of equipment and facilities.
* Ensure statutory compliance, documentation, and record keeping.
* Coordinate with HR for attendance, staffing, and operational requirements.

8\. Reporting

* Prepare daily operational reports.
* Monitor KPIs related to production, dispatch, inventory, and purchases.
* Report operational challenges and recommend improvements to management.

Desired Candidate Profile

* Age: 38 years or above (preferred).
* Minimum 10 years of experience in administration and operations.
* Experience in bakery, food manufacturing, FMCG, hospitality, QSR, or central kitchen operations is highly preferred.
* Strong leadership and people management skills.
* Excellent organizational and problem\-solving abilities.
* Good knowledge of inventory management, procurement, dispatch, and administration.
* Comfortable using Microsoft Excel and ERP/POS systems.
* Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple teams simultaneously.
* Honest, disciplined, proactive, and capable of making independent operational decisions.

Pay: ₹35,000\.00 \- ₹42,000\.00 per month

title: PRODUCTION MANAGER
description:
**Job Summary**

The Production Manager is responsible for planning, coordinating, and controlling all production activities to ensure timely delivery, superior product quality, optimum productivity, and effective utilization of manpower and resources. The role focuses on achieving production targets, maintaining quality standards, and ensuring compliance with company policies and safety requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Production Planning \& Control**

* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly production plans based on customer orders.
* Allocate work efficiently across departments and monitor production schedules.
* Ensure on\-time completion of orders as per committed delivery dates.
* Monitor production capacity and optimize resource utilization.

**2\. Production Operations**

* Supervise all manufacturing processes, including casting, die, CNC, filing, assembly, soldering, polishing and finishing.
* Ensure adherence to standard operating procedures (SOPs).
* Resolve production issues promptly to avoid delays.

**3\. Quality Management**

* Ensure products meet internal quality standards and customer specifications.
* Monitor First Time Acceptance (FTA) and implement corrective actions to reduce rework.
* Coordinate with the Quality Control team for continuous quality improvement.

**5\. Delivery Management**

* Coordinate with Planning, Stores, and Dispatch to achieve customer delivery commitments.
* Monitor work\-in\-progress (WIP) and eliminate production bottlenecks.
* Ensure priority orders are completed on schedule.

**6\. Inventory \& Material Control**

* Monitor availability of raw materials, consumables, and production tools.
* Coordinate with Stores for timely material issuance.
* Control excess inventory and improve inventory turnover.

**7\. Team Management**

* Lead, motivate, and supervise production supervisors and operators.
* Conduct daily production review meetings.
* Identify training needs and support employee skill development.
* Monitor attendance, discipline, and productivity.
* Submitting various types of report from production department an timely submission to management and HR.

**8\. Process Improvement**

* Identify opportunities to improve productivity, reduce cycle time, and minimize production costs.
* Implement Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Standardize production processes to improve efficiency.

**9\. Safety \& Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with safety regulations and company policies.
* Ensure statutory and internal compliance requirements are followed.

**10\. Reporting**

* Prepare daily production reports and management dashboards.
* Analyze production efficiency, rejection, rework, delivery performance, and productivity.
* Present improvement plans to management.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Engineering, Production Management, or a related field.

**Experience**

* 8–15 years of experience in manufacturing company.
* Minimum 3–5 years in a Production Manager or similar leadership role.

* Food provided

**1\) Job Purpose:** *Write the purpose for which the job exists (in 2\-3 lines)* **(****Max 1325 Characters)**
===============================================================================================================

  

The Branch Manager – Gold Loans is responsible for driving branch\-level business performance, ensuring compliance, delivering superior customer experience, and maintaining portfolio quality. The role leads the frontline team to achieve disbursement, new customer acquisition, yield, audit, collections, and risk KPIs while upholding operational governance. **2\) Dimensions:** *Mention quantitative or qualitative parameters that are relevant for the job and provide a better understanding of the scope and scale of the job.* **New Relationship**

 (Max 254 Characters)

  

Ensure strict adherence to RBI norms, internal policies, risk processes, purity testing, and audit standards. **Portfolio monitoring**

  

Monitor delinquencies, yield, tonnage, auction ratios, spurious/bentex cases, and branch growth metric**3\) Job Context \& Major Challenges:** Write the specific aspects of the job that provide a challenge (internal and external) to the jobholder in the context of the Business/Unit/Function/Department/Section **(****Max 3975 Characters)**
==============================================================================================================================================================================================================================================

 **Organization Context**
Aditya Birla Capital Limited ("NBFC") is registered with RBI as a Systematically Important Non\-Deposit accepting Non\-Banking Finance Company (NBFC). ABCL is one of the top private diversified NBFCs in India. As of 31\-Sep’25, ABCL has a pan\-India presence with a lending book of approx. Rs. 139,500 Crores.  

ABCL offers end\-to\-end lending solutions to a diverse set of customers \- Retail, HNI, MSMEs, and Mid \& Large Corporates through secured as well as unsecured loan products. The diverse range of lending products includes Retail Small Ticket Secured and Unsecured Loans, Unsecured Personal Loans, Unsecured Business Loans, Health \& Education Loans, Digital B2B2C and B2B2B Small Ticket Loans, Small Business Secured Loans, Loans Against Property (LAP), Lease Rental Discounting (LRD), Construction Finance (to Real Estate Developers), SME Loans, Capital Markets Loans (Loan Against Shares), Supply Chain Finance, Mid and Large Corporate Loans, and Infrastructure Finance loans. ABCL also has a Wealth Management division.  

ABCL is rated “AAA” by India Ratings, ICRA and CARE (reaffirmed in 2020\). ABCL secured the ABG Business Excellence Award in 2017 (Silver), and 2015 (Bronze), and multiple other Awards on forums like CII. **Business Context**
Gold Loans is a key secured lending product with high volume, fast turnaround expectations and requires strict discipline in risk, valuation, purity testing, and customer trust management. **Job Context:**  

The Branch Manager executes gold loan business at the branch level, ensuring revenue, portfolio quality, and operational governance. The role balances growth, yield optimization, and compliance while managing a small but high?impact team and ensuring branch\-level risk controls **Key Challenges:*** Achieving aggressive customer acquisition, disbursement and tonnage growth in competitive local markets.
* Maintaining strict LTV adherence, gold purity compliance, and accurate valuation amid gold price fluctuations.
* Ensuring timely closure of spurious/bentex cases and minimizing auction\-to\-book ratio.
* Driving collection resolutions for 0–30 DPD while preventing slippages.
* Ensuring branch audit scores \>90% with zero tolerance deviations.
* Delivering consistent customer experience in high\-sensitivity product category (emotional asset).
* Motivating and developing frontline staff for continuous sales and service productivity

 **Key Result Areas (Max 1325 Characters)** **Supporting Actions (Max 1325 Characters)** **Business Growth \& Acquisition*** Achieve targets for new CUID creation.
* Drive new customer disbursements as per percentile role benchmarks.
* Ensure net growth and tonnage growth in line with branch plan.
 **Yield \& Profitability Management*** Achieve onboarding yield benchmarks
* Drive optimal ticket size, renewal mix, and repeat customer engagement.
* Ensure cost\-efficient branch operations.
 **Portfolio Quality \& Risk Management*** Maintain auction\-to\-book ratio

 **Collections \& Delinquency Management*** Deliver resolution for 0–30 DPD bucket.
