**Job Description: Technical Recruiter**

 **About Company:**  

  

**Teleradiology Solutions (TRS) is a pioneer in teleradiology, delivering round\-the\-clock diagnostic radiology reporting and support to hospitals and healthcare providers across India, the US, and other global markets. Founded in 2002 by two Yale\-trained physicians and headquartered in Ardmore, PA, TRS today serves over 150 hospitals across 21 countries.**  

**The company pairs a network of board\-certified radiologists — including ABR\-certified specialists — with technology\-driven workflows and its AI\-enabled arm, dAIgnostiX, to deliver fast, accurate, and reliable imaging interpretation. dAIgnostiX is based out of Bengaluru (Whitefield). TRS/dAIX also maintains an active academic focus (****www.radguru.net****) and ongoing research interests, including AI in radiology.**

**Experience:** 5\+ years  

**Location:** Bangalore (Whitefield), WFO

**About the Role**

  

We are looking for a motivated and detail\-oriented Technical Recruiter to join our Talent Acquisition team. The ideal candidate will have experience recruiting for technical and engineering positions and will be responsible for managing the end\-to\-end recruitment lifecycle, from sourcing candidates to onboarding. This role requires strong stakeholder management, excellent communication skills, and the ability to identify top technical talent in a competitive market.

 **Key Responsibilities**

  

* Manage the complete recruitment cycle for technical positions, including IT, AI, software development, infrastructure, cloud, cybersecurity, data, and engineering roles.
* Partner with hiring managers to understand hiring requirements, job responsibilities, and desired candidate profiles.
* Source candidates through LinkedIn, job portals, employee referrals, social media, and other sourcing channels.
* Screen resumes and conduct initial candidate assessments to evaluate technical skills, experience, and cultural fit.
* Coordinate and schedule interviews with hiring managers and interview panels.
* Maintain regular communication with candidates throughout the hiring process to ensure a positive candidate experience.
* Negotiate compensation within company guidelines and assist in closing candidates.
* Maintain accurate candidate records in the Applicant Tracking System (ATS).
* Build and maintain a strong talent pipeline for current and future hiring needs.
* Track recruitment metrics and provide regular hiring updates to stakeholders.
* Support employer branding initiatives and participate in recruitment events, career fairs, and networking activities.

### **Requirements**

**Required Qualifications**

  

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field.
* 5 plus years of experience in technical recruitment.
* Experience hiring for software development, infrastructure, cloud, DevOps, networking, cybersecurity, AI/ML, or other technical roles.
* Strong understanding of technical terminology and technology stacks.
* Hands\-on experience with LinkedIn Recruiter, job portals, and Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS).
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple positions simultaneously.

 **Preferred Skills**

  

* Experience working in a fast\-paced product, IT services, or technology startup environment.
* Knowledge of Boolean search techniques and advanced sourcing strategies.
* Familiarity with recruitment analytics and reporting.
* Experience with Zoho Recruit, Greenhouse, Lever, or similar ATS platforms.
* Strong networking and relationship\-building skills.

title: Technical Talent Attraction Specialist - India (Remote)
description:
Wilson is seeking a motivated, consultative and experienced Recruitment Consultant to join our collaborative, dynamic and talented team. Someone that will play an integral part in acting as a trusted client advisor and candidate advocate. In this role, you will combine cutting\-edge recruitment strategies and market intelligence to deliver the best talent to meet the critical recruiting needs of our clients. We’re looking for individuals who demonstrate a strong, independent work ethic, knowledge of best practices for attracting top talent, the ability to develop and nurture strong working relationships and a passion for providing excellent client satisfaction. Our Recruiters provide an exceptional candidate experience through management of all aspects of the recruiting process including sourcing, screening, interviewing and recommending candidates for both interviews and for hire.


**YOU WILL:**

\- Oversee the selection process including identifying and assessing candidates, conducting initial phone screens, facilitating interviews and gathering feedback from our clients and candidates.


\- Build and maintain a strong network of candidates through market research and on\-going bench management, demonstrating the ability to anticipate client needs and hiring manager preferences by delivering strong submit \-to\-interview and interview\-to\-offer ratios.


\- Develop a creative and proactive recruitment strategy to identify both passive and active candidates.


\- Present strong talent for open positions and overcome objections in the hiring process.

title: Lead Analyst, Data Operations
description:
### **Description**

 **Job location: Remote**  

  

**About the role:**
Sun King is looking for a practitioner\-leader to serve as Lead Analyst on the Data Desk. Reporting directly to the Head of Data Operations, you are the operational engine that keeps the Data Desk running at pace and to standard. You are both a technical authority and a people manager, often in the same hour.
Your mandate has three pillars: keep the queue healthy, automate the repeatable tasks, and ensure that nothing inaccurate leaves the team. You manage the flow of incoming L1/L2 requests, perform 100% of code reviews for entry\-level analysts, and systematically convert recurring requests into self\-service dashboards — effectively working the Data Desk out of a job, one repeat ticket at a time.
The ideal candidate is someone who takes pride in operational precision, finds satisfaction in growing junior talent, and has the SQL depth to catch a subtle logic error in a peer’s query.  

  

**The team you would join:**  

The Global Analytics and Technology function at Sun King helps us build technology\-enabled solutions based on data\-driven insights. We have a team of data scientists, data engineers, analysts, technical architects, Android developers, web designers, backend engineers, product managers, and UI/UX developers working on developing cutting\-edge solutions for the underserved billions — covering last\-mile delivery, credit underwriting, credit risk management, distribution channel digitization, churn management, and more.  

Within this function, the Data Operations team runs the Data Desk, the squad that fields, triages, and resolves the organization’s day\-to\-day data requests while simultaneously working to automate itself out of repetitive work. The team also serves as a Data Academy: Sun King’s internal residency for elite data talent.  

  

### **What you will be expected to do**

  

* **Ticket Routing \& Triage:** Own the incoming request queue and serve as the first point of triage for all L1/L2 tickets raised to the Data Desk. Accurately categorize every request across the four tracks (Logic, Exports, Ops, and Finance) and route to the appropriate pod lead or analyst without delay. Monitor SLA performance across the queue in real time; proactively surface blockers to the Head of Data Ops before SLAs are breached. Maintain and continuously refine the triage playbook, updating categorization rules as request patterns evolve and new ticket types emerge.
* **Automation of the Routine:** Systematically identify “repeat” requests and flag them for automation. Work closely with Pod Leads to scope, design, and ship self\-service dashboards and automated data pipelines that retire those recurring requests. Coordinate with the Analytics Engineering pod to ensure all automated outputs conform to Sun King data quality and governance standards.
* **Technical Supervision \& Code Review:** Perform 100% of code reviews for entry\-level analysts before any output is delivered to a business stakeholder. Review SQL, LookML, and dashboard logic for correctness, performance, and alignment with the Sun King Data Standard.
* **Team Operations \& People Development:** Run daily stand\-ups for the Data Desk team, keeping the team aligned on priorities and unblocked on active tickets. Conduct regular 1\-on\-1s with direct reports, tracking progress against individual growth plans agreed with the Head of Data Ops. Onboard new Freshers into the Data Desk’s processes, tooling, and quality standards as part of the Data Academy rotation curriculum. Represent the Data Desk in cross\-functional ceremonies — sprint reviews, stakeholder check\-ins — when the Head of Data Ops is unavailable.

### **You might be a strong candidate if you have/are**

  

* **Education:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a technical field such as Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, or a related discipline.
* **Professional Experience:** 4–9 years of experience in a data, analytics, or data operations function with at least 1–2 years in a role with direct responsibility for reviewing, mentoring, or managing junior data analysts. A track record of translating recurring manual work into automated or self\-service solutions.
* **Technical Proficiency:** Strong hands\-on SQL skills, working knowledge of LookML or equivalent BI layer logic (Looker, Tableau, Power BI, Metabase), and familiarity with AWS\-based data environments.

  


### **What Sun King offers**

  

* Professional growth in a dynamic, rapidly expanding, high\-social\-impact industry
* An open\-minded, collaborative culture made up of enthusiastic colleagues who are driven by the challenge of innovation towards profound impact on people and the planet.
* A truly multicultural experience: you will have the chance to work with and learn from people from different geographies, nationalities, and backgrounds.
* Structured, tailored learning and development programs that help you become a better leader, manager, and professional through the Sun King Center for Leadership.

  

### **About Sun King**


Sun King is the world’s leading off\-grid solar energy company, combining cutting\-edge product design, fintech, and field operations to deliver energy access for the 1\.8 billion people who live without an affordable and reliable electric\-grid connection.  

Sun King has built a new kind of energy utility: distributed, green, customer\-centric, and affordable. We bring clean, reliable, decentralized energy directly into people’s lives — from solar kits that provide first\-time energy access to multi\-kilowatt systems that serve both off\-grid users and grid\-connected customers powering larger homes, schools, hospitals, farms, offices, and light manufacturing.  

Already, 25 million homes and businesses rely on Sun King for electricity supply and the appliances and services it enables: lighting, televisions, fans, refrigeration, and smartphones.  

  

Sun King combines energy generation, energy\-efficient appliances, installation, and financing into one seamless offering. Think of it as a distributed utility, designed for wherever energy is needed and designed to scale with its users as incomes and energy needs grow.  

  

Sun King makes solar products affordable to low\-income households and businesses via ‘pay\-as\-you\-go’ (PAYG) purchase financing. Sun King installs solar after customers pay a small deposit. Customers then make small, manageable payments of as little as US $0\.14 a day via mobile money or cash.  

Instead of paying for expensive, polluting, and health\-damaging kerosene for lighting or diesel for power, customers unlock savings through accessing solar power and after one to two years of payments, customers own their solar equipment outright.  

  

Sun King collects payments digitally through mobile money systems and its 35,000 field agents — over 1 million payments each day. To date, Sun King has extended more than $1\.4 billion in PAYG loans to customers.  

  

Sun King began by powering homes and businesses with solar systems delivered through PAYG financing. Now, we’re using the same model to make smartphones and clean cooking equipment affordable: helping households connect to the digital economy and transition from wood\-based fuels to modern, sustainable alternatives.  

  

Sun King employs 3,500 full\-time staff in 14 countries, with specialties spanning product design, data science, logistics, customer service, sales, software, operations, and more — all with a passion to serve off\-grid families. Sun King is committed to gender diversity in the workplace. Women represent 42% of Sun King’s workforce.

title: Graduate Engineer Trainee - Mechanical
description:
Company Description  

At Konecranes, we believe that great customer experience is built on the people behind the Konecranes name. Everything we do, we do with passion and drive. We believe diversity drives business success and is the foundation for our growth. We welcome different backgrounds and skills that enrich our community and we promote a place where we can ALL be ourselves. This is what makes Konecranes a unique place to work.

  

Job Description  

We are seeking enthusiastic and motivated Graduate Engineer Trainees (GETs) – Mechanical, Mobile Harbour Crane to join our Engineering Design team. The selected candidates will work closely with experienced engineers in the development, documentation, and management of engineering designs and product data. This role provides an excellent opportunity for fresh graduates to gain hands\-on exposure to 3D CAD modeling, Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), engineering documentation, manufacturing processes, and design best practices while contributing to live customer and project requirements.


The candidate should possess strong engineering fundamentals, analytical thinking, and a keen interest in mechanical design and product development.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Strong verbal and written English communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a team\-oriented environment.
* Basic knowledge of CAD and ERP systems.
* Sound understanding of Engineering fundamentals and Mathematics.
* Knowledge of welding technologies, manufacturing processes, and GD\&T (Geometric Dimensioning \& Tolerancing).
* Good visualization and interpretation of 2D engineering drawings.
* Analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).
* Support compliance with ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 requirements.


The role is based in our office in SP Infocity, Hadapsar, Pune – but it goes without saying that the remote \& hybrid working is a part of our modern ways of working.

**To achieve this goal**

* Bachelor's Degree in **Mechanical Engineering** or **Production Engineering** from a recognized and reputed university.
* Fresher with sound knowledge of Engineering fundamentals, CAD \& PLM software.
* Consistent academic performance throughout the educational career shall be preferred.
* Passionate about mechanical design and product engineering.
* Strong aptitude for visualizing and interpreting engineering concepts.
* Keen interest in CAD modeling and digital engineering tools.
* Willingness to learn new technologies, systems, and industry practices.
* Ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment.
* Strong ownership mindset and commitment towards quality and deadlines.

  

Qualifications  

Bachelor’s degree holder in Mechanical / Production Engineering from reputed university.


**Experience:**


Fresher with sound knowledge of Engineering fundamentals, CAD \& PLM software.

  

Additional Information **What We Offer**

* As a Graduate Engineer Trainees (GETs) – Mechanical, Mobile Harbour Crane you get to join our team and make your mark in our journey forward. You will be working as an Individual Contributor and later leading and contributing to our team in a very ambitious and growth\-oriented culture. Although previous people leadership experience is an advantage, we are open to hiring a candidate with a can\-do attitude and providing them with leadership in\-the\-role learning and training opportunities within the company. You will be able to work in a corporate in\-house role and collaborate with global teams.
* As we trust in Winning Together, we offer continuous learning and development, which means that you will also get equal opportunities for self\-development as a leader.
* Driving for better, we offer a **flexible \& inclusive work environment** where you can be yourself and enjoy **Work\-Life balance.**
* We believe in doing the right thing by offering a **Competitive Salary**.

Interested?

***Konecranes moves what matters****. We are a global leader in material handling solutions, serving a broad range of customers across multiple industries. We consistently set the industry benchmark, from everyday improvements to the breakthroughs at moments that matter most, because we know we can always find a safer, more productive and sustainable way. That's why, with 16 000\+ professionals in over 50 countries, we are trusted every day to lift, handle and move what the world needs.*

title: Data Engineer I, SPIV Data Engineering
description:
**Description**
 Selling Partner Identity Verification is working to identify and prevent fraudulent behavior through all stages of a seller's lifecycle. We are seeking a skilled Data Engineer to join our team and help us build and manage the Data for the business domains within the Selling Partner Identity Verification space. As a Data Engineer, you will play a crucial role in designing, implementing, and maintaining our data infrastructure and pipelines. You will work closely with cross\-functional teams to deliver scalable and efficient data solutions that drive business value.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 You will design and develop scalable, high\-performance data systems using medallion architecture.
   

  

 You are expected to collaborate with data scientists, analysts, and business stakeholders to understand data requirements and implement appropriate solutions.
   

  

 Optimize data storage and retrieval systems for improved performance and cost\-effectiveness.
   

  

 Implement data quality checks and monitoring systems to ensure data integrity and reliability.
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 A Data Engineer I on SPIV starts their day by syncing with the team on data pipeline status, checking for any overnight failures in ETL jobs processing seller identity verification data. They collaborate with data scientists to understand new fraud detection requirements, then design and implement scalable data models using medallion architecture to support these use cases.
   

  

**About The Team**
 SPIV Data Engineering builds the data backbone for Selling Partner Identity Verification \- preventing fraud across the seller lifecycle. Our Northstar is to build business domain datasets with data as product mental model. We're a collaborative team that values ownership, technical rigor, and shipping solutions that matter. You'll work with data scientists, analysts, and business teams. We emphasize learning, code quality, and building infrastructure that scales.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 1\+ years of data engineering experience
* Experience with SQL
* Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
* Experience with one or more query language (e.g., SQL, PL/SQL, DDL, MDX, HiveQL, SparkSQL, Scala)
* Experience with one or more scripting language (e.g., Python, KornShell)


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with big data technologies such as: Hadoop, Hive, Spark, EMR
* Experience with any ETL tool like, Informatica, ODI, SSIS, BODI, Datastage, etc.

title: Software Tester Intern
description:
**Job Title: Software Tester Internship**

**Location:** Nagpur  
**Experience:** Fresher  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a motivated and detail\-oriented **Software Tester (Fresher)** to join our team. The candidate will be responsible for testing software applications, identifying bugs, reporting issues, and ensuring product quality before release. Fresh graduates with strong analytical skills and an interest in software testing are encouraged to apply.

**Roles \& Responsibilities**

* Understand project requirements and software specifications.
* Perform manual testing of web and mobile applications.
* Create and execute test cases, test scenarios, and test reports.
* Identify, document, and track software defects and bugs.
* Work closely with developers to resolve issues.
* Verify bug fixes and conduct regression testing.
* Ensure applications meet quality standards and user requirements.
* Participate in software testing activities throughout the development lifecycle.
* Prepare testing documentation and reports.

**Required Skills**

* Basic understanding of **Software Testing concepts**.
* Knowledge of **Manual Testing** and testing methodologies.
* Understanding of **SDLC (Software Development Life Cycle)** and **STLC (Software Testing Life Cycle)**.
* Basic knowledge of bug tracking tools is an advantage.
* Good analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong communication and documentation skills.
* Attention to detail and willingness to learn.

**Qualification**

* Bachelor’s degree in **Computer Science, IT, BCA, B.E., B.Tech, MCA**, or related field.
* Freshers can apply.

**Preferred Skills (Optional)**

* Knowledge of **automation testing** tools is a plus.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
**Department:** 
 Data Science \& Engineering
 



**Location:** 
 MMR Research Mumbai
   

  




**Description**
 We’re looking for
 **hands‑on DevOps Engineers** 
 with a solid grounding in the Azure ecosystem to join our delivery teams working on some of the most exciting digital programmes across multiple industries. You’ll be part of a small, high‑impact product team — working alongside developers, designers, analysts and product owners — helping to drive automation, tooling and cloud infrastructure under the guidance of senior engineers.
   

  

 We’re big on continuous learning, so you’ll have the chance to work with experienced engineers, explore new technologies and grow your technical capability at pace. This role is the
 **first step in MMR’s DevOps career pathway** 
 , giving you the foundation you need to progress into a Level 2 DevOps Engineer role.
   

  

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Support CI/CD pipelines** 
 across Bitbucket and Azure DevOps
   

  

**Automate deployments** 
 using Azure Pipelines, Ansible or Octopus Deploy
   

  

**Provision cloud infrastructure** 
 with Terraform (IaC)
   

**Maintain Azure environments** 
 including compute, storage and networking
   

  

**Work with containers** 
 across Docker and Kubernetes setups
   

  

**Monitor systems** 
 using Grafana, Turbo360 and Azure Monitor
   

  

**Troubleshoot build and pipeline issues** 
 and escalate when needed
   

  

**Collaborate across Dev, QA and Agile teams** 
 to support smooth delivery
   

  

  

**Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**
**Azure fundamentals** 
 with experience across core services, Entra and cloud best practices
   

  

**CI/CD tooling** 
 using Bitbucket and Azure DevOps
   

  

**Containers \& orchestration** 
 with Docker, Kubernetes and AKS
   

  

**Infrastructure as Code** 
 using Terraform, ARM, Bicep or Helm
   

  

**Scripting capability** 
 in PowerShell, Bash, Python and AZ CLI
   

  

**Monitoring \& logging** 
 with Prometheus, Grafana, Azure Monitor and Log Analytics
   

  

**Configuration management awareness** 
 across DSC, Ansible, Puppet, Chef or SaltStack
   

  

**Version control \& Agile delivery** 
 using Git within modern DevOps/Agile teams
   

  

  

**A bit about us and our benefits!**
 We’re MMR Research Worldwide – the global sensory and consumer research experts behind many of the world’s biggest brands in food, drink, personal and household care. From bold new flavours to breakthrough product experiences, we help turn great ideas into products people truly love.
   

  

 With teams across the UK, US, Asia and Africa, we blend science, creativity and curiosity to shape the future of everyday products. Join us and you’ll be part of a fast\-growing, innovative company where your ideas matter and your career can thrive.
   

  

 It’s our people that make all of this possible.
   

  

 We are proud of our collaborative culture which is driven by strong leadership and offers industry\-leading training and growth opportunities.
   

  

 At MMR, we're committed to ensuring the happiness and well\-being of each employee, regardless of where they are in the world! We offer a wide range of core and additional benefits. Competitive salaries, generous holiday allowances, and market\-leading training opportunities are standard here. Our vibrant culture, talented team, and focus on employee wellbeing is what makes MMR so special.

title: Cloud Platform Engineer
description:
The era of pervasive AI has arrived. In this era, organizations will use generative AI to unlock hidden value in their data, accelerate processes, reduce costs, drive efficiency and innovation to fundamentally transform their businesses and operations at scale.
   

  

 SambaNova Suite™ is the first full\-stack, generative AI platform, from chip to model, optimized for enterprise and government organizations. Powered by the intelligent SN40L chip, the SambaNova Suite is a fully integrated platform, delivered on\-premises or in the cloud, combined with state\-of\-the\-art open\-source models that can be easily and securely fine\-tuned using customer data for greater accuracy. Once adapted with customer data, customers retain model ownership in perpetuity, so they can turn generative AI into one of their most valuable assets.
   

  

 About SambaNova Systems: Join the company that's building the future of AI computing. At SambaNova, we are disrupting the AI and high\-performance computing space with our integrated hardware and software platform. Our DataScale systems and SambaFlow software are pushing the boundaries of what's possible with generative AI and large language models. We are a team of passionate innovators tackling some of the world's most challenging computational problems.
   

  

 The Role
   

  

 As a Cloud Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) specializing in our AI Inferencing Service, you will be the guardian of its reliability, performance, and scalability. You will bridge the gap between software development and operations, applying an engineering mindset to solve operational challenges. Your primary focus will be ensuring our inference endpoints have exceptional uptime, low\-latency response times, and efficient resource utilization, directly impacting the experience of our customers and the success of our AI products. This role includes participating in a shared on\-call rotation to maintain 24/7 service reliability.
   

  

 What You'll Do:
   

  

 Service Ownership \& On\-Call: Take shared ownership of the production inferencing service, including its availability, latency, performance, efficiency, change management, monitoring, emergency response, and capacity planning across multiple regions. This includes implementing and supporting AI infrastructure in new regions, such as Asia, Europe, and Latin America, to support the growth of our business. Participate in a balanced on\-call rotation to provide 24/7 support for the service.
   

  

 On\-Call \& Work\-Life Balance
   

  

 We believe a sustainable on\-call schedule is critical for long\-term success and team health. Our on\-call philosophy is built on the following principles:
   

  

 Balanced Rotation: The on\-call rotation is shared equally across the team, typically following a primary/secondary (follow\-the\-sun) model to ensure no single person bears a disproportionate burden.
   

  

 Focus on Prevention: We invest heavily in automation, robust testing, and system design to prevent pages before they happen. The goal of on\-call is not to heroically fight fires, but to manage rare, complex failures and use those learnings to make the system more resilient.
   

  

 Actionable Alerts: We have a strict policy against alert fatigue. Alerts must be actionable and require immediate human intervention.
   

  

 Incident Management: Lead the response to incidents affecting the inferencing service, driving blameless post\-mortems and implementing corrective actions to prevent recurrence.
   

  

 Monitoring \& Alerting: Develop and maintain advanced monitoring, alerting, and dashboarding (using tools like Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog) to gain deep insights into service health, model performance (e.g., latency, throughput, error rates), and accelerator utilization. A key responsibility is ensuring alerts are actionable and have a low false\-positive rate, minimizing on\-call fatigue.
   

  

 Performance \& Scalability: Proactively identify and eliminate performance bottlenecks. Design and implement auto\-scaling policies to handle variable inference loads cost\-effectively. Use insights from on\-call incidents to drive improvements that enhance system stability and scalability.
   

  

 Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Manage and evolve our cloud infrastructure (on AWS, GCP, and/or Azure along with on\-prem) using tools like Terraform and Ansible, ensuring it is secure, repeatable, and scalable.
   

  

 CI/CD \& Automation: Champion automation by building and improving CI/CD pipelines for the seamless and safe deployment of new model versions and service updates. A core goal is to automate manual toil identified during on\-call shifts, reducing future operational overhead.
   

  

 Capacity Planning: Forecast infrastructure needs based on product roadmaps and usage trends. Work with finance and engineering teams to manage cloud costs and optimize spending.
   

  

 SLOs \& SLIs: Define, measure, and report on Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and Indicators (SLIs) for the inferencing platform, using data to drive prioritization and reliability investments.
   

  

 What We're Looking For (Must\-Haves):
   

  

 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
   

  

 3\-5\+ years of experience in a Site Reliability Engineer, DevOps, or related role supporting a large\-scale, customer\-facing service in a public cloud environment (AWS, GCP, Azure).
   

  

 Strong programming/scripting skills in languages like Python, Go, or Java.
   

  

 Proven experience with containerization and orchestration technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).
   

  

 Deep understanding of monitoring and observability principles and tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, Datadog).
   

  

 Solid experience with Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation).
   

  

 Familiarity with CI/CD principles and tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD).
   

  

 Excellent problem\-solving skills and a systematic approach to troubleshooting complex distributed systems.
   

  

 What Will Make You Stand Out (Nice\-to\-Haves):
   

  

 Experience in a hybrid environment bridging cloud and on\-premise/data center infrastructure.
   

  

 Direct experience supporting ML/AI inferencing services in production.
   

  

 Familiarity with GPU\-accelerated computing and optimizing workloads for NVIDIA GPUs for purposes of mapping to RDUs.
   

  

 Knowledge of model serving frameworks like vLLM, SGLang or Ray.
   

  

 Understanding of MLOps principles and practices.
   

  

 Experience with managing and tuning databases (SQL or NoSQL) and caching systems (Redis, Memcached).
   

  

 Strong Linux/Unix system administration fundamentals.
   

  

 Why SambaNova?
   

  

 Massive Impact: You will be a key part of a critical platform with high visibility and direct impact on our product and engineers.
   

  

 Cutting\-Edge Technology: Work with a world\-class team on one of the most advanced AI stacks in the industry.
   

  

 Autonomy and Growth: We trust you to make technical decisions. This is a greenfield opportunity to build something remarkable from the ground up.
   

  

 Competitive compensation, including equity, excellent benefits, and a flexible work environment.
   

  

 How to Apply: If you are a versatile engineer who loves to build scalable systems and wants to use those skills to power the future of AI, we want to hear from you.
   

  

 Base Salary Range:
   

  

 Base Pay Range

 Please note that in order to be considered an applicant for any position at SambaNova Systems, you must submit an application form for each position for which you believe you are qualified.

 SambaNova Systems is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard basis of age (40 and over), color, disability, gender identity, genetic information, marital status, military or veteran status, national origin/ancestry, race, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding), sexual orientation, and any other applicable status protected by federal, state, or local laws.

title: Hardware & Network Engineer
description:
Job Description: Hardware \& Network EngineerRole Summary

We are looking for a Hardware \& Network Engineer to provide technical support for computer hardware, networking, and IT infrastructure. The candidate will be responsible for troubleshooting hardware issues, maintaining network connectivity, installing and configuring IT devices, and providing on\-site or remote technical support.

Key Responsibilities

* Install, configure, and troubleshoot desktops, laptops, printers, scanners, and other IT hardware.
* Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, and operating system\-related issues.
* Install and configure LAN/WAN network devices and troubleshoot network connectivity issues.
* Basic configuration and troubleshooting of switches, routers, Wi\-Fi devices, and access points.
* Manage LAN cabling, patch panels, and network points.
* Troubleshoot IP address, DNS, DHCP, and basic TCP/IP\-related issues.
* Perform Windows installation, OS configuration, driver installation, and system updates.
* Configure and troubleshoot printers and other peripheral devices.
* Perform preventive maintenance of IT hardware and network equipment.
* Maintain IT asset records and technical documentation.
* Provide on\-site and remote technical support to users.
* Coordinate with vendors and service providers for hardware and network\-related issues.
* Follow IT security, backup, and maintenance procedures.

Required Skills

* Good knowledge of computer hardware and troubleshooting.
* Basic knowledge of LAN/WAN and networking concepts.
* Knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, and IP addressing.
* Basic knowledge of routers, switches, Wi\-Fi, and network cabling.
* Good knowledge of Windows operating systems.
* Ability to troubleshoot desktop, laptop, printer, and peripheral issues.
* Good communication and problem\-solving skills.

Qualification

* ITI / Diploma / Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science, Electronics, or a related field.
* CCNA or relevant networking certification is an advantage.

Experience

* 1–3 years of experience in Hardware \& Network Support is preferred.
* Freshers with good technical knowledge may also be considered.

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹18,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

* Debug, test, and optimize application performance.
* Collaborate with UI/UX designers to implement modern, responsive interfaces.

* Work with Git for version control and team collaboration.

* Familiarity with SQL queries and relational databases.
* Understanding of responsive web design principles.
* Basic knowledge of REST APIs and API integration.
* Familiarity with Git or other version control systems.
* Strong logical thinking and debugging skills.
* Willingness to learn new technologies quickly.

Preferred Skills (Good to Have)

* Experience with Laravel or CodeIgniter.

What You Will Learn

* Full Stack Web Development on live projects.
* Database design and optimization.
* API development and third\-party integrations.

* Git\-based collaborative development.
* Agile development practices.
* Code quality, debugging, and deployment processes.

* Mentorship from experienced software engineers and startup founders.
* Hands\-on experience working on real HealthTech products.
* Collaborative, learning\-focused startup environment.

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for curious, self\-driven, and enthusiastic developers who enjoy solving real\-world problems through technology. If you are passionate about web development and want to work on impactful HealthTech products, we'd love to have you on our team.

**Join Eitonics Technologies Pvt. Ltd. and build technology that makes healthcare smarter, more accessible, and more impactful.**

We are looking for a Hardware \& Network Engineer to provide technical support for computer hardware, networking, and IT infrastructure. The candidate will be responsible for troubleshooting hardware issues, maintaining network connectivity, installing and configuring IT devices, and providing on\-site or remote technical support.

Key Responsibilities

* Install, configure, and troubleshoot desktops, laptops, printers, scanners, and other IT hardware.
* Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, and operating system\-related issues.
* Install and configure LAN/WAN network devices and troubleshoot network connectivity issues.
* Basic configuration and troubleshooting of switches, routers, Wi\-Fi devices, and access points.
* Manage LAN cabling, patch panels, and network points.
* Troubleshoot IP address, DNS, DHCP, and basic TCP/IP\-related issues.
* Perform Windows installation, OS configuration, driver installation, and system updates.
* Configure and troubleshoot printers and other peripheral devices.
* Perform preventive maintenance of IT hardware and network equipment.
* Maintain IT asset records and technical documentation.
* Provide on\-site and remote technical support to users.
* Coordinate with vendors and service providers for hardware and network\-related issues.
* Follow IT security, backup, and maintenance procedures.

Required Skills

* Good knowledge of computer hardware and troubleshooting.
* Basic knowledge of LAN/WAN and networking concepts.
* Knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, and IP addressing.
* Basic knowledge of routers, switches, Wi\-Fi, and network cabling.
* Good knowledge of Windows operating systems.
* Ability to troubleshoot desktop, laptop, printer, and peripheral issues.
* Good communication and problem\-solving skills.

Qualification

* ITI / Diploma / Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science, Electronics, or a related field.
* CCNA or relevant networking certification is an advantage.

Experience

* 1–3 years of experience in Hardware \& Network Support is preferred.
* Freshers with good technical knowledge may also be considered.

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹18,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

Evoque is a brand and marketing consulting firm that works directly with founders to identify where their business stands in its growth journey, and then builds and executes the marketing strategy to take them to the next stage. We operate as a fractional CMO for our clients — assembling the right capabilities around each brand's specific needs, and evolving that scope as the business grows. We're looking for a full\-time Sales \& Marketing Professional to join Evoque and work closely with the founder across client accounts. **What You'll Gain**

**About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**


  

**Blue Dart Express Limited**, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.


Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.


We are proud to be consistently ranked among **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work**, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an **Employer of Choice** is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.


If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, **Blue Dart is where you belong**. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.


**Position Overview:**


  

The **Territory Service Representative (TSR) – Operations** is responsible for the timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within an assigned territory while delivering a superior customer experience and representing the Blue Dart brand with professionalism.


Operating as the face of Blue Dart on the ground, the role ensures safe handling of shipments, timely collections and deliveries, accurate shipment scanning, COD collections, proof of delivery (POD) compliance and adherence to operational procedures. The TSR works closely with the Shift In\-charge and branch operations team to ensure service commitments are consistently achieved while maintaining the highest standards of safety, customer service and operational discipline.


**Job Purpose:**


  

To execute timely pickup and delivery of shipments, ensure accurate shipment handling, customer interactions and COD collections while adhering to Blue Dart's operational standards, safety requirements and service commitments.


**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**


  

**Pickup \& Delivery Operations**

* Perform timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within the assigned route or territory.
* Ensure all shipments are delivered within committed service timelines.
* Verify shipment details before pickup and delivery.
* Handle shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.

**Customer Service Excellence**

**COD \& Documentation Management**

**Operational Compliance**

* Ensure shipment status updates are completed in real time.
* Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) during pickup and delivery activities.
* Adhere to company policies relating to shipment handling, documentation and customer interaction.
* Support operational requirements during peak business periods.

**Safety \& Security**

* Follow all road safety guidelines while operating company or personal vehicles.
* Ensure safe handling and security of customer shipments throughout transit.
* Wear the prescribed company uniform and personal protective equipment wherever applicable.
* Report accidents, incidents or unsafe conditions immediately.
* Protect company assets and customer property.

**Vehicle \& Asset Responsibility**

* Maintain the assigned vehicle or personal two\-wheeler in roadworthy condition.
* Ensure all statutory vehicle documents remain valid.
* Maintain cleanliness and basic upkeep of the vehicle.
* Report maintenance requirements promptly.

**Workplace Discipline \& Brand Representation**

* Maintain high standards of personal grooming, hygiene and professional appearance.
* Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.
* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.
* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.
* Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.

**Team Collaboration**

* Work closely with Shift In\-charges and branch operations teams.
* Support colleagues during operational contingencies.
* Participate in operational briefings and safety meetings.
* Contribute towards achieving branch productivity and service goals.


**Qualifications \& Experience:**

title: Bakers Assistant
description:
About Paoroti

Paoroti is a cloud kitchen based in Guwahati, Assam, specialising in artisan dairy\-free baked goods. Our menu includes focaccia slabs, chocolate walnut babka, sourdough discard muffins, vegan brownies, and enriched brioche — all crafted to a high, consistent standard for delivery channels.

We are a small, quality\-first team. Every person we hire directly shapes the product our customers receive. These two roles — Head Baker and Line Baker — are the heart of the kitchen.

POSITION DETAILS:

Bakers assistant(intern)

The Line Baker supports the Head Baker in daily production. This is a hands\-on execution role — following recipes precisely, keeping the kitchen clean and organised, and ensuring nothing runs behind. We are hiring two people in this role.

**Reports To**

Head Baker

**No. of Positions**

2 (two Line Bakers)

**Location**

Shared commercial kitchen, Guwahati

**Working Hours**

Early morning start (typically 5:00 AM – 2:00 PM); 6 days/week

**Salary Range**

₹15,000 – ₹18,000 per month (based on skill level)

Core Responsibilities

* Assist the Head Baker with all stages of production: weighing, mixing, shaping, proofing, baking, and cooling
* Follow recipes exactly as written — no improvising without instruction from the Head Baker
* Prepare and organise all mise en place before the production day begins
* Monitor baking times and oven temperatures, flagging any issues immediately
* Keep the kitchen clean and organised throughout the shift — clean\-as\-you\-go at all times
* Assist with receiving and storing ingredient deliveries correctly
* Support the Packaging \& QC staff during peak order periods if needed
* Follow all food safety and hygiene protocols without exception

Essential Qualities — What We Are Looking For

**Quality / Trait**

**What to Look For**

**Willingness to Learn**

This role does not require an expert baker — but it does require someone genuinely eager to improve their skills. We will train the right person. A growth mindset matters more than a long CV here.

**Recipe Discipline**

Must be able to follow a written recipe precisely and accurately. Baking is unforgiving of guesswork. We need someone who weighs, measures, and follows timings without shortcuts.

**Physical Stamina**

Kitchen work is physically demanding: long hours on your feet, early mornings, lifting trays, and working near hot ovens. The candidate should be fit and comfortable in this environment.

**Punctuality \& Discipline**

Production schedules are tight. A line baker who is regularly late or absent disrupts the entire day’s output. Reliability is essential.

**Attention to Detail**

Noticing that a dough hasn’t proofed correctly, that a brownie tray is overbaking, or that an ingredient is running low — these small observations make a big difference in a small kitchen.

**Team Player**

This person works closely with the Head Baker and one other Line Baker all day. A positive, cooperative attitude and willingness to take direction without friction is important.

**Hygiene Habits**

Food safety must be taken seriously. Clean hands, tied\-back hair, no jewellery, and careful handling of allergen\-sensitive ingredients (especially in a dairy\-free kitchen).

**Curiosity About Food**

We want people who are interested in what they’re making — who taste the batter, ask why a dough needs this amount of proofing, and care about the final product. Passion beats indifference every time.

Qualifications \& Experience

**Requirement**

**Experience**

0–2 years. Freshers with genuine interest in baking are welcome. Prior experience at a bakery, hotel kitchen, or food production unit is an advantage but not required.

**Education**

No formal qualification required. A short baking course, diploma, or FCI/IHM training is a bonus. Practical aptitude matters more than certificates at this level.

**Basic Kitchen Skills**

Should understand basic kitchen hygiene, be able to use weighing scales accurately, and be comfortable around commercial ovens and mixers.

**Language**

Assamese or Hindi required. Basic communication skills sufficient — ability to read a recipe card and follow spoken instructions.

**Location**

Must be based in or easily commutable to the kitchen location in Guwahati. Early morning start means proximity matters.

What We Will Train You In

We do not expect Line Bakers to arrive knowing everything. Here is what Paoroti will actively teach the right candidate:

* Vegan baking techniques — working with plant\-based butters, milks, and tofu
* Artisan bread fundamentals — dough handling, fermentation, shaping, and scoring
* Our specific product recipes and quality standards
* FSSAI food safety and hygiene compliance
* Kitchen organisation and production flow for a cloud kitchen environment

title: Customer Service Executive
description:
**Customer Service Representative**

**Retailer \& Distributor Support \| Post\-Onboarding \| Voice \+ Chat**

**Role:** Customer Service Representative (CSR) — Retailer \& Distributor Support **Type:** Full\-time **Experience:** 0–3 years. Freshers with strong communication welcome; prior customer\-support / tele\-calling / field\-support experience is a plus **Languages:** Telugu \+ Hindi/Hinglish required; English for internal coordination **Reports to:** Sales Manager

**About the Company**

We power a buyer app on an ONDC\-backed B2B commerce platform that lets kirana (neighbourhood) stores place orders to all the distributors in their area from a single app, instead of waiting for salesmen or travelling to wholesalers.

The platform is live with thousands of retailers and dozens of brands onboarded, and is expanding to additional cities. As we onboard thousands more shopkeepers and distributors, they need fast, patient, reliable support — and that's where you come in.

**The Role, in One Line**

You keep retailers and distributors happy after they join.

When a kirana owner or a distributor has a question or a problem — an order, a scheme, a delivery, an app issue — you're the person who picks up, understands it in their own language, solves it or gets it solved, and closes the loop quickly.

**Who You'll Support**

**Kirana Retailers (Customers)**

* How to place an order, minimum order value (MOV) and beat\-day rules
* Order status, delivery timing and "order not delivered" issues
* Scheme, pricing and offer questions
* App help — login, catalogue, payments
* Complaints about wrong / short / damaged items

**Distributors**

* Accepting, processing and fulfilling retailer orders on the app
* Delivery and service\-level follow\-ups
* Scheme / margin / billing clarifications
* App and account issues
* Escalations that need coordination with internal teams

**What You'll Do**

* Handle inbound and outbound queries via calls, WhatsApp and chat — patiently and in the customer's own language.
* Provide post\-onboarding support to shopkeepers and distributors after they're onboarded — helping them place their first orders, understand MOV and beat\-day rules, and get comfortable with the app.
* Resolve order, delivery, scheme, pricing, billing and app issues — solving what you can directly and escalating the rest to the right internal team.
* Coordinate between retailer and distributor when an order isn't fulfilled on time — follow up with the distributor and internal teams so the retailer isn't left waiting (standard is to resolve retailer issues within 12 hours).
* Log every interaction accurately in the CRM / ticketing system — status, resolution and follow\-ups — so nothing falls through the cracks.
* Escalate genuine or repeat issues to the operations, tech or distributor\-management teams with clear notes so they're resolved fast.
* Proactively guide retailers and distributors about updates, schemes and best practices, turning support conversations into stickier, more active users.
* Share ground\-level feedback (common complaints, recurring app problems, delivery gaps) back to the team so root causes get fixed, not just tickets.

**Key Result Areas (KRAs)**

* Resolve retailer and distributor issues within the agreed timeline (12\-hour standard for retailer issues).
* Maintain high first\-contact resolution and low repeat\-complaint rates.
* Keep customer satisfaction (CSAT) high across both retailers and distributors.
* Ensure every interaction is logged accurately and followed up to closure.
* Drive post\-onboarding activation — help newly onboarded stores actually start ordering.

**Who We're Looking For**

The most important thing is that you're a clear, patient communicator who can win the trust of a kirana owner or distributor who may not be very tech\-savvy.

* **Education:** Any graduate (or final\-year). Degree/college tier is not a barrier — communication and attitude matter most.
* **Language:** Fluent in Telugu and Hindi/Hinglish, able to explain things simply in everyday shopkeeper language — no jargon. English for internal coordination.
* **Temperament:** Patient, warm and calm under pressure — you can handle a frustrated shopkeeper without losing your cool.
* **Tech comfort:** Comfortable using a smartphone, apps, WhatsApp and basic computer/CRM tools; able to learn systems quickly.
* **Ownership:** You take ownership of a problem until it's actually solved — you don't just pass it on and forget.
* **Organised:** Clear note\-taking, accurate logging and reliable follow\-through.

**Nice to Have (Not Required)**

* Prior experience in customer support, call centre, tele\-sales, or field support — ideally in FMCG, retail, fintech or B2B apps.
* Familiarity with kirana / general trade, distributors, or ONDC.

**What You'll Get**

* A front\-row seat in a fast\-growing, government\-backed (ONDC) commerce platform scaling across India.
* Training on the product, processes and support tools.
* Direct impact — your work decides whether thousands of shopkeepers stay and grow with the platform.

Growth paths into team\-lead, quality, operations or key\-account roles for strong performers.

Pay: From ₹23,000\.00 per month

title: Network Engineer
description:
* Position Summary


 The Level 1 (L1\) Network Engineer is responsible for providing first\-level technical support for network infrastructure. This role involves continuous monitoring of network systems, handling initial troubleshooting of network\-related incidents, logging and managing support tickets, and escalating unresolved issues to higher\-level support teams (L2/L3\) in accordance with defined procedures and service\-level agreements (SLAs).
   

  

* Key Responsibilities


**2\.1 Network Monitoring and Operations**
* Monitor network performance, availability, and alerts using network monitoring tools.
* Identify and respond to basic network issues such as link failures, latency, packet loss, and device reachability problems.
* Perform routine health checks of network devices and links.


**2\.2 Incident and Ticket Management**
* Log incidents and service requests in the ticketing system with accurate details.
* Perform first\-level diagnosis and resolution of reported network issues.
* Escalate incidents to L2/L3 teams as per escalation matrix and SLA requirements.
* Track incidents through resolution and provide regular status updates.


**2\.3 Troubleshooting and Support**
* Conduct basic troubleshooting for LAN, WAN, Wi\-Fi, and VPN connectivity issues.
* Verify physical connections including cables, ports, power status, and link indicators.
* Assist users with basic network\-related issues such as IP conflicts, DNS resolution problems, and connectivity loss.


**2\.4 Network Configuration Support**
* Verify IP addressing, VLAN assignments, DHCP, and DNS settings.
* Execute predefined configuration changes under supervision or SOPs.


**2\.5 Documentation and Reporting**
* Maintain incident reports, network diagrams, and SOP updates.
* Prepare daily shift and handover reports.
* Required Technical Skills
* OSI \& TCP/IP models
* LAN/WAN fundamentals
* IP addressing and subnetting
* VLAN, routing, and switching basics
* DNS, DHCP, ARP, ICMP
* Educational Qualifications
* Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or related field.
* Certifications (Preferred)
* CCNA
* CompTIA Network\+ or Any equivalent entry\-level networking certification
* Soft Skills
* Good communication skills
* Willingness to work in 24/7 shifts
* Team collaboration

**AI Digital Marketing Executive**

**About Metaphi**

Metaphi Innovations Pvt. Ltd. is an AI\-first technology company helping businesses accelerate their digital transformation through custom software development, Enterprise AI Solutions, Business Applications (ERP), Cloud \& Data Engineering, and SaaS Products.

Our mission is to build technology that solves real business problems while creating exceptional customer experiences. We work with startups, SMEs, and enterprises across multiple industries, delivering scalable digital products and business solutions.

At Metaphi, we believe Artificial Intelligence is not just another tool—it is an essential part of how modern businesses operate. Every team member is expected to leverage AI to improve productivity, creativity, decision\-making, and quality of work.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an enthusiastic, creative, AI\-first Digital Marketing Executive / Intern who will help build Metaphi's brand, create high\-quality content, manage our digital presence, and support lead generation through organic digital marketing.

This role combines content marketing, SEO, social media, website management, creative design, video editing, branding, and marketing analytics into one growth\-oriented position.

If you enjoy writing, storytelling, designing, creating videos, experimenting with AI, and learning how technology businesses grow, this role offers an excellent opportunity to build a career in modern B2B digital marketing.

You will be part of the Business Development Team, working from our Mumbai Office based out in Ghatkopar East. from Monday to Saturday \- 930am to 630pm, 2nd \& 4th Saturdays will be holiday.

**AKSQubit Technologies** is hiring **Mechanical Engineering Freshers** for multiple opportunities in **Mechanical Design, Production, and Quality Control**.

* Understanding of engineering drawings and basic **GD\&T**

* Preparation of inspection reports

**Preferred Skills**

* Strong technical aptitude and problem\-solving skills
* Good communication and teamwork
* Willingness to learn and work in a hands\-on manufacturing environment
* Basic knowledge of **MS Office**
* Attention to detail and commitment to quality

* Customized Mechanical Product Development

* Robotics and AGV Platforms

description:
**Job Title: Business Development** 

**Location:** Sector 83, Mohali

**Position:** Business Development Executive

**About Us:** 

Offshore Marketers is a data\-driven digital marketing agency focused on delivering performance\-oriented solutions across SEO, paid ads, funnels, and automation. We are currently seeking a **Business Development Executive** who can bridge business needs with technical execution, helping us scale smarter and drive growth using insights, systems, and strategy.

**Role Overview:**

As a Business Developer, you will work closely with cross\-functional teams—including marketing, sales, and tech—to identify business opportunities, optimize workflows, and support data\-driven decision\-making. This role is ideal for someone who understands digital marketing ecosystems and wants to contribute strategically to business and product development.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Business Requirement Gathering:** Work with stakeholders to collect, define, and translate business needs into functional requirements and project documentation.
* **Lead Funnel Analysis:** Analyze lead generation funnels and user journeys to identify bottlenecks, conversion drop\-offs, and opportunities for optimization using tools like Google Analytics, Hotjar, and CRM dashboards.
* **Lead Generation \& Revenue Contribution:** Strategically identify and utilize various online portals to generate qualified leads, nurture opportunities, and contribute directly to the company’s revenue pipeline.
* **Client Needs Mapping:** Conduct discovery calls and align client objectives with internal capabilities, translating business goals into measurable KPIs and performance metrics.
* **Market \& Competitive Intelligence:** Perform competitor benchmarking, trend forecasting, and audience segmentation using research platforms and data visualization tools.
* **Proposal \& SOW Documentation:** Create business proposals, technical documentation, and scope of work documents using a structured, data\-backed approach.
* **CRM \& Data Management:** Maintain data integrity within CRM systems (e.g., HubSpot, Zoho), generate reports, and build dashboards to track business development performance.
* **Process Automation Support:** Identify areas for workflow automation using tools like Zapier, Make (Integromat), or CRM\-native automation features.
* **Cross\-Team Collaboration:** Act as the liaison between business, marketing, and technical teams to ensure successful implementation of growth and campaign strategies.

**Technical \& Core Skills Required:**

* **Basic Analytical Tools:** Good knowledge of Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets for reporting and simple data analysis (e.g., filters, charts, basic formulas).
* **CRM Familiarity:** Hands\-on experience or basic understanding of any CRM platform like Zoho, HubSpot, or GoHighLevel to manage leads and track client interactions.
* **Digital Marketing Awareness:** General understanding of how online funnels, paid ads, and email campaigns work. Experience working with teams using tools like MailerLite, Meta Ads Manager, or Systeme.io is a plus.
* **Documentation Skills:** Ability to create structured documents such as client briefs, simple reports, and workflow outlines using MS Word, Google Docs, or Notion.
* **Communication:** Strong verbal and written communication skills for coordinating with team members and presenting findings or suggestions clearly.
* **Problem Solving:** Ability to identify issues, think critically, and suggest practical solutions based on available data.
* **Organizational Tools:** Comfortable using basic project management tools like Trello, ClickUp, or Google Calendar to manage tasks and timelines.

title: Assistant Quality Manager
description:
**About Role:**

To lead and manage the Quality Management System (QMS), Quality Control activities, Internal Audits, Non\-Conformance Management, Customer Complaint Handling, KPI Monitoring, and EHS compliance to ensure organizational quality objectives, regulatory compliance, operational excellence, and customer satisfaction.

**Key Roles \& Responsibilities**

**1\. Quality Management System (QMS)**

* Develop, implement, maintain, and continuously improve the Quality Management System.
* Ensure compliance with AS9120, EMS, OH\&S, customer, and regulatory requirements.
* Define and monitor departmental quality objectives aligned with organizational goals.
* Drive continual improvement initiatives across departments.

**2\. Quality Planning \& Risk Management**

* Prepare quality plans for new projects, products, and operational activities.
* Conduct risk assessments and identify mitigation strategies for quality\-related risks.
* Monitor process effectiveness and implement preventive measures.
* Ensure root cause analysis and corrective actions are effectively implemented.

**3\. Document Control \& Compliance**

* Manage quality documentation including SOPs, Work Instructions, Policies, Procedures, Formats, and Records.
* Ensure proper version control, approval, revision tracking, and accessibility of documents.
* Maintain centralized document control systems and ensure confidentiality where applicable.

**4\. Quality Control Operations**

* Oversee Incoming Material Inspection, In\-Process Inspection, and Final Product Inspection activities.
* Ensure products and materials comply with customer specifications and quality standards.
* Monitor inspection reports, test records, and quality data.
* Ensure timely identification and resolution of quality deviations.

**5\. Internal Audit Management**

* Prepare and execute annual internal audit plans and schedules.
* Conduct internal audits for Quality and EHS Management Systems.
* Review previous audit findings and pending non\-conformances.
* Issue audit reports, observations, and non\-conformance reports.
* Ensure timely closure and effectiveness of corrective actions.

**6\. Non\-Conformance \& Corrective Action Management**

* Lead investigation of non\-conformance incidents and customer complaints.
* Conduct root cause analysis using quality tools and methodologies.
* Implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
* Monitor effectiveness of corrective actions and prevent recurrence.
* Coordinate with internal departments, suppliers, customers, and external agencies for resolution.

**7\. Customer Complaint \& Quality Issue Handling**

* Manage customer quality concerns, complaints, feedback, and technical queries.
* Coordinate Return Material Authorization (RMA), scrap approvals, and customer notifications.
* Ensure complaint closure within defined timelines.
* Maintain customer satisfaction through timely communication and resolution.
* Prepare and share investigation and corrective action reports with customers when required.

**8\. Management Review Meeting (MRM)**

* Plan and conduct Management Review Meetings as per defined frequency.
* Prepare agendas, reports, presentations, and MOMs for review meetings.
* Monitor action items, target dates, and status updates.
* Escalate delays or critical quality issues to management.

**9\. KPI, MIS \& Performance Monitoring**

* Review departmental MIS reports and KPIs regularly.
* Identify performance gaps, deviations, and process inefficiencies.
* Raise non\-conformance where KPI targets are not achieved.
* Recommend process improvements and revised performance targets.

**10\. EHS Management Support**

* Monitor EMS and OH\&S related reports and KPIs.
* Ensure compliance with EHS requirements and reporting systems.
* Coordinate with Safety Officer and management on deviations and corrective actions.

**11\. Training \& Awareness**

* Conduct Quality, AS9120, EMS, and OH\&S awareness programs.
* Lead employee training related to quality systems and compliance.
* Promote organizational knowledge sharing and quality awareness culture.
* Support induction training for new employees

Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent, Fresher

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹35,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Commuter assistance

* Do you have hands\-on experience working with Quality Management Standards such as AS9120, AS9100, ISO 9001, ISO 14001 (EMS), or ISO 45001 (OH\&S)?
* The salary for the given role is 30,000\-35,000\. Apply only if comfortable with the given salary

* Verify customer KYC, financial, property, and business documents.
* Match every document against the lender's checklist before file submission.
* Identify missing, expired, incorrect, or inconsistent documents.

* Monitor customer satisfaction and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Develop strategies to increase customer retention and loyalty.
* Prepare periodic reports on customer interactions, feedback, and account status.
* Identify opportunities for upselling and cross\-selling products or services.
* Conduct regular customer meetings and follow\-up calls.

Required Qualifications

* 1–3 years of experience in customer relationship management, sales, or customer service (freshers with excellent communication skills may also be considered).
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Excellent interpersonal and problem\-solving abilities.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and CRM software (e.g., Salesforce, Zoho CRM, HubSpot, or similar).
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Preferred Skills

* Customer\-centric mindset.
* Negotiation and conflict\-resolution skills.
* Analytical and reporting abilities.
* Multitasking and adaptability.
* Knowledge of sales and customer retention strategies.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Customer satisfaction (CSAT) score.
* Customer retention rate.
* Response and resolution time.
* Client engagement and follow\-up effectiveness.

Department

As Assigned

We are looking for a passionate and detail\-oriented **Junior Ink Chemist** to join our R\&D team. The ideal candidate should have a strong academic foundation in Chemistry and a keen interest in ink formulation, color science, and chemical manufacturing. Freshers with an **M.Sc. in Chemistry** are encouraged to apply. The selected candidate will receive on\-the\-job training in ink formulation, quality testing, and production support.

Production Support

* Support troubleshooting of product quality issues.

Documentation

* Maintain formulation records, laboratory notebooks, and test reports.
* Prepare technical documentation and sample reports.
* Follow SOPs and maintain compliance with quality standards.

Safety \& Compliance

* Follow all laboratory safety procedures and chemical handling guidelines.
* Use Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) at all times.
* Ensure proper storage and handling of chemicals.

* Specialization in Organic, Industrial, Polymer, Analytical, or Applied Chemistry will be preferred.

Experience

* **0–1 year (Freshers are welcome).**
* Internship or academic project in paints, inks, coatings, polymers, or specialty chemicals will be an added advantage.

Required Skills

* Strong understanding of chemistry fundamentals.
* Basic knowledge of laboratory techniques and analytical instruments.
* Good observation and documentation skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Willingness to learn ink formulation and manufacturing processes.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and MS Word.
* Good communication and teamwork skills.

Preferred Knowledge

* Basic understanding of pigments, dyes, resins, solvents, and additives.
* Familiarity with quality testing procedures.
* Knowledge of laboratory safety practices.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Accuracy of laboratory testing and documentation.
* Learning and adaptation to formulation processes.
* Timely completion of assigned laboratory trials.
* Compliance with safety and quality procedures.
* Contribution to successful product development and production support.
* Attendance, discipline, and teamwork.

Career Growth

The selected candidate will undergo structured training in ink formulation, quality assurance, and manufacturing processes. Based on performance, the employee can progress to:

* Ink Chemist
* Senior Ink Chemist
* R\&D Executive
* Product Development Chemist
* Technical Service Chemist

Compensation \& Benefits

* On\-the\-job technical training.
* Career growth opportunities in R\&D and manufacturing.
* PF, ESIC (as applicable), leave benefits, and other company benefits.

description:
**About Uptrail** 




 Uptrail is a UK\-based career accelerator helping students and early\-career professionals break into the tech industry through hands\-on, real\-world programmes in data, software development, cyber security, and cloud engineering. We work with learners globally and are growing our internal team to support an expanding talent pipeline.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for a motivated HR Recruiter \& Outreach Intern to join our remote team and support our end\-to\-end recruitment process. This is a full\-time, hands\-on role suited to fresh graduates or final\-year students with an interest in human resources, talent acquisition, or people operations. You will work directly with our recruitment team, handling candidate screening calls, outreaching prospects, maintaining applicant records, and supporting hiring coordination across active roles.
 



  





**Duration:** 
 3 months
 



**Stipend:** 
 ₹1,000 per month
 



**Work arrangement:** 
 Fully remote
 



**Job type:** 
 Internship (Part\-Time)
 



**Location:** 
 Bengaluru, India
 



  





 Performance\-based opportunity: Interns who demonstrate strong performance during the 3\-month period will be considered for a full\-time HR Recruiter role at Uptrail.
 



  





**What You Will Do** 




 \- Conduct initial screening calls with candidates to assess communication skills, availability, and basic role fit
 



 \- Maintain and update the applicant tracker with accurate candidate information and screening outcomes
 



 \- Coordinate interview schedules between candidates and the hiring team
 



 \- Send timely communications to candidates regarding application status and next steps
 



 \- Support the team in posting and monitoring job advertisements across platforms
 



 \- Assist with shortlisting candidates based on role requirements shared by the hiring team
 



 \- Maintain organised records of all recruitment activity using Excel or Google Sheets
 



 \- Support general HR operations and coordination tasks as required
 



  





**Who We Are Looking For** 




 \- Recent graduate or final\-year student in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field
 



 \- No prior work experience required — fresh graduates are encouraged to apply
 



 \- Confident and professional verbal communication skills in English
 



 \- Comfortable conducting calls and interacting with candidates from diverse backgrounds
 



 \- Highly organised with strong attention to detail
 



 \- Proficient in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets
 



 \- Ability to manage multiple tasks and maintain accuracy under a fast\-paced environment
 



 \- Genuine interest in recruitment, talent acquisition, or HR operations
 



  





**What You Will Gain** 




 \- Hands\-on experience in end\-to\-end recruitment at a growing international startup
 



 \- Practical exposure to candidate screening, interview coordination, and applicant tracking
 



 \- Experience working with modern remote\-work and HR tools
 



 \- Certificate of completion and reference letter upon successful completion
 



 \- Performance\-based opportunity to join Uptrail full\-time as an HR Recruiter
 



  





**Equal Opportunity** 




 Uptrail is committed to building an inclusive team. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, disciplines, and experiences.
