title: BCG X APAC Talent Manager – X Delivery
description:
Who We Are


Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.  

  

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

  

What You'll Do


As BCG X continues to scale across Asia Pacific, we are seeking a Talent Manager – X Delivery based in Gurugram to lead staffing and talent deployment for our Build \& Analytics population.

  

This role sits within the AP Staffing \& People function, reporting into the X AP Staffing Director, and is accountable for delivering high\-quality staffing outcomes while shaping talent strategy for X Delivery.  

You will operate as a regional staffing leader for X Delivery, balancing business demand, client priorities, and individual development goals. In parallel, you will lead a small team and drive continuous improvement across staffing processes, insights, and workforce planning.

 **Key responsibilities include:**

  

Staffing and Deployment Leadership

* Own end\-to\-end staffing outcomes for BCG X Delivery (Build \& Analytics) across AP, ensuring optimal deployment aligned to business priorities and individual development goals
* Drive demand–supply matching across projects, proposals, and internal initiatives, making clear, high\-quality staffing decisions
* Maintain a forward\-looking view of the staffing pipeline (short\- and long\-term), identifying risks and opportunities early
* Partner with senior stakeholders (X Delivery leadership, case teams, product teams) to align on priorities, staffing trade\-offs, and resource allocation
* Ensure strong governance of staffing decisions, including fairness, diversity considerations, and transparency
* Act as the primary point of contact for talent, providing guidance on staffing choices and career development trade\-offs.


Talent Development \& Experience

* Embed development priorities into staffing decisions, ensuring individuals receive opportunities aligned to their growth goals
* Build trusted relationships with engineers, analysts, and product talent to understand preferences, strengths, and development areas
* Reinforce career development messaging in partnership with People, HR, and CDC stakeholders
* Own onboarding experience for new hires within X Delivery, ensuring strong initial staffing and integration into the business
* Provide input into performance and people discussions, contributing to a consistent and high\-quality talent experience


Strategic Planning \& Insights

* Identify patterns across staffing, skills, and demand to inform workforce planning and hiring priorities
* Provide data\-driven insights to AP leadership on utilization, capacity gaps, and emerging skill needs
* Partner with Recruiting and leadership to shape cohort composition and future talent needs
* Anticipate shifts in business demand and proactively adjust staffing strategies


Team Leadership \& Operations

* Lead and develop a team of 2–3 staffing specialists, driving performance, capability building, and engagement
* Set clear priorities and ensure high\-quality execution across all staffing activities
* Oversee accuracy and transparency of staffing data, systems, and reporting
* Manage escalations and ensure timely resolution of complex staffing challenges


Change Management \& Process Excellence

* Lead the evolution of staffing processes for X Delivery, building scalable and efficient operating models
* Identify inefficiencies and drive simplification, standardization, and automation
* Define and track KPIs to measure staffing effectiveness and continuously improve outcomes
* Drive adoption of new processes and tools through stakeholder alignment, communication, and training

  

What You'll Bring

* Bachelor’s degree
* 8\+ years of experience in staffing, talent management, HR business partnering, or similar roles
* Experience operating in complex, fast\-paced, and stakeholder\-heavy environments
* Interest in digital product development (engineering, analytics, product, design)
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities
* Fluency in English

  

Who You'll Work With

* AP Staffing Director and broader regional staffing leadership
* X Delivery leadership (engineering, analytics, product)
* HR, People \& Development, and CDC stakeholders
* Finance (utilization, approvals, cost allocation)
* Recruiting and L\&D teams

  

Additional info

**YOU’RE GOOD AT**

* Operating effectively in a fast\-paced, global, and highly matrixed environment
* Building trust and influencing stakeholders across seniority levels
* Making high\-quality decisions in ambiguous, trade\-off\-driven environments
* Balancing business needs with individual development priorities
* Communicating clearly and persuasively, both verbally and in writing
* Managing conflict and navigating complex people situations with sound judgment
* Leading and developing teams, creating accountability and engagement
* Using data and insights to inform decisions and drive improvements

  

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

description:
**Job Description**
-------------------


Posted Tuesday, August 4, 2026 at 7:30 PM
**Who We Are**  

Magnit is the future of work. Serving hundreds of the world’s most recognizable brands for the past 30\+ years, Magnit offers the industry’s first holistic platform for the modern workforce. Magnit's integrated workforce management (IWM) platform supported by data, software, intelligence, and best\-in\-class services team is key to our clients’ success. It can adapt quickly to regional or industry economic shifts, and provides the speed, scale, flexibility, transparency, and expertise required to meet an organization’s contingent workforce management, talent strategy and broader organization goals. At Magnit, you’ll work with passionate colleagues who collaborate and deliver meaningful results that positively transform the largest companies around the globe.
**About the Role**
  

We are looking for a proactive and strategic HR Business Partner to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate with wide experience in HR partnering roles, demonstrating excellence in stakeholder management, employee relations, end\-to\-end employment lifecycle operations, strategic workforce support, and HR data\-driven decision\-making. This role will be a critical enabler in driving people priorities, improving employee engagement, and supporting business objectives through analytical insights.
  

**Key Responsibilities**
  

Strategic HR Partnership
  

* Act as a trusted advisor to business leaders and senior stakeholders, providing insights and solutions on people strategies aligned to business goals.
* Support change management processes, organizational effectiveness, and culture\-building activities.
* Provide Consultative services to the line managers on Human Resources initiatives, process, and programs.
* Provides day\-to\-day performance management guidance to line management (e.g., coaching, counselling, career development, disciplinary actions).

Employee Relations \& Lifecycle Management
  

* Manage complex employee relations cases, ensuring fair and consistent application of policies and procedures.
* Provide guidance on grievance handling, disciplinary procedures, and performance management interventions.
* Own and streamline the entire employee lifecycle ensuring positive employee experiences at every stage.
* Drive Engagement programs for the business unit.

* Participates in evaluation and monitoring of training programs to ensure success. Follows up to ensure training objectives are met

Global Stakeholder Management
  

* Build strong, consultative relationships with global business units and internal partners across Talent Acquisition, Learning and Development, and HR operations.
* Actively engage with leadership teams to influence decision\-making through an HR lens.
* Serve as a point of contact for HR escalations, offering pragmatic and compliant solutions.

**HR Analytics and Data Intelligence**
  

* Collect, analyze, and interpret HR metrics (attrition, engagement, headcount, compensation parity, etc.) to guide business decisions.
* Analyzes trends and metrics in partnership with the HR group to develop solutions, programs, and policies.
* Leverage data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI or Excel dashboards) to present actionable insights to leadership.
* Lead regular people metrics reviews and recommend evidence\-based interventions to improve key outcomes.

**Operational Excellence**
  

* Maintains in\-depth knowledge of legal requirements related to day\-to\-day management of employees, reducing legal risks, and ensuring regulatory compliance. Partners with the legal department as needed/required.
* Manages and resolves complex employee relations issues. Conducts effective, thorough, and objective investigations.
* Drive process optimization initiatives to enhance efficiency across HR operations.
* Partner with Payroll, HRIS, and Compliance teams for accurate, timely employee records and reporting.
* Magnit retains the right to change or modify job duties at any time. The above job posting is not all encompassing. Position functions and qualifications may vary depending on business necessity.

**What You Will Need**
  

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in human resources
* Minimum 5\+ years of progressive experience as an HR Business Partner or similar strategic HR role.
* Prior experience supporting diverse business units or matrix organizations is preferred.
* Strong hands\-on experience with HR analytics, reporting tools, and data storytelling.
* Well\-versed with employment laws, HR compliance standards, and best practices.
* Strong stakeholder and relationship management skills.
* Excellent interpersonal, coaching, negotiation, and conflict resolution skills.
* High analytical ability with a focus on data\-driven decision\-making.
* Agile mindset – able to thrive in fast\-paced and changing environments.
* Strong ethical standards, discretion, and professional integrity.

**What Magnit will Offer You**  

  



At Magnit, you’ll be joining an innovative, high\-growth environment and can quickly make an impact to help transform the largest companies in the world. You will work with passionate colleagues who collaborate and deliver. Magnit offers all employees the opportunity for growth and development, and we want individuals to fulfill their potential and blaze their own trails!  

  



Magnit will offer you a competitive PTO and benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, retirement planning, as well as discounts and perks for tickets, travel, merchandise and more! Magnit encourages employees to participate in giving back, and we will match employee contributions to favorite charities and support corporate volunteering hours to make a difference in your community!  

  



**If this role isn’t for you**


Stay in touch, we will let you know when we have new positions on the team.
  

  

To see a complete list of our open career opportunities please visit.


https://magnitglobal.com/us/en/company/careers.html  



  

To do our best work we need different viewpoints. Therefore, we celebrate diversity and embrace inclusion.  



  

As an equal opportunity employer, we are dedicated to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We strive to ensure that we maintain a positive and enriching work environment for all.  



  

By applying to this role, you consent to Magnit safely storing and managing your personal data. Please read this link to learn more.

title: Manager HR
description:
**Job Description**
 Job Description: HR \& Administration Manager
   

  

 Position Title: Manager – HR \& Administration
   

  

 Company: Della Group
   

  

 Location: Daman
   

  

 Employment Type: Full\-Time
   

  

 Department: Human Resources \& Factory Administration
   

  

 Reports To: General Manager / Plant Head \& Corporate HR
   

  

**Job Purpose**
 The HR \& Administration Manager will oversee end\-to\-end plant HR operations, facility administration, and strictly enforce statutory and legal factory compliance at the Daman manufacturing facility. The ideal candidate will act as a bridge between factory operations, employees, corporate HR, and local labor government authorities to ensure smooth, compliant, and productive plant operations.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Factory Statutory \& Labor Compliance (Core Responsibility)
* Ensure 100% adherence to the Factories Act, 1948, Daman \& Diu Factory Rules, and local labor legislation.
* Manage full statutory compliance.
* Prepare, maintain, and audit all mandatory registers (Form 12, Muster Roll, Wage Registers, Accident Registers, etc.).
* Handle periodic returns (monthly, quarterly, annual) and submit them to relevant government departments on time.
* Coordinate with Labor Commissioners, Factory Inspectors, Pollution Control Board (DCC), Fire Authorities, and external legal consultants.
* Oversee third\-party/contractor labor compliance, verifying contractor licenses, wage payouts, PF/ESIC deposits, and monthly compliance certificates before bill clearance.
* Plant HR Operations , Payroll \& Employee Relations
* Manage end\-to\-end plant recruitment for shop floor workers, technical staff, line supervisors, and managerial staff in Daman.
* Oversee timekeeping, shift management, attendance tracking, overtime calculations, and monthly payroll processing for plant personnel.
* Drive employee engagement, grievance handling, and resolve workplace disputes on the shop floor to maintain industrial peace.


**Job Expectations**
* Conduct plant induction, safety training, SOP orientation, and skill development programs.
* Handle disciplinary actions, domestic inquiries, show\-cause notices, charge sheets, and counseling in line with standing orders and labor laws.
* To handle payroll in HRMS ( Sensys) software.
* Factory Administration \& Facilities Management
* Oversee day\-to\-day administration of the factory campus (security, housekeeping, canteen, transportation, pest control, and scrap handling).
* Maintain plant health, safety, and hygiene standards (EHS) in coordination with safety officers and shop floor teams.
* Ensure renewal of factory licenses, trade licenses, fire NOCs, environmental consents (CTO/CTE), and utility connections.
* Supervise security team operations, material inward/outward gate passes, and inventory security protocols.
* Manage vendor contracts, negotiate service terms, and verify monthly admin vendor invoices.


**Qualifications \& Key Requirements**
* Education: MBA / MSW / Master's degree in Human Resource Management or Personnel Management \& Industrial Relations (PM\&IR). A Law degree (LL.B.) is an added advantage.
* Experience: 8–12 years of hands\-on experience in Plant HR \& Administration within a manufacturing environment (Furniture, Woodworking, Interior Joinery, Textiles, Plastics, or Engineering plant experience preferred).
* Location Preference: Candidates residing in or willing to relocate to Daman.


 Skills \& Competencies
   

  

* Statutory Expertise: Deep working knowledge of local Daman factory acts, statutory return submissions, and audit handling.
* Liaisoning: Strong network and experience liaising with local authorities, police, labor boards, and municipal bodies in Daman/Vapi.
* Software Proficiency: Hands\-on experience with HRMS, biometric attendance software, MS Excel, and statutory compliance portals.
* Languages: Fluency in English, Hindi, and Gujarati (crucial for local worker/labor communication)


**Minimum Qualification**
 Relevant Field
   

  

**Minimum Job Experience**
 5\-8 years
   

  

**Reporting To**
 Director
   

  

**Travel**
 As an when required

 Currently seeking an energetic and results\-oriented
 **Total Rewards Specialist**

This position is responsible for thorough execution of AVASO’s recruiting process for assigned searches, and requires an eye for detail, a passion for finding top talent, and an ability to multi\-task in a fast\-paced environment. This is a full\-time role and requires the ability to plan, multi\-task and follow through on assigned tasks.
 



  





  





**What You'll Do** 




**Compensation Administration** 



* Support the annual merit cycle — preparing employee\-level CTC data, working on the data and analysis.
* Assist in salary benchmarking exercises using approved survey sources; maintain salary range tables, grade band schedules, and CTC revision trackers.
* Process salary revisions, promotions, and increments accurately in the HRIS and payroll system.
* Prepare compensation analyses, identify outliers, and flag findings for review by the Senior Specialist or Manager.



  





**Payroll Operations Support** 



* Coordinate monthly payroll inputs: LOP deductions, arrear computations, ad\-hoc allowances, and one\-time payments.
* Validate payroll data for accuracy prior to processing; cross\-check outputs against HRIS records and resolve discrepancies.
* Maintain structured payroll trackers, salary revision logs, and exception registers in Excel.
* Liaise with the Finance team for payroll reconciliation and monthly variance reporting.



  





**Exit Management \& Full and Final Settlement (FNF)** 



* Own end\-to\-end FNF computation for exiting employees.
* Coordinate with HR Operations, Finance, and business units to obtain clearances and validate inputs before FNF is processed.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for employee and ex\-employee queries on FNF, salary arrears, tax deductions, and relieving documentation.
* Maintain a live FNF tracker covering all active cases, status, pending clearances, and disbursement dates.



  





**HR Data Analysis \& Reporting — A Core Part of This Role** 



* We are looking for someone who treats data as a first\-class output. The ability to build, automate analytics clearly is as important as the operational skills in this role.
* Build and maintain Excel\-based dashboards and trackers for headcount cost, payroll variance, and compensation distribution.
* Develop VBA macros to automate repetitive payroll and HR processes, reducing manual effort and improving accuracy.
* Analyse data to identify trends, outliers, and equity issues.
* Proactively flag and resolve data quality issues across all Total Rewards records.



  





**What We're Looking For** 




**Experience** 



* 5–6 years of progressive experience in Total Rewards, Compensation \& Benefits, or HR Operations.
* Demonstrated hands\-on experience in payroll processing, salary revision administration, and FNF management.
* Prior experience in a mid\-to\-large IT services, technology, or global services organisation is preferred.
* Exposure to multi\-country compensation structures is an advantage.



  





**Data \& Analytics Skills — Required** 



* Strong Excel proficiency is a hard requirement for this role — not just data entry or basic formulas.
* Microsoft Excel (Advanced) — VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, INDEX\-MATCH, SUMIFS, Pivot Tables, dynamic dashboards, data validation.
* VBA Macro development for payroll and HR process automation.
* Ability to design structured, formula\-driven workbooks from scratch.



  





**Tools \& Systems** 



* HRIS platforms — SAP SuccessFactors, Darwinbox, Zoho People, or equivalent.
* Payroll systems — working knowledge of payroll processing tools and salary computation logic.
* Microsoft Office Suite — Word and PowerPoint for documentation and reporting.



  





**Education** 



* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Commerce, Business Administration, or a related field — mandatory.
* MBA / PGDM in Human Resources or equivalent postgraduate qualification — preferred.
* Certification in Compensation \& Benefits (WorldatWork CCP, SHRM\-CP, or equivalent) — desirable

**Role Overview :** 




  





 As an AI Solution Analyst – AI Workflows at Zamp.ai, you will operate as a key business partner on the front line. Your primary focus is to deeply understand customer processes, capture workflow requirements, and translate them into precise, high\-quality AI workflows on our platform using our code generation platform.
 



 You will collaborate with internal teams and customers to unpack real operational challenges, formalise problem statements, and ensure the workflows created truly reflect business needs. The role is rooted in business analysis, process understanding, and structured problem\-solving, with a strong emphasis on clarity, accuracy, and customer impact.
 



 At its core, this is a business\-driven role that leverages AI to transform customer operations into reliable, measurable, and scalable workflows.
 



  





**Responsibilities :** 




  




* Workflow Definition \& Implementation: Translate customer and internal business process requirements into workflow specifications, then use our internal AI tooling to generate code and assemble workflow logic and automation.

* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Serve as the critical link between business teams, product \& engineering. Provide feedback on workflow patterns, tool improvement and platform capabilities.
* Customer \& Stakeholder Enablement: Work with customer\-facing teams to onboard workflow solutions, ensure they run smoothly, and support adoption and feedback\-loops.

* Initiative and ownership mindset: you thrive in fast\-moving, ambiguous environments and proactively drive results.
* Strong communication skills and customer orientation: you can translate business needs into technical/solution language and interact effectively across teams.



**Our Culture \& Benefits :** 




  





 At Zamp.ai, we foster a culture of transparency, meritocracy, and empowerment. Join a lean, high\-velocity team where your impact is visible, your work matters, and you’ll grow quickly.
 



  





**Perks include:** 



* Competitive salary \+ stock options with upside.
* Collaborative environment working with top\-tier talent.
* Inclusive and diverse workspace.
* Comprehensive medical insurance for employees, spouse and dependents.
* Continuous learning and development opportunities.
* Office with comfortable work setting and excellent amenities.

 Our platform is a governed, vendor\-agnostic decision layer that deploys inside an any container and reads data with full auditability. It takes a business from what happened and why, to what will happen and what to do next. True, engineered, prescriptive AI infrastructure.
 



  





 We're looking for a one of a kind Data Engineer to be the person who can take any source system, however ugly, and reliably turn it into clean, trusted, production\-grade gold tables. You'll work directly under our Founding Data \& Observability Engineer, building the medallion pipelines our platform runs on.
 



  





 This is hands\-on, detail\-obsessed pipeline craft. We're title\-agnostic: not senior, not founding, but we want someone genuinely outstanding. A superstar early\-career engineer who does this better than people twice their tenure.
 



  





**🔑 The Role** 




  





 You'll own the journey from raw, scrappy source data to clean gold.
 



  




* Building medallion pipelines (bronze, silver, gold) on Databricks with Delta Lake
* Taming inconsistent, undocumented, real\-world data (exports, spreadsheets, semantic models, transactional systems) into something clean and trustworthy
* Writing excellent, performant SQL. Modelling and querying operational data in PostgreSQL
* Tracing every metric back to source so gold tables are auditable and reproducible
* Building pipelines so they are clean to instrument



  





 This is execution at a very high standard. You take direction on what to build, and you nail the how.
 



  





**🧩 Who This Is For** 




  




* High GPA from a top tier Indian University such as IIT, NIT, SRM
* Exceptional at SQL. Non\-negotiable, and how we'll assess you.
* Hands\-on Databricks: Delta Lake and the Lakehouse model
* Solid PostgreSQL experience
* A proven track record of turning scrappy source data into clean medallion gold tables. You've done this before, not just read about it.
* Obsessive about detail and data quality. You sweat the edge cases.
* Scrappy and resourceful. Given a target and clear direction, you find the path to gold.



  





 Nice to have: Python, orchestration (Airflow/Spark), Unity Catalog, Docker/Kubernetes.
 



  





**📍 Role Basics** 




  




* Role: Full\-time Data Engineer
* Location: Remote (India)
* Compensation: Competitive (USD) \+ ESOP options \+ performance\-linked increases
* Start: ASAP



  





**Why Join Unloq?** 




  




* Learn from the best. You'll work directly under a strong senior data engineer on real enterprise deployments, and grow fast.
* Real craft, real ownership. You own the pipelines that take messy data to trusted gold. The numbers leadership decides on start with your work.
* Direct founder access. Small team, big problems, zero bureaucracy.
* Modern stack. Databricks and Anthropic Claude at the core.
* Share options (ESOP).



  





 We're building something that doesn't exist yet: the layer that makes AI trustworthy enough for the boardroom, not just the back office. It's early, it's hard, and the right people find that exciting. If you take pride in clean data done properly, this is your role.

We enable your best to power our future
   

  

**Job Description**
**Nielsen Data Science**
 Nielsen Media is the global leader in measuring what people watch and listen to on TV, Digital and Audio in a changing media landscape. Data Science is essential to Nielsen’s mission. We offer a fast\-paced environment for methodology and software development in a team of world\-class computer scientists, statisticians, data scientists, and behavioral methodologists

 You enjoy bridging the fields of data science, Sampling Analytics, software development, and data engineering. * Identified the AI opportunities in existing and new projects and implemented them.
* Support reproducible data science projects end\-to\-end
* Deploy and maintain data pipelines and models in a production environment
* Work with cross\-functional teams to productionize, validate, and optimize methodologies
* Communicate methodology and research findings to varying audiences
* Support research on methodology changes to cross\-platform audience measurement. The primary research areas include trend analyses, imputing missing data, representation/ sampling, bias reduction, indirect estimation, data integration, and automation.
* Continuous support and development of new projects by exploring the data \- Variable Identification, cleaning the data , applying dimension reduction techniques, calculating distances and integrating the surveys. And also using output evaluation techniques in order to make sure of the accuracy.
* Address quality escapes and fix issues in production code.
* Document new methodologies and code

* Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to develop effective relationships with other team members, including remotely.

Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain.  As a leading food and drug retailer in the United States, Albertsons Companies, Inc. operates over 2,200 stores across 35 states and the District of Columbia. Our well\-known banners across the United States, including Albertsons, Safeway, Vons, Jewel\-Osco and others, serve more than 36 million U.S customers each week. We build and shape technology solutions that solve customers’ problems every day, making things easier for them when they shop with us online or in a store. We have made bold, strategic moves to migrate and modernize our core foundational capabilities, positioning ourselves as the first fully cloud\-based grocery tech company in the industry.
 



 Our success is built on a one\-team approach, driven by the desire to understand and enhance the customer experience. By constantly pushing the boundaries of retail, we are transforming shopping into an experience that is easy, efficient, fun and engaging.
 



  





**About Albertsons Companies India:** 




 At Albertsons Companies India, we're not just pushing the boundaries of technology and retail innovation, we're cultivating a space where ideas flourish and careers thrive. Our workplace in India is a vital extension of the Albertsons Companies Inc. workforce and important to the next phase in the company’s technology journey to support millions of customers’ lives every day.
 



 At the Albertsons Companies India, we are raising the bar to grow across Technology \& Engineering, AI, Digital and other company functions, and transform a 165\-year\-old American retailer. At Albertsons Companies India, associates collaborate directly with international teams, enhancing decision\-making processes and organizational agility through exciting and pivotal projects. Your work will make history and help millions of lives each day come together around the joys of food and inspire their well\-being
 



  





**Engineer Machine Learning** 




**ROLE SUMMARY:** 




 Individual contributor responsible for developing, testing, and supporting machine learning components of the AIOps platform. Works under the guidance of senior engineers to build models, prepare data, and integrate ML services into observability workflows. This is a junior\-to\-mid\-level role requiring 1–3 years of hands\-on experience.
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:** 



* Assist in designing and developing ML models for anomaly detection, alert classification, and forecasting.
* Build and maintain data preprocessing and feature engineering pipelines.
* Support model training, validation, and performance evaluation against defined metrics.
* Integrate ML microservices with observability platforms, APIs, and event systems.
* Monitor model behavior in staging and production environments and report deviations.
* Document model logic, experiments, training parameters, and deployment procedures.
* Collaborate with data, platform, and SRE teams to resolve data quality and inference issues.
* Adopt MLOps best practices for versioning, reproducibility, and code quality.



  





**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field.
* 1–3 years of experience in software engineering, data science, or machine learning.
* Proficiency in Python and common ML libraries (scikit\-learn, Pandas, NumPy).
* Basic understanding of the ML lifecycle: training, validation, inference, and evaluation.
* Familiarity with SQL and relational data manipulation.
* Exposure to REST APIs, microservices concepts, and Git version control.



  





**MANDATORY SKILLS:** 



* Python programming for data science and machine learning
* scikit\-learn, Pandas, NumPy, and foundational feature engineering
* SQL and relational data querying for analysis and feature extraction
* Data preprocessing, cleaning, and exploratory data analysis
* Basic model training, validation, and evaluation metrics (precision, recall, RMSE, etc.)
* REST API integration and Git\-based collaborative development
* Docker fundamentals and containerized local development
* Understanding of observability data types: logs, metrics, traces, and alerts



  





**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:** 



* Exposure to deep learning frameworks (PyTorch or TensorFlow).
* Experience with time\-series analysis or statistical anomaly detection.
* Familiarity with MLOps tools (MLflow, Kubeflow) and CI/CD pipelines.
* Knowledge of OpenTelemetry and monitoring platforms such as Grafana or Prometheus.
* Experience with NoSQL databases or vector stores.
* Coursework or certifications in machine learning, statistics, or cloud technologies.



  





**KEY SKILLS:** 



* Python, scikit\-learn, Pandas, SQL
* Data preprocessing, feature engineering, model evaluation
* REST APIs, Docker, Git, observability fundamentals

title: Support Engineer 1 - Data Science
description:
**Overview**
* Join one of the world’s leading AI\-driven supply chain solutions companies, recognized by Glassdoor as one of the “Best Places to Work.”
* We are looking for a skilled individual with a strong foundation in statistical and analytical methods, who can also collaborate effectively with teams during deployment and operational phases.
* Expertise in implementing industry best practices is a plus.


**Scope**
* As a Support Engineer, you will be a key player in onboarding clients onto Blue Yonder’s Luminate Planning suite of solutions and providing ongoing support through our Data Science as a Service (DSaaS) offering.
* Our team currently consists of approximately 50 associates in India, part of a larger global team spanning the US and Germany, and is poised for rapid growth.
* Strong communication and leadership abilities are essential, as you will mentor junior team members.


**What You’ll Do**
* Select, build, and optimize classifiers using advanced machine learning techniques.
* Conduct data mining using cutting\-edge methods and tools.
* Integrate third\-party data sources to enhance the company’s datasets when necessary.
* Refine data collection procedures to ensure relevant data is available for analytic systems.
* Process, cleanse, and verify the integrity of data used for analysis.
* Perform ad\-hoc analysis and present results clearly to stakeholders.
* Address customer concerns regarding forecasting issues and data quality, and build utilities to perform forecasting checks.


**What We Are Looking For**
* Solid understanding of machine learning algorithms (e.g., Linear Regression, K\-Means Clustering, Naive Bayes).
* Proficiency in data science toolkits such as Python, NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib, Seaborn (expertise in at least two is required).
* Experience in supply chain concepts and statistical analysis.
* Knowledge of operations research concepts, including integer, linear, and stochastic programming.
* Strong critical and operational thinking skills.
* Familiarity with data visualization tools such as Streamlit and Power BI.
* Proficiency in query languages such as SQL and Snowflake, or Python\-based SQL wrappers.
* Solid grounding in applied statistics, including distributions, hypothesis testing, and regression analysis.
* Bonus skills: familiarity with Dask/parallel processing, Airflow orchestration tools, Postman/API integration.
* Strong scripting and programming capabilities.
* Data\-driven mindset with an eye for detail.


**Educational Background**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science with a focus on Data Science.


**Experience**
* 1 to 3 years of relevant experience.


**Our Values**
 If you want to know the heart of a company, take a look at their values. Ours unite us. They are what drive our success – and the success of our customers. Does your heart beat like ours? Find out here: Core Values
   

  

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

title: Research Engineer-I
description:
**About Us**
 Attentive.ai is transforming the field services and construction industries with our flagship AI solution \- Beam AI. Our platform empowers businesses to double their bidding capacity and accelerate growth through automation and intelligent insights. More than 900 businesses across the U.S. and Canada already use our products to boost sales velocity and streamline operations. Backed by Peak XV (Surge), Insight Partners, InfoEdge, Vertex, and Tenacity Ventures, we’re on a mission to make advanced AI tools accessible, practical, and impactful in the real world.
   

  

**Position Description**
 As a Research Engineer\-I, you will be an integral part of our AI research team focused on transforming the construction industry through cutting\-edge deep learning, computer vision and NLP technologies. You will contribute to the development of intelligent systems for automated construction take\-off and estimation by working with unstructured data such as blueprint, drawings (including SVGs), and PDF documents.
   

  

 In this role, you will support the end\-to\-end lifecycle of AI\-based solutions — from prototyping and experimentation to deployment in production. Your contributions will directly impact the scalability, accuracy, and efficiency of our products.
   

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities**
* Contribute to research and development initiatives focused on Computer Vision, Image Processing, and Deep Learning applied to construction\-related data.
* Build and optimize models for extracting insights from documents such as blueprints, scanned PDFs, and SVG files.
* Contribute development of multi\-modal models that integrate vision with language\-based features (NLP/LLMs).
* Follow best data science and machine learning practices, including data\- centric development, experiment tracking, model validation, and reproducibility.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams including software engineers, ML researchers, and product teams to convert research ideas into real\-world applications.
* Write clean, scalable, and production\-ready code using Python and frameworks like PyTorch, TensorFlow, or HuggingFace.
* Stay updated with the latest research in computer vision and machine learning and evaluate applicability to construction industry challenges.


**Skills \& Requirements**
* 1\-3 years of experience in applied AI/ML and research with a strong focus on Computer Vision and Deep Learning.
* Solid understanding of image processing, visual document understanding, and feature extraction from visual data.
* Familiarity with SVG graphics, NLP, or LLM\-based architectures is a plus.
* Deep understanding of unsupervised learning techniques like clustering, dimensionality reduction, and representation learning.
* Proficiency in Python and ML frameworks such as PyTorch, OpenCV, TensorFlow, and HuggingFace Transformers.
* Hands\-on experience with model optimization techniques (e.g., quantization, pruning, knowledge distillation). \- Good to have
* Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git), project tracking tools (e.g., JIRA), and cloud environments (GCP, AWS, or Azure).
* Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, and containerized ML deployment pipelines.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with a passion for building innovative solutions; ability to rapidly prototype and iterate.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, agile, startup\-like environment with excellent communication and collaboration skills.


**Why Work With Us?**
* Be part of a visionary team building a first\-of\-its\-kind AI solution for the construction industry.
* Exposure to real\-world AI deployment and cutting\-edge research in vision and multimodal learning.
* Culture that encourages ownership, innovation, and growth.
* Opportunities for fast learning, mentorship, and career progression.

title: Data Scientist
description:
**Your potential, unleashed.** 









 India’s impact on the global economy has increased at an exponential rate and Deloitte presents an opportunity to unleash and realise your potential amongst cutting edge leaders, and organisations shaping the future of the region, and indeed, the world beyond.
 



 At Deloitte, your whole self to work, every day. Combine that with our drive to propel with purpose and you have the perfect playground to collaborate, innovate, grow, and make an impact that matters.
 



  





**The team** 




  





 The Digital Excellence Centre is responsible for building products and platforms for Deloitte India that focuses on providing extraordinary customer experience by putting design thinking with trailblazing technology in the center of what they do. The diverse team consists of subject matter experts, technology specialists, quality engineers, user experience researchers \& designers, data scientists and product managers.
 



  





**Work you’ll do** 




  





 As a Machine Learning Engineer, you will play a crucial role in the development and implementation of cutting\-edge artificial intelligence products. Your responsibilities will involve designing and constructing sophisticated machine learning models, as well as refining and updating existing systems.
 



 In order to thrive in this position, you must possess exceptional skills in statistics and programming, as well as a deep understanding of data science and software engineering principles.
 



 Your ultimate objective will be to create highly efficient self\-learning applications that can adapt and evolve over time, pushing the boundaries of AI technology.
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 




 · Partner closely with stakeholders to identify high\-impact applications of data to solve meaningful business problems.
 



 · Identify, mine, and analyze medium and large size datasets to unearth insights that drive new business value for clients.
 



 · Develop robust statistical and machine learning models and implement processes to evaluate, automate and improve model performance.
 



 · Lead efforts with various functions to test, deploy and iterate on data science solutions
 



 · Build, execute, and evaluate A/B tests
 



 · Provide feedback to improve the quality of data collection to ensure adequacy, accuracy and legitimacy of data (e.g. this could involve cross\-checking of different sources and validating the correlation between them)
 



  





**As a prospective candidate, you should possess:** 




 1\. Ability to process complex data sets
 



 2\. Ability to perform exploratory data analysis to discover interesting trends and relationships
 



 3\. Experience applying statistical modelling, machine learning, NLP, and other quantitative techniques to solve business problems
 



 4\. Experience in deep learning
 



 5\. Possess understanding of and ability to communicate statistics to experts and non\-experts
 



 6\. Creative thinker who has proven ability to innovate through data exploration and application of solutions
 



 7\. Ability to thrive in an environment that requires flexibility and multi\-tasking
 



 8\. Ability to take initiative and work with high level of independence
 



 9\. Strong technical and remote collaboration skills are a must
 



 10\. Any exposure to Generative AI would be a great addition.
 



  





**How you’ll grow** 




  





 At Deloitte, our professional development plan focuses on helping people at every level of their career identify and use their strengths to do their best work every day. From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe there’s always room to learn. We offer opportunities to help build world\-class skills in addition to hands\-on experience in the global, fast\-changing business world. From on\-the\-job learning experiences to formal development programs at Deloitte University, our professionals have a variety of opportunities to continue to grow throughout their career. Explore Deloitte University, The Leadership Center.
 



  





**Benefits** 




  





 At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. We value our people and offer employees a broad range of benefits. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
 



  





**Our purpose** 









 Deloitte is led by a purpose: To make an impact that matters.
 



  





 Every day, Deloitte people are making a real impact in the places they live and work. We pride ourselves on doing not only what is good for clients, but also what is good for our people and the communities in which we live and work—always striving to be an organization that is held up as a role model of quality, integrity, and positive change. Learn more about Deloitte's impact on the world

description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
 Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
   

  

**Your day at NTT DATA**
 The Associate Software Development Engineer is an entry level subject matter expert, tasked with assisting with designing, developing, and testing software systems, modules, or applications for software enhancements and new products including cloud\-based or internet\-related tools.
   

  

 This role is accountable for assisting with for detailed design for certain modules/sub\-systems, doing prototype for multi\-vendor infrastructure, and showcasing it internally or externally to clients.
   

  

 This role designs and develops functionality in a micro\-services environment working with APIs, telemetry data, and running ML/AI algorithms on it, working with both structured and unstructured data.
   

  

**Key responsibilities:**
* Receives detailed instructions to design and develop solutions and functionality that drives the growth of business.
* Assists with writing and testing code.
* Assists with the execution of automated testing.
* Takes directions from various stakeholders to participate in software deployment.
* Assists with delivering software components while working in collaboration with the product team.
* Supports the integration and building of solutions through automation and coding, using 3rd party software.
* Receives detailed instructions to craft, build, and debug large scale distributed systems.
* Assists with writing, updating and maintaining the technical program, end\-user documentation, and operational procedures.
* Assists with refactoring code.
* Assists with the reviewing of code written by other developers.
* Performs any other related task as required.


**To thrive in this role, you need to have:**
* Basic understanding of cloud architecture and services in multiple public clouds like AWS, GCP, Microsoft Azure, and Microsoft Office 365\.
* Developing subject matter expert in programming languages such as C/C\+\+, C\#, Java, JavaScript, Python, Node.js, libraries and frameworks.
* Some expertise of data structures, algorithms, and software design with strong analytical and debugging skills.
* Knowledge of micro services\-based software architecture and experience with API product development.
* Some expertise in SQL and no\-SQL data stores including Elasticsearch, MongoDB, Cassandra.
* Basic understanding of container run time (Kubernetes, Docker, LXC/LXD).
* Some proficiency with agile, lean practices and believes in test\-driven development.
* Possess a can\-do attitude and one that takes initiative.
* Ability to work well in a diverse team with different backgrounds and experience levels.
* Ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment.
* Some proficiency with CI/CD concepts and tools.
* Some proficiency with cloud\-based infrastructure and deployments.
* Excellent attention to detail.


**Academic qualifications and certifications:**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field.
* Microsoft Certified Azure Fundamentals preferred.

description:
ML Engineer
   

  

 About the Role:
   

  

 We are looking for an ML Engineer to build the machine learning and data foundations that power our AI platform. While AI Developers create intelligent applications, ML Engineers ensure those applications are accurate, scalable, and continuously improving.
   

  

 You will design and optimize embedding pipelines, retrieval systems, evaluation frameworks, and data pipelines that enable high\-performing AI solutions. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving data\-intensive problems, measuring model performance, and using experimentation to improve AI systems.
   

  

 As AI continues to evolve, you will continuously evaluate new models, embedding techniques, retrieval strategies, and ML approaches to ensure our platform remains accurate, efficient, and future\-ready.
   

  

 Responsibilities:
   

 1\. Design, build, and maintain machine learning pipelines supporting AI applications.
   

 2\. Develop and optimize embedding pipelines, vector databases, and Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) infrastructure.
   

 3\. Build evaluation frameworks to measure retrieval quality, response accuracy, relevance, latency, and overall AI system performance.
   

 4\. Improve search relevance through chunking strategies, reranking, metadata filtering, and retrieval optimization.
   

 5\. Analyze production data to identify opportunities for improving AI quality and user experience.
   

 6\. Design experiments, evaluate results, and make data\-driven recommendations.
   

 7\. Develop monitoring and observability for AI systems, including model performance, embeddings, retrieval metrics, and data quality.
   

 8\. Collaborate with AI Developers to improve chatbot accuracy and reliability.
   

 9\. Evaluate emerging ML techniques, embedding models, and AI infrastructure technologies for business adoption.
   

 10\. Establish best practices for ML engineering, experimentation, and model lifecycle management.
   

  

 Experience \& Qualifications:
   

  

 1\. 2 \- 4 years of experience in Machine Learning, Applied AI, Data Science, or Software Engineering with a focus on ML systems.
   

 2\. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, Software Engineering, or a related quantitative field. A Master’s degree is a plus.
   

 3\. Strong programming skills in Python and SQL.
   

 4\. Strong understanding of machine learning fundamentals, statistics, and experimental design.
   

 5\. Experience with machine learning libraries such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Scikit\-learn.
   

 6\. Hands\-on experience with embeddings, vector databases, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), feature engineering, and model evaluation.
   

 7\. Experience building data pipelines and integrating structured and unstructured datasets.
   

 8\. Familiarity with cloud platforms (preferably AWS), Docker, Git, and modern development practices.
   

 9\. Strong analytical mindset with experience designing experiments and interpreting model performance metrics.
   

 10\. Demonstrated passion for continuous learning through research, personal projects, open\-source contributions, or experimentation with emerging ML and AI technologies.
   

  

 Nice to Have:
   

 Experience with pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS, Milvus, or similar vector databases.
   

 Experience with MLflow, Weights \& Biases, LangSmith, Arize, Phoenix, or other evaluation and observability platforms.
   

 Knowledge of ranking algorithms, recommendation systems, semantic search, or information retrieval.
   

 Experience with distributed data processing using Spark, Airflow, or similar orchestration tools.
   

 Familiarity with LLMOps, model deployment, inference optimization, and production monitoring.
   

  

 What We Are Looking For:
   

 We are looking for engineers who:
   

 Experience working with large\-scale structured and unstructured datasets for search, recommendation or analytics.
   

 Enjoy solving data and machine learning problems through experimentation and analysis.
   

 Think in terms of measurement, evaluation, and continuous improvement.
   

 Are passionate about optimizing AI performance rather than simply integrating AI models.
   

 Stay current with advances in machine learning, retrieval systems, embeddings, and model evaluation.
   

 Build reliable, scalable ML systems that directly improve the quality of AI applications.

title: Associate GenAI Engineer
description:
**Role overview** 




  





 This role sits where GenAI engineering meets learning content. You'll help design and build the agentic systems that generate and quality\-check what learners study, working closely with the team as you grow into owning parts of the pipeline yourself. It suits someone early in their journey who's already as excited about shipping an agent as they are about judging whether the content it created is actually good, and who cares whether learners succeed, not just whether something shipped.
 



  





**What you'll do (and grow into)** 




  





 You'll help build the AI systems that generate and quality\-check our learning content (lesson scripts, coding exercises, graded projects, MCQs), and take on more ownership of that content as it reaches learners the more you show you can. The agents are how the work gets done; what we'll grow you toward is content that ships quickly, holds up under assessment, and stays current.
 



  




* Build and ship parts of the agentic workflows (n8n, LangGraph, LLM APIs) that generate learning content, and help hold them to our bar for instructional clarity and technical accuracy, contributing to a 4/5\-or\-better instructor rating.
* Help build the quality layer: the eval sets, rubrics, and guardrails that decide what's good enough to ship, and author content yourself to keep sharpening your own judgment.
* Keep content accurate and current: spot outdated Gen AI concepts, deprecated libraries, wrong syntax, or broken code examples, and fix them promptly, with support on the trickier calls.
* Get involved in curriculum R\&D: try out new tools and frameworks as they land, and share what's worth adding or retiring.
* Learn the foundations that keep the pipeline running and improving: memory, knowledge bases, integrations, and observability, and help clear the issues that stall generation or loading.



  





**What your work feeds into:** 




  





**Content:** 
 velocity (more shipped per cycle), efficiency (lower cost and effort per unit), effectiveness (learners who complete it pass what they're assessed on), and relevancy (it stays current).
 



**Business:** 
 skill\-assessment success percentage, a minimal delta between content and assessment, and more learners landing in the ideal engagement bands.
 



  





**Must\-have** 




  




* 0–1 year of building software or AI projects — internships, personal, course, or hackathon work all count — with at least one LLM\-integrated app or agent you can show us (GitHub or live demo, not a tutorial follow\-along).
* Genuine hands\-on familiarity with GenAI (prompt design, basic RAG, vector databases, calling hosted LLM APIs), and enough content sense to tell technically accurate material from sloppy.
* Comfortable in Python, plus some full\-stack (MERN or similar), enough to build simple surfaces your agents plug into and write your own logic and integrations.
* Have used an agent/automation framework (n8n, LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, or equivalent) to build at least a multi\-step, tool\-calling workflow.
* An evaluation instinct in the making: you check your output against something before you trust it, rather than assuming it's right.
* Curiosity about where things break — wrong answers, hallucination, cost — and the willingness to dig in and figure out why.
* You already use AI tools (Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT, Copilot) as a normal part of how you build.
* A fast learner: you can pick up a new tool or concept from docs, AI, and a bit of guidance without needing step\-by\-step instruction.
* You write clearly: precise, structured, easy to follow.



  





**Nice\-to\-have** 




  




* Any EdTech, tutoring, teaching, or content\-creation experience, even informal.
* Exposure to observability or eval tooling (LangSmith, RAGAS, or similar), or to CI/CD.
* A public trail of how you learn: a thoughtful README, a walkthrough, a blog post, an open\-source contribution, or a project demo.



  





**Why this role** 




  





 GenAI content is being figured out as it's built, and this is a rare first or second role where you help shape how it's done rather than run someone else's playbook. You'll build real systems, see their impact on real learners, and grow fast, with room to experiment, ship, and improve. If you've built something you're proud of and you're hungry to build a lot more, we'd love to see it.
 



  





**Location:** 
 Hyderabad (In\-office)
 



**Workweek:** 
 5 days

* Excellent understanding of business intelligence and reporting concepts.
* Ability to convert business requirements into technical solutions.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively with cross\-functional teams.
* Strong attention to data accuracy and report quality.

title: Full Stack Data Engineer
description:
**Role Overview** 




 We are seeking a talented Full Stack Data Engineer to join our growing Data \& Analytics team.
 



 This is a hands\-on role for someone who enjoys building data solutions end\-to\-end—from ingesting and transforming raw data through to modelling, visualization, and delivering actionable business insights. You will work closely with stakeholders across Commercial, Operations, Finance, and Corporate Functions to translate business requirements into scalable data products built on the Microsoft Fabric ecosystem.
 



  





 The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise with a business\-oriented mindset and enjoys owning solutions throughout their lifecycle.
 



  





**Note: Role will require supporting EU/US timezones. Flexibility in working hours is to be expected** 




  





**About Role** 



* End\-to\-End BI Solution Development
* Design, develop, and implement full\-stack BI solutions from data ingestion through to user\-facing reports and apps.
* Take ambiguous business questions and translate them into well\-defined BI products, including data models, semantic layers, dashboards, and supporting documentation.
* Manage delivery from discovery and prototyping through validation and production support.
* Ensure data accuracy, integrity, and reliability across all BI solutions.
* Data Pipelines, Modelling, and ETL
* Develop and maintain ingestion and transformation pipelines using Microsoft Fabric (Data Factory pipelines, dataflows Gen2, copy activities).
* Land, organise, and structure data using Fabric Lakehouse and/or Data Warehouse patterns.
* Implement layered data architectures (e.g. bronze / silver / gold) to ensure modular, reusable, and testable transformations.
* Partner with Data Engineers to align on ETL standards, performance optimisation, and scalable design.
* Apply data quality checks, validation rules, and monitoring to proactively identify issues.
* Semantic Models, Reporting, and Visualisation
* Design dimensional and star schemas optimised for BI use cases (facts, dimensions, SCDs, conformed dimensions).
* Build and maintain Power BI semantic models (datasets) with clear, consistent business logic using DAX measures and calculated columns.
* Develop high\-quality Power BI reports, dashboards, and apps that are intuitive, performant, and aligned to real business workflows.
* Implement navigation, drill\-through, parameterised views, and security (row\-level and object\-level) as required.
* Optimise models and reports for performance, maintainability, and scalability.
* Data Analysis and Insights
* Perform data analysis to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities that support decision\-making.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to understand analytical needs and deliver actionable insights.
* Support advanced analytics use cases where appropriate, including predictive or statistical models in partnership with other specialists.
* Data Governance, Documentation, and Support
* Ensure BI solutions comply with data governance policies, security standards, and regulatory requirements.
* Contribute to and follow standards for naming, workspace structure, environments, and deployment flows in Fabric.
* Document BI products clearly, including purpose, data sources, refresh cadence, ownership, lineage, and known limitations.
* Contribute to shared libraries of reusable calculations, templates, and visual standards.
* Provide structured handovers, user support, and occasional training or knowledge\-sharing sessions.
* Collaboration and Continuous Improvement
* Work closely with business stakeholders to prioritise work and agree success measures for BI products.
* Collaborate with data engineering, architecture, governance, and security teams to align on standards and patterns.
* Participate in peer reviews of SQL, DAX, data models, and report designs.
* Support continuous improvement of BI delivery practices, promoting full\-stack ownership and reduced hand\-offs.



  





**About You** 



* Strong proficiency in SQL for data transformation, modelling, and performance tuning.
* Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Fabric components, including:
* Data Factory (pipelines, dataflows Gen2\)
* Lakehouse and/or Data Warehouse
* Power BI datasets, reports, and apps
* Strong Power BI skills, including DAX, semantic modelling, and performance optimization.
* Solid understanding of data warehousing and dimensional modelling concepts.
* Experience implementing BI security models (e.g. RLS).
* Familiarity with Git\-based source control and CI/CD practices for BI and analytics assets.
* Experience working with enterprise source systems (e.g. ERP, CRM, finance systems).



  





**Analytical And Professional Skills** 



* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to translate business needs into technical solutions.
* Clear communication skills, able to explain complex technical concepts to non\-technical audiences.
* Strong attention to detail, documentation, and data quality.
* Ability to work effectively in a cross\-functional, collaborative environment.
* Comfortable working in regulated or compliance\-driven environments.



  





**Education/ Qualifications** 



* Bachelor/Master in relevant field (e.g. Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Engineering), or equivalent practical experience.
* Proven experience (typically 3\+ years) in a BI, analytics, or data engineering role delivering end\-to\-end BI solutions.
* Demonstrated experience working across the full BI stack, from data ingestion and modelling to reporting and user adoption.

title: Manual QA
description:
**Job Summary**
 We are looking for a detail\-oriented Manual QA Engineer with strong testing fundamentals to
   

  

 ensure the quality and reliability of our applications. You will be responsible for analyzing
   

  

 requirements, designing and executing test cases, validating business workflows, and tracking
   

  

 defects while working closely with product and development teams. This role requires hands\-on
   

  

 experience in manual testing, test case design, defect management, and test reporting, along
   

  

 with the ability to think through real\-world scenarios and edge cases as the product evolves
   

  

 rapidly in a startup environment.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Analyze requirements, user stories, user flows, and functional specifications to identify test scenarios
* Design, review, and maintain test cases, test scenarios, and test data
* Perform functional, regression, smoke, sanity, and exploratory testing
* Identify, document, and track software defects and ensure timely resolution in collaboration with the development team
* Participate in requirement review meetings and provide feedback from a QA perspective
* Generate and share test execution and quality reports
* Work closely with developers and product owners to clarify requirements and resolve issues
* Participate in test planning, test estimation, and test execution cycles
* Ensure test coverage aligns with business and technical requirements

* applications (Android / iOS)
* Strong foundation in software testing fundamentals, including SDLC, STLC, and the defect
* life cycle
* Strong understanding of black box test design techniques, such as Equivalence Partitioning,
* Boundary Value Analysis, Decision Table Testing, and State Transition Testing
* Hands\-on experience with test management tools (Testiny, TestRail, Zephyr, etc.)
* Effective communication skills, both written and verbal, to articulate quality issues clearly
* Ability to design and document clear, concise, and well\-structured test cases
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with close attention to detail

description:
**About the Role** 




 Chetaru Web Link is looking for a hands\-on QA Tester to own quality across our client web and mobile projects. You will be the last checkpoint before anything reaches a client or goes live. We need someone who tests thoroughly, documents clearly, and does not pass work forward until it actually works.
 



**This is a full\-time on\-site position at our Indore office.** 
 Candidates must be currently based in Indore or willing to relocate before joining. We are not considering remote or hybrid applicants for this role.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 



* Test WordPress and WooCommerce websites — themes, plugins, forms, checkout flows, payment gateways, and post\-update regression
* Test Shopify stores — product and variant setup, cart and checkout, discount logic, app integrations, and theme customisations
* Test Laravel web applications — user roles and permissions, CRUD flows, form validation, API responses, and admin panels
* Test Flutter mobile applications on both Android and iOS — UI behaviour across screen sizes, offline handling, app permissions, and API integration
* Perform cross\-browser and cross\-device testing (Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge; desktop, tablet, mobile)
* Verify responsive layouts and styling against approved designs
* Write and maintain test cases, test scenarios, and checklists for each project
* Log defects with clear reproduction steps, expected vs actual behaviour, environment details, and screenshots or screen recordings
* Retest fixes and confirm closure — no bug is marked resolved without verification
* Run pre\-deployment and post\-deployment sanity checks on live sites
* Carry out routine health checks on all running client sites (broken links, forms, page load, SSL, console errors, plugin/version issues)
* Work directly alongside developers and project leads in\-office for faster defect turnaround
* Share daily and weekly QA status reports with the project lead



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* Based in Indore or able to relocate — this is a strictly on\-site role with no work\-from\-home option
* \[1–3] years of hands\-on manual testing experience on web and mobile projects
* Working understanding of WordPress, Shopify, Laravel, and Flutter applications from a tester's perspective
* Strong grasp of QA fundamentals — functional, regression, smoke, sanity, UI/UX, and compatibility testing
* Ability to write clear, structured bug reports and test documentation in English
* Familiarity with bug tracking and project management tools (Jira, ClickUp, Trello, or similar)
* Basic API testing using Postman
* Comfort reading HTML/CSS and using browser developer tools to identify front\-end issues
* Attention to detail and the discipline to follow a checklist end to end
* Willingness to take ownership — flagging a problem is expected, not optional



  





**Good to Have** 



* Experience with automation tools (Selenium, Cypress, Appium)
* Familiarity with BrowserStack or similar device\-cloud platforms
* Exposure to Firebase App Distribution, TestFlight, or Google Play internal testing
* Basic knowledge of SQL for data verification
* Understanding of performance and basic security testing



  





**Work Details** 



* Salary: ₹15,000 – ₹25,000 per month, based on experience and performance in the practical assessment
* Working days: Mon–Fri
* Working hours: 10 AM – 7:30 PM



  





**How to Apply** 



* Send your CV to \[email address] with the subject line "QA Tester — \[Your Name] — \[Your Current City]". Please confirm your current location, current CTC, expected CTC, and notice period in the email body. Shortlisted candidates will complete a short practical testing task and attend an in\-person interview at our office.

title: Performance Engineer I
description:
**Job Purpose**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
 As DP world progresses in its mission of being a global trade enabler, we are looking for an engineer who loves working on a highly complex distributed web application.
   

  

 In this role, you will be working with cross\-functional teams across the company to benchmark systems performance and finding performance issues. You will own performance test plans and execution for large\-scale projects. You will own components and services from a performance aspect, and work with Products, Developer, Infra, and SDET in delivering high\-quality software. You will perform various activities not just limited to performance test script development, tool, and framework development, performance benchmarking, load and stress testing, performance optimization, capacity planning, etc. You will work with software engineering leaders to cross\-leverage performance testing solutions that are available in the market or that are being built in other teams.
   

  

 To be successful in this role, you should have excellent time management and organizational skills as well as strong communication skills. You should be self\-driven and passionate about solving performance issues and have the ability to upgrade your technical skills within the constantly changing technology sector.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**
 Design and development of performance test tools, framework, and automation.
   

  

 Design and execute the performance test plan to validate system performance and stability.
   

  

 Analyze test results, resource utilization, configuration, and other system metrics to identify issues and suggest changes to improve system performance, capacity, reliability, and scalability.
   

  

 Work with developers, SDET, and other stakeholders in fixing performance issues.
   

  

 Design and conduct tests with complex workloads and data shapes to expose potential bottlenecks and failure points.
   

  

 Validate fail\-over/recovery scenarios and measures any impact to response times and interruptions during the execution of such scenarios.
   

  

 Derive performance improvement opportunities by analyzing production metrics and trends.
   

  

 Design and develop Performance Engineering aides like profiles, traces, or any observability framework.
   

  

 Participate in performance requirements and planning discussions to prepare performance test plan/strategy creation.
   

  

 Prepare performance test reports with observations and recommendations.
   

  

 Researching performance test tools, methodologies, and trends and upgrading existing practices and processes.
   

  

**Other**
 Act as an ambassador for DP World at all times when working; promoting and demonstrating positive behaviors in harmony with DP World’s Founder’s Principles, values and culture; ensuring the highest level of safety is applied in all activities; understanding and following DP World’s Code of Conduct and Ethics policies
   

  

 Perform other related duties as assigned
   

  

**JOB CONTEXT**
 DP World is a leading enabler of global trade and an integral part of the supply chain. We operate multiple yet related businesses – from marine and inland terminals, maritime services, logistics and ancillary services to technology\-driven trade solutions.
   

  

 We have a portfolio of 78 operating marine and inland terminals supported by over 50 related businesses in over 40 countries across six continents with a significant presence in both high\-growth and mature markets. We aim to be essential to the bright future of global trade, ensuring everything we do has a long\-lasting positive impact on economies and society.
   

  

 Our dedicated team of over 45,000 employees from 110 countries cultivates long\-standing relationships with governments, shipping lines, importers and exporters, communities, and many other important constituents of the global supply chain, to add value and provide quality services today and tomorrow.
   

  

 Container handling is the company’s core business and generates more than three quarters of its revenue. In 2018, DP World handled 71 million TEU (twenty\-foot equivalent units) across our portfolio. With its committed pipeline of developments and expansions, the current gross capacity of 90 million TEU is expected to rise to more than 100 million TEU by 2020, in line with market demand.
   

  

 By thinking ahead, foreseeing change and innovating we aim to create the most productive, efficient and safe trade solutions globally.
   

  

**Qualifications, Experience And Skills**
 A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
   

  

 1\.6\-4 years of work experience in performance testing and analysis, preferably of a large\-scale distributed web application in a cloud environment such as AWS, Azure.
   

  

 Strong hands\-on experience in at least one programming language. Should be able to code independently.
   

  

 Strong experience with open\-source performance testing tools (JMeter preferred) and frameworks.
   

  

 The ability to recognize performance issues and risk in a distributed web application.
   

  

 Good understanding of distributed systems, computer architecture, and operating systems.
   

  

 Experience in analyzing the CPU Utilization, Memory usage, Network usage, Garbage Collection, and DB Parameters and DB Report verifying the performance of the applications. Thread dump analysis.
   

  

 Container technologies such as Docker or Kubernetes
   

  

 Experience with SQL and/or NoSQL databases
   

  

 The ability to deal with ambiguous/undefined problems, isolating them and finding the root cause.
   

  

 Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
   

  

 Good time management and organizational skills.
   

  

 The ability to keep current with the constantly changing technology industry.

title: Devops Engineer
description:
Join us at GemOne — a fast\-growing tech company and proud daughter of TVH, mixing the energy of a scale\-up with the stability of an established global player. We build smart telematics solutions that help businesses manage their industrial fleets more safely and efficiently. We keep things hands\-on, collaborative, and down\-to\-earth. If you’re eager to learn, take initiative, and make a real impact, you’ll fit right in!
   

  

**About The Position**
 GemOne is looking for a DevOps Engineer to join our Platform team within our broader Products organization. You will mainly be focusing on improving our existing infrastructure, as well as coming up with and implementing new solutions that drive our business forward. A flavor of what you will be doing:
   

  

* Design, develop, and maintain Terraform configurations for creating and managing GCP resources
* Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) best practices
* Automate infrastructure deployments and configuration management using CI/CD pipelines
* Collaborate with product development teams to ensure smooth deployments and operations
* Troubleshoot and resolve infrastructure issues
* Stay up\-to\-date on the latest GCP and Terraform features and best practices


 On top of that, you can be asked to work on other value\-adding projects for which GemOne knows and sees the potential it can bring to our own company
 *and* 
 our customers, but which is to date still a greenfield within our organization \-therefore you will be able to play a pioneering role in exploiting these greenfields.
   

  

 Aside from the above mentioned “objectives”, you will also be able to learn from state\-of\-the\-art IoT technology, together with a joyous mix of high\-potentials and well seasoned professionals \-if you want to learn a lot and very quickly, then you’ve come to the right place
   

  

 Given the importance of this role, a minimum office attendance of 3 days / week is required.
   

  

**Required Expertise \& Capabilities**
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Bitbucket Pipelines, Jenkins, Gitlab CI/CD)
* Scripting experience with languages like Bash or Python
* Knowledge of Terraform and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles
* Experience with a cloud service provider, preferably GCP
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team
* Healthy level of criticism, i.e. not afraid to challenge the status quo
* Proactive mindset \-spotting problems / challenges, but also drafting the potential solution and acting upon it
* Fluent in English


**Bonus Points**
* Experience with container orchestration tools (e.g., Kubernetes)
* Experience with infrastructure monitoring tools (e.g., Prometheus, Cloud Monitoring)
* Experience in a fast\-paced, growth\-oriented environment


**What’s In It For You**
 At GemOne, people really matter. You’ll join a company where your well\-being comes first, with flexible hours, the option to work from home, 20 vacation days plus 12 extra days off (based on a 40\-hour week).
   

  

 What else do we offer?
   

  

* A competitive salary with great extras like a company car, group and hospitalization insurance, meal vouchers, Iphone and access to a company restaurant.
* A people\-first culture with a warm, family feel.
* A tech\-driven environment where innovation and collaboration go hand in hand.
* Room to grow through ongoing support and many in\-house and external training opportunities.
* TVH Park: our green campus where you can relax, play kubb or petanque, and enjoy summer events.


 If you're ready to make an impact and grow with us, we’d love to hear from you!
   

  

 We believe diverse teams build better products and better workplaces. Not sure you tick every box? Apply anyway. Your potential matters more than perfection.
   

  

 \#Indeed\_ITCD
